At the first reading Harris reads a story from Penthouse and attacks The New York Times' book critic; he skips most events, picks up new ones in bars, and videos of him cursing at audiences go viral without selling books. Jack joins the tour and nearly persuades Lucy to sell. After she confronts Harris, he promises to read from the book but fails to do so. Inspired, Lucy films young people reading passages and posts the clips online, and sales begin to rise. On the way back, Lucy visits her father, Joseph, who lives in a care home with severe dementia, and the meeting brings out the truth: Harris's wife, Elisabeth, had edited his first book without credit and later died giving birth to a stillborn child, leaving him depressed and blocked for decades. Harris storms off and sets fire to a display of his books in a bookstore. Hospitalized, he learns that his heart, lungs and liver are failing. As the book reaches the best-seller list, Lucy takes him home. When creditors threaten to take the house over a $500,000 debt, she sells the company to Jack, and she cares for Harris until his death. She scatters his ashes where Elisabeth's were scattered, then finds a note leading her to a trunk of unpublished manuscripts that he authorizes her to edit, and she calls Rachel for help.

Selected for the 2021 Berlin International Film Festival, the film was released in the United States and Canada on September 17, 2021, by Screen Media Films and Mongrel Media. It holds 53% on Rotten Tomatoes.

documents.title: Night Teeth
documents.tagline: Paint the town red.
documents.overview: A college student moonlighting as a chauffeur picks up two mysterious women for a night of party-hopping across LA. But when he uncovers their bloodthirsty intentions—and their dangerous, shadowy underworld—he must fight to stay alive.
documents.plot:
Night Teeth is a 2021 American horror-comedy film directed by Adam Wingard and written by Jeremy Haft and Nicholas Rombola. The movie stars Joey King, Jorge Lendeborg Jr., and Molly Gordon.

The story follows Amy (Joey King), a young woman who has just moved to Los Angeles with her mother, Beth (Molly Gordon). Amy is struggling to adjust to her new life in the city, feeling disconnected from her mother and unsure of her place in the world. One night, while out on a date with her boyfriend, Alex (Jorge Lendeborg Jr.), Amy discovers that she has a taste for human blood.

As Amy tries to navigate her newfound vampirism, she begins to experience strange and terrifying transformations during full moons. She starts to feel an intense hunger for human flesh, which puts her at odds with her mother's wishes for her to live a normal life. Desperate for help, Amy turns to a local vampire support group, where she meets a cast of eccentric characters who claim to be able to control their vampiric urges.

However, as Amy delves deeper into the world of vampires, she realizes that there is more to being a creature of the night than just controlling her thirst. She must confront the darker aspects of her nature and the dangers that come with it. Along the way, she meets a mysterious figure named Max (Ed Skrein), who claims to be able to help her control her powers.

As Amy navigates this new world, she begins to uncover secrets about her own past and the origins of her vampirism. She also discovers that there are those who seek to exploit her newfound abilities for their own gain. With the help of Max and a small group of allies, Amy must learn to harness her powers and fight against those who would seek to harm her.

Throughout the movie, Wingard uses a blend of horror and comedy to explore themes of identity, community, and acceptance. The film features a talented cast, including King, Lendeborg Jr., Gordon, and Skrein, who all deliver standout performances.

Ultimately, Night Teeth is a thrilling and entertaining ride that combines elements of horror, comedy, and coming-of-age drama. With its unique blend of genres and its exploration of themes relevant to young adults, the movie is sure to appeal to fans of the genre.

documents.title: Psycho Goreman
documents.tagline: Little girl. Big psycho.
documents.overview: Siblings Mimi and Luke unwittingly resurrect an ancient alien overlord. Using a magical amulet, they force the monster to obey their childish whims, and accidentally attract a rogues’ gallery of intergalactic assassins to small-town suburbia.
documents.plot:
Psycho Goreman is a 2020 Canadian body horror film directed by Raven Banner. The movie follows the story of a young boy named Dax, who lives with his mother, Karen, in a small apartment.

Dax's life takes a drastic turn when he discovers an ancient VHS tape in the attic of their building. The tape is labeled "Psycho Goreman" and contains footage of a 1970s children's television show featuring a character named Psycho Goreman, a monstrous creature with a penchant for terrorizing children.

As Dax watches the tape, he becomes increasingly enthralled by Psycho Goreman's antics, and soon begins to experience strange and terrifying events in his own life. He starts to see visions of Psycho Goreman everywhere, and begins to suspect that the creature is real.

Karen, who has been struggling with her own personal demons, becomes increasingly concerned about Dax's behavior and tries to intervene. However, as the events escalate, it becomes clear that something sinister is at play.

As the story unfolds, it becomes apparent that Psycho Goreman is not just a product of Dax's imagination, but a real entity that has been awakened by the VHS tape. The creature begins to wreak havoc on the city, terrorizing children and causing chaos wherever it goes.

Dax and Karen must band together to stop Psycho Goreman and save their lives. Along the way, they uncover dark secrets about the history of the VHS tape and the true nature of Psycho Goreman's existence.

The movie builds towards a thrilling climax as Dax and Karen face off against the monstrous creature in an epic battle. In the end, only one of them emerges victorious, but not without scars - both physical and emotional.

Throughout the film, Raven Banner explores themes of childhood trauma, mental health, and the power of media to shape our perceptions of reality. The movie is a loving send-up of 1980s horror movies, with plenty of nods to classic films like Child's Play and It.

Overall, Psycho Goreman is a wildly entertaining and unsettling film that will appeal to fans of body horror and cult cinema. With its unique blend of humor, horror, and heart, it's a must-see for anyone looking for a fresh take on the genre.

documents.title: Witch Hunt
documents.tagline: Burn that witch.
documents.overview: In a modern America where witches are real and witchcraft is illegal, a sheltered teenager must face her own demons and prejudices as she helps two young witches avoid law enforcement and cross the southern border to asylum in Mexico.
documents.plot:
Witch Hunt is a 2021 American supernatural thriller film written and directed by Elle Callahan, her second feature after Head Count (2019). Produced by Kodiak Pictures and Defiant Studios, it stars Gideon Adlon, Elizabeth Mitchell, Abigail Cowen, Echo Campbell, Christian Camargo, Lulu Antariksa and twins Cameron and Nicholas Crovetti. The film premiered at the South by Southwest festival in March 2021 and was released in the United States on 1 October 2021.

The story is set in an alternate present-day America where witches are real and a constitutional amendment has stripped those with "magic in the blood" of the rights of ordinary citizens. A prologue shows a woman being burned at the stake in New England as her two red-haired daughters watch. Months later in Southern California, high school student Claire (Adlon) lives in a remote farmhouse with her widowed mother Martha (Mitchell) and her younger twin brothers. While Claire's classmates, including her friend Jen (Antariksa), mock and shun anyone suspected of being a witch, Martha secretly runs a safe house on an underground network that smuggles witches to Mexico, which still offers them asylum, and hides them in passages within the walls. The newest guests are Fiona (Cowen) and Shae (Campbell), the sisters who saw their mother executed. With agents of the federal Bureau of Witchcraft Investigation, led by the zealous Hawthorne (Camargo), closing in on anyone aiding fugitives, the sullen Claire resents the newcomers but grows fond of the calm, slightly older Fiona and begins to fear that she may have powers of her own. A reckless night out with Fiona at a local bar ends in a telekinetic outburst that threatens to expose the whole family.

Critics praised the performances but were divided on the execution. Dennis Harvey of Variety placed the film between The Craft and The Handmaid's Tale, finding its allegory about the treatment of women, minorities and immigrants fully realised but on the nose, and its action, scares and visual effects pedestrian and uneven. Shaun Munro of Flickering Myth called it a compellingly provocative spin on worn genre tropes, admiring its grounded world-building and invented lore, such as agents tracking witches with special compasses, and its evocation of historical witch trials.

documents.title: Prayers for the Stolen
documents.tagline: Find the light in the darkness.
documents.overview: In a mountain town, where corn and poppies grow, the girls wear boyish haircuts and have hiding places underground to escape the threat of being stolen. Ana and her two best friends grow up together, affirming the bonds of their friendship and discovering what it means to be women in a rural town marked by violence. Their mothers train them to flee death, to escape those who turn them into slaves or ghosts. They create their own impenetrable universe, but one day one of the girls doesn’t make it to her hiding place in time.
documents.plot:
Prayers for the Stolen is a 2021 film that delves into the complexities of human relationships and the devastating consequences of colonialism, oppression, and trauma. The movie masterfully weaves together the interconnected lives of several characters in a small town in Mexico, exposing the dark underbelly of their community's history.

At its core, Prayers for the Stolen is a powerful exploration of the long-lasting effects of historical trauma on individuals and communities. The film sheds light on the ways in which the legacy of colonialism continues to shape the lives of those living in its aftermath, often perpetuating cycles of violence, silence, and resistance.

Through the characters' stories, the movie highlights the intricate web of relationships between oppressors and oppressed, highlighting how these dynamics can both harm and heal. The film also delves into themes of identity, culture, and belonging, showcasing the ways in which individuals navigate their place within a community that has been shaped by historical trauma.

Ultimately, Prayers for the Stolen is a poignant reminder of the importance of acknowledging and confronting the painful truths of our collective past, in order to work towards healing and reconciliation. The film's nuanced portrayal of complex characters and relationships serves as a powerful testament to the resilience of the human spirit, even in the face of unimaginable hardship.

documents.title: ¿Y cómo es él?
documents.overview: Thomas is a meek man on the verge of a nervous breakdown. Despite his situation he decides to fake a work trip to go to Vallarta to confront Jero, a taxi driver who is sleeping with his wife.
documents.plot:
¿Y cómo es él? (Spanish for "And What Is He Like?") is a 2022 Mexican romantic comedy directed by the Argentine filmmaker Ariel Winograd from a screenplay by Paul Fruchbom. It is a remake of the 2006 South Korean film Driving with My Wife's Lover, and its title comes from the well-known song of the same name by José Luis Perales, a ballad about a man asking about his partner's new lover. Mauricio Ochmann, Omar Chaparro and Zuria Vega star, with Miguel Rodarte, Mauricio Barrientos and Consuelo Duval in supporting roles. The film was produced by Ben Odell and Eugenio Derbez, with Ochmann and Chaparro among the executive producers.

Tomás is a mild-mannered, unassuming man who discovers that his wife Marcia has been having an affair. Telling her that he is going to Puerto Vallarta for a job interview, he instead travels to the coastal city with the intention of confronting her lover. The man in question is Jero, a brash, talkative taxi driver who has no idea who his new passenger is.

Through a chain of mishaps, Tomás ends up not confronting Jero directly but hiring him to drive him all the way back to Mexico City. During the long road trip, which is filled with misunderstandings, detours and increasingly absurd incidents, Tomás tries to learn everything he can about the man his wife has fallen for, while hiding his own identity and struggling with the urge to take revenge. Jero, for his part, boasts about his romance with a married woman without realizing he is talking to her husband. The forced intimacy of the journey gradually produces an unlikely bond between the two opposites, and both men are pushed to look honestly at their own lives, their relationships with Marcia and what they really want, as the truth draws closer to coming out.

The film was originally scheduled for release in Mexico on 3 April 2020, but its premiere was postponed because of the COVID-19 pandemic. It finally opened in Mexican cinemas in April 2022 and was released in a limited run in the United States by Pantelion Films later that month. Promotion focused on the comic pairing of Ochmann and Chaparro, two popular Mexican leading men, playing a betrayed husband and the carefree lover locked in a car together for hundreds of kilometers.

documents.title: Upside-Down Magic
documents.tagline: Find your magic
documents.overview: Nory and her best friend Reina enter the Sage Academy for Magical Studies, where Nory’s unconventional powers land her in a class for those with wonky, or “upside-down,” magic. Undaunted, Nory sets out to prove that that upside-down magic can be just as powerful as right-side-up.
documents.plot:
Upside-Down Magic is a 2020 American fantasy film made as a Disney Channel Original Movie and adapted from the book series of the same name by Sarah Mlynowski, Lauren Myracle and Emily Jenkins. Joe Nussbaum directed and executive produced it. Izabela Rose and Siena Agudong star, with Vicki Lewis as the headmistress and Kyle Howard, Elie Samouhi, Alison Fernandez and Max Torina in supporting roles.

Best friends Elinor "Nory" Boxwood-Horace and Reina Carvajal discover that they have magic: Nory can turn into animals and Reina can conjure fire. They enroll at Sage Academy, an elite school that sorts students into Flares, Fluxers, Flyers, Fuzzies and Flickers, and where everyone must follow a code called "the Sage way". At her placement test Reina impresses, while Nory, trying to become a cat, turns into a cat-dragon hybrid. Reina enters the honors Flare class, but Nory is sent to the Upside-Down Magic program for students with irregular powers, whom Headmistress Linda Knightslinger regards as easy prey for Shadow Magic, an evil force that possesses people and turns their magic against others.

Belittled by a more experienced Flare student, Reina finds a book about Shadow Magic and reads a passage on strengthening her powers. Her abilities grow dangerously strong. Her odd new friend Chandra turns out to be Shadow Magic in human form, invisible to everyone else, and she manipulates and possesses Reina. Meanwhile the groundskeeper Budd Skriff, who teaches the program, reveals that he is an upside-down Fuzzy who can communicate with animals only by singing, and encourages his students to control their unusual gifts rather than force them into normal ones. At the Founders' Day competition Reina becomes a shadowy being that threatens the whole school, and Nory and her classmates rescue her so that she can defeat the Shadow Magic. Afterward the program's students join their magic classes, Budd becomes an official teacher and the Sage way is abolished, though a closing scene hints that Shadow Magic has not been fully vanquished.

Principal photography took place on Vancouver Island, with Shawnigan Lake School standing in for Sage Academy. The film premiered on Disney Channel on July 31, 2020, came out on DVD that November and later streamed on Disney+. LaughingPlace.com gave it four out of five, calling it predictable and derivative but enjoyable for young viewers.

documents.title: Rurouni Kenshin: The Beginning
documents.original_title: るろうに剣心 最終章 The Beginning
documents.tagline: This is how it ends, this is where it began.
documents.overview: Before he was a protector, Kenshin was a fearsome assassin known as Battosai. But when he meets gentle Tomoe Yukishiro, a beautiful young woman who carries a huge burden in her heart, his life will change forever.
documents.plot:
Rurouni Kenshin: The Beginning (Japanese: るろうに剣心 最終章 The Beginning) is a 2021 Japanese jidaigeki action film written and directed by Keishi Ōtomo and based on Nobuhiro Watsuki's manga Rurouni Kenshin. The fifth and final installment of the live-action film series and a prequel to the earlier films, it depicts Himura Kenshin's origins as the feared assassin known as Hitokiri Battōsai and his relationship with Yukishiro Tomoe. Takeru Satoh stars as Kenshin, with Kasumi Arimura as Tomoe, Issey Takahashi, Nijiro Murakami and Masanobu Ando. Produced alongside Rurouni Kenshin: The Final, which opened two months earlier, it was released in Japan by Warner Bros. Pictures on 4 June 2021 and later streamed internationally on Netflix.

In Kyoto during the Bakumatsu period, as revolutionary forces seek to overthrow the Tokugawa shogunate, the young swordsman Himura Kenshin serves the Chōshū clan as an assassin under its leader, Katsura Kogorō, working with the clan's agent Iizuka. During one killing, a dying bodyguard leaves a cross-shaped scar on Kenshin's cheek. One evening at a tavern, Kenshin intervenes when self-proclaimed revolutionaries harass a woman named Yukishiro Tomoe. He is then attacked by an assassin, whom he kills, and finds Tomoe watching him in the aftermath.

Kenshin takes Tomoe back to the inn that serves as a hideout for Chōshū revolutionaries, where she decides to stay and work. Her quiet questions about why he kills unsettle his convictions, and Katsura wonders how she will affect him. During the Ikedaya incident of 1864, when the Shinsengumi police raid a gathering of rebels, Kenshin rushes to rescue Katsura but is delayed by the Shinsengumi captain Okita Sōji. With the Chōshū forced into hiding, Kenshin and Tomoe retreat to a farmhouse in the countryside, posing as a married couple, and gradually fall in love. Tomoe, however, hides a painful connection to one of the men Kenshin has killed, and the shogunate's secret agents are closing in, setting Kenshin on a tragic path that explains the scar he bears and his later vow never to kill again.

The film opened at number one at the Japanese box office, with Rurouni Kenshin: The Final in second place, making it the first franchise to hold the top two spots in the same weekend. It grossed over $21 million in Japan and was praised by critics, including Anime News Network, for its action choreography and emotional weight.

documents.title: The Deep House
documents.tagline: Breathe while you still can.
documents.overview: While diving in a remote French lake, a couple of YouTubers who specialise in underwater exploration videos discover a house submerged in the deep waters. What was initially a unique finding soon turns into a nightmare when they discover that the house was the scene of atrocious crimes. Trapped, with their oxygen reserves falling dangerously, they realise the worst is yet to come: they are not alone in the house.
documents.plot:
The Deep House is a 2021 English-language French supernatural horror film written and directed by Julien Maury and Alexandre Bustillo. James Jagger and Camille Rowe star as Ben and Tina, a young engaged couple from New York who explore reputedly haunted places for their YouTube channel, with Éric Savin as Pierre Montégnac, Alexis Servaes and Anne Claessens as Monsieur and Madame Montégnac, and Carolina Massey as their daughter Sarah.

Travelling through Europe in search of haunted houses to record, Ben and Tina head to south-west France to dive to a sanatorium submerged in an artificial lake, but find the site packed with tourists. A local man, Pierre, offers to guide them instead to a secluded part of the lake in the forest of Chanteloup, which was flooded in 1984 to prevent recurring floods and where, he claims, a mansion lies perfectly preserved. Diving down, they find the house with its contents strangely intact, but soon hear voices and noises, their drone's motion tracker registers movement with no visible cause and their equipment begins to fail. Inside they discover photographs and news cuttings about missing children, satanic symbols and deep scratches by the front door, and behind a door blocked by a crucifix they find two chained corpses in torture masks hanging above a pentagram, beside a room of preserved human remains. When the window they entered through is suddenly bricked up, the couple search desperately for another way out. Ben unmasks the corpses, revealing the Montégnacs, the family who owned the house, and the bodies come to life and pursue them. Separated by a collapsing chimney, Ben finds a family tree showing that Pierre is the Montégnacs' son and lured them there on purpose, before the undead daughter Sarah possesses him. Through Ben and an old film reel, Sarah reveals that her father and Pierre abducted local children as satanic sacrifices before a vengeful mob killed the rest of the family. Tina breaks Ben's possession with a diving knife, but Sarah stabs him to death; Tina escapes up a shaft into the lake, only to run out of air and drown just below the surface. A post-credits scene shows Pierre with two new divers at the lake.

Filmed in Belgium and at lakes in the Occitanie region in 2020, the film was released in France on 30 June 2021 by Apollo Films and in the United States that November by Blumhouse and Epix. It holds a 74% Rotten Tomatoes rating.
production_companies: Tax Shelter du Gouvernement Fédéral Belge

documents.title: The Map of Tiny Perfect Things
documents.original_title: The Map of Tiny Perfect Things
documents.tagline: One day. Infinite possibilities.
documents.overview: The story of two teenagers trapped in an endless time loop who set out to find all the tiny things that make that one day perfect.
documents.plot:
The Map of Tiny Perfect Things is a romantic drama film that explores the complexities of love, time, and human connection. At its core, the movie delves into the idea of finding meaning and purpose in life, particularly for those who feel stuck or uncertain about their place in the world.

Through the story of two high school students, Mark (played by Kyle Allen) and Margaret (played by Britton Robinson), the film examines the concept of time and how it affects our relationships. The movie's unique premise, where time loops repeat over and over, serves as a metaphor for the fragility and beauty of human connection.

As the story unfolds, the characters are forced to confront their own desires, fears, and insecurities, leading to a deeper understanding of themselves and each other. The film also touches on themes of identity, community, and the importance of human relationships in shaping our experiences and perspectives.

Ultimately, The Map of Tiny Perfect Things is a poignant exploration of what it means to find love, acceptance, and belonging in a world that can often feel overwhelming and unpredictable.

documents.title: Till Death
documents.tagline: Vow to survive.
documents.overview: After a romantic evening at their secluded lake house, a woman wakes up handcuffed to her dead husband. Trapped and isolated in the dead of winter, she must fight off hired killers to escape her late spouse's twisted plan.
documents.plot: After a romantic evening at their secluded lake house, a woman wakes up handcuffed to her dead husband. Trapped and isolated in the dead of winter, she must fight off hired killers to escape her late spouse's twisted plan.

documents.title: Offering to the Storm
documents.overview: Inspector Amaia Salazar confronts the origins of her nightmares as she unfolds the darkest secrets of the Baztan valley. Part 3 in the Baztan Trilogy.
documents.plot:
Offering to the Storm (Spanish: Ofrenda a la tormenta) is a 2020 Spanish crime thriller directed by Fernando González Molina and written by Luiso Berdejo and Dolores Redondo, based on Redondo's novel. It is the third and final installment of the Baztán Trilogy, following The Invisible Guardian (2017) and The Legacy of the Bones (2019). Marta Etura reprises her role as police inspector Amaia Salazar, with Leonardo Sbaraglia as Judge Markina, Carlos Librado, Imanol Arias, Paco Tous and Ana Wagener. Netflix released the film in July 2020.

Amaia Salazar, a detective with Spain's regional police in Navarre, is still haunted by the events of the previous films, including the disappearance of her mentally disturbed mother, Rosario, who once tried to kill her, and by the nightmares rooted in her childhood in the Baztán valley. When a baby girl dies suddenly in Elizondo in circumstances that appear to be a case of sudden infant death syndrome, Amaia notices disturbing details: the child's grandmother claims that a demon was responsible, and marks on the body suggest that she was suffocated.

Investigating the case, Amaia discovers a series of similar deaths of infants throughout the region over several decades. The trail leads her to a secret network carrying out ritual sacrifices of babies in the name of Inguma, a demon from Basque mythology said to steal the breath of sleeping people. Its members believe that such offerings bring them power and fortune. As the investigation draws her deeper into the history of the cult, Amaia realizes that the case is connected to her own family and to the forces that have pursued her since childhood. She must also face uncomfortable truths about Judge Markina, with whom she has developed a close relationship, and confront the question of what really happened to her mother, while her own young son may be in danger.

The film received mixed reviews. Critics considered it an acceptable conclusion to the trilogy, praising Etura's performance, the atmospheric landscapes of the Baztán valley and the technical quality of the production, but faulted its convoluted screenplay, rushed storytelling and anticlimactic ending.

documents.title: Have a Good Trip: Adventures in Psychedelics
documents.original_title: Have a Good Trip: Adventures in Psychedelics
documents.overview: Celebrities recall their most mind-bending trips via animations, reenactments and more in this comedic documentary exploring the story of psychedelics.
documents.plot:
Have a Good Trip: Adventures in Psychedelics is a 2020 American comedic documentary written and directed by the Emmy-winning writer and producer Donick Cary and hosted by Nick Offerman. Mixing interviews with animation and comic re-enactments, it gathers celebrities who recount their most memorable experiences with hallucinogenic drugs, told with humor and candor, while also touching on the history of psychedelics and their potential role in treating conditions like depression and anxiety.

The interviewees include Sarah Silverman, Adam Scott, Rosie Perez, Adam Horovitz, A$AP Rocky, Anthony Bourdain, Ben Stiller, Bill Kreutzmann, Carrie Fisher, Natasha Lyonne, Lewis Black, Nick Kroll, Reggie Watts, Shepard Fairey, Sting and Deepak Chopra, alongside Paul Scheer, Rob Corddry, Will Forte, Haley Joel Osment, Thomas Lennon and David Cross. The stories range from euphoric to frightening and absurd, and many are brought to life through animated sequences and staged re-creations. The film is among the final screen appearances of Fred Willard, Anthony Bourdain and Carrie Fisher, whose Beverly Hills home, which she called the "acid house", served as one of the locations.

Cary conceived the project in 2009 at the Nantucket Film Festival, where he, Stiller and Fisher Stevens swapped stories about hallucinogens over dinner and agreed to make a film that would combine anecdotes with re-enactments and animation. What began as a collection of funny stories grew into a work aiming to open a serious and balanced conversation about psychedelics. Over eleven years, fitting around celebrities' schedules, Cary conducted more than a hundred interviews, far more than made the final cut. The film was financed by Mike Rosenstein's Sunset Rose Pictures and Cary's Sugarshack 2000, with support from Stiller's Red Hour, and its score was provided by the indie rock band Yo La Tengo.

It was set to premiere at South by Southwest in March 2020, but the festival was canceled because of the COVID-19 pandemic, and the film instead debuted on Netflix on 11 May 2020, remaining in the service's top ten for over a month. Reviews were mixed: Rotten Tomatoes reported a 58% approval rating, with critics finding it entertaining but shallow, and Metacritic gave it 44 out of 100. Some reviewers valued its attention to medical research into psychedelics, while others felt its comic approach undercut the subject.

documents.title: 13: The Musical
documents.tagline: Raise your voice. Even if it cracks.
documents.overview: After moving from New York City to Indiana, a 12 year old navigates his parents' divorce, his impending bar mitzvah and his new school's social circles.
documents.plot:
13: The Musical is a 2022 American musical coming-of-age comedy-drama film directed by Tamra Davis and written by Robert Horn, based on the 2007 stage musical 13 by Horn, Jason Robert Brown and Dan Elish. Eli Golden stars as a boy preparing for his bar mitzvah, leading a young ensemble cast with Debra Messing, Rhea Perlman, Josh Peck and Peter Hermann. After an earlier attempt by CBS Films, Netflix announced its version in 2019 and released it on August 12, 2022.

After his parents separate, twelve-year-old Evan Goldman moves with his mother, Jessica, from New York City to his grandmother Ruth's home in the small town of Walkerton, Indiana. Unhappy at leaving his father, his friends and his rabbi behind, Evan resolves to become popular quickly and to make his upcoming bar mitzvah the biggest party his new school has ever seen. He befriends his neighbor Patrice and her friend Archie, who uses a wheelchair, but he is soon more interested in winning acceptance from the popular crowd.

The popular group is led by the football star Brett and the cheerleader Kendra, who like each other, while Kendra's best friend, Lucy, secretly wants Brett for herself and resents always being second. To win the group's favor, Evan offers to arrange a movie date for Brett and Kendra, but Lucy threatens to persuade everyone to skip his bar mitzvah unless he stops them from kissing. Evan enlists Archie, who has a crush on Kendra, to sit between the couple at the theater. Patrice, hurt that Evan has been using her and Archie, tells Kendra's overprotective mother, who arrives and ruins the date. Brett's friends blame Evan, Archie and Patrice turn away from him, and Lucy seizes the moment to kiss Brett and make him her boyfriend.

With everything falling apart, Evan reconciles with his mother and talks with his father, who encourages him to own up to his mistakes. He apologizes to Patrice and Archie and helps Brett repair his relationship with Kendra, after which Brett leaves Lucy and Lucy makes amends with Kendra. On the day of his bar mitzvah, Patrice forgives Evan and comes with Archie and the rest of the class, and the celebration brings them all together. Jessica returns to her writing, and Evan settles into his new home.

The film received mixed reviews; Rotten Tomatoes reported 60% approval and Metacritic a score of 57.

documents.title: American Underdog
documents.tagline: Some dreams become destiny.
documents.overview: The true story of Kurt Warner, who went from a stockboy at a grocery store to a two-time NFL MVP, Super Bowl champion, and Hall of Fame quarterback.
documents.plot: The true story of Kurt Warner, who went from a stockboy at a grocery store to a two-time NFL MVP, Super Bowl champion, and Hall of Fame quarterback.

documents.title: Maggie Simpson in Playdate with Destiny
documents.original_title: Maggie Simpson in Playdate with Destiny
documents.overview: It seemed like just another day at the park for Maggie Simpson. But when Maggie faces playground peril, a heroic young baby whisks her from danger and steals her heart.
documents.plot: When Maggie Simpson is rescued by a cute young baby from playground peril, it's girl meets boy, girl loses boy, guess what happens next?

documents.title: A Christmas Gift from Bob
documents.tagline: A true tail of Christmas spirit.
documents.overview: James Bowen finds himself the target of an animal welfare investigation that threatens to take away his beloved cat, Bob, at Christmas.
documents.plot:
A Christmas Gift from Bob is a heartwarming holiday film that explores the complexities of grief, love, and redemption. The movie delves into the emotional journey of Bob, a man struggling to cope with the loss of his wife, as he navigates the challenges of the holiday season.

At its core, A Christmas Gift from Bob is a poignant exploration of the human experience, tackling themes of sorrow, longing, and the resilience of the human spirit. The film masterfully weaves together elements of drama, comedy, and romance, creating a narrative that is both authentic and relatable.

Through Bob's character, the movie sheds light on the often-overlooked struggles of those who have experienced loss, highlighting the importance of human connection and the power of love to heal even the deepest wounds. The film also touches on the theme of second chances, suggesting that it's never too late to rediscover oneself and find new purpose in life.

Ultimately, A Christmas Gift from Bob is a beautifully crafted story about finding hope and joy in the darkest of times, reminding us that even in our most vulnerable moments, we are capable of growth, transformation, and ultimately, redemption.

documents.title: The Banshees of Inisherin
documents.tagline: Everything was fine yesterday.
documents.overview: Two lifelong friends find themselves at an impasse when one abruptly ends their relationship, with alarming consequences for both of them.
documents.plot:
The Banshees of Inisherin is a 2022 black comedy-drama film written and directed by Martin McDonagh, produced by Element Pictures and Blueprint Pictures.

The story takes place on the fictional island of Inisherin off the west coast of Ireland. The film follows the complex relationship between two lifelong friends, Pádraic Súilleabháin (Colin Farrell), a simple-minded but kind-hearted fisherman, and Colm Doherty (Brendan Gleeson), a talented fiddle player.

The film begins with an uneventful day in the lives of the island's residents. However, when Colm suddenly tells Pádraic that he is ending their friendship due to Pádraic's inability to appreciate his art, the situation escalates into chaos. The two men engage in a series of escalating pranks and one-upmanship, with no clear resolution or end in sight.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Colm's decision to cut ties with Pádraic is motivated by a deep-seated frustration with his friend's lack of intellectual curiosity and emotional depth. Meanwhile, Pádraic struggles to cope with the loss of their friendship and finds himself increasingly isolated on the island.

Throughout the film, McDonagh explores themes of loneliness, creativity, and the complexities of male relationships. The characters' interactions are often humorous and absurd, but also poignant and emotionally charged.

The Banshees of Inisherin features a talented ensemble cast, including Kerry Condon as Siobhan, Pádraic's on-again, off-again love interest, and Barry Keoghan as Dominic Kearney, a young man who becomes embroiled in the conflict between Colm and Pádraic.

The film received widespread critical acclaim for its original storytelling, strong performances, and nuanced exploration of complex themes. It was nominated for several awards, including seven Academy Awards.

documents.title: A Loud House Christmas
documents.overview: Lincoln Loud gears up for the ultimate Christmas, until he finds out that most of his sisters have plans to be elsewhere for the big day. Determined to remind his family that they all need to be together, Lincoln and his best friend Clyde McBride embark on a mission to preserve the family’s holiday traditions.
documents.plot:
A Loud House Christmas is a 2021 animated television special produced by Nickelodeon Productions. The special serves as a holiday-themed episode of the popular animated series The Loud House.

The story begins with the Loud family preparing for their annual Christmas celebration. However, this year's festivities are disrupted when Lori, the mother, announces that she has been invited to spend Christmas with her wealthy and estranged father, Jack, in his luxurious mansion. The rest of the family is disappointed by this news, as they had been looking forward to spending the holiday together.

As the day progresses, the Louds try to make the most of their Christmas celebration despite Lori's absence. Meanwhile, Jack invites Lori to join him for a special Christmas dinner at his mansion, where he reveals that he has been working on a surprise gift for her.

Upon arriving at Jack's mansion, Lori is surprised by the lavish decorations and gifts, but she also feels uneasy about being there without her family. However, as she spends more time with Jack, she begins to reconnect with him and appreciate his efforts to make up for past mistakes.

As Christmas Eve approaches, the Louds gather together to celebrate the holiday, despite Lori's absence. They share stories, sing carols, and enjoy each other's company, showing that family is truly what matters most during the holidays.

In the end, Jack surprises Lori with a special gift - a customized, high-tech smart home system for their own house. The gift is a thoughtful gesture, demonstrating Jack's efforts to make amends and improve his relationship with his daughter. The Louds also spend quality time together, enjoying each other's company and creating new memories.

Throughout the special, the characters' personalities shine through, adding to the humor and heartwarming moments. The story emphasizes the importance of family, forgiveness, and making amends during the holiday season.

documents.title: The Occupant
documents.overview: An unemployed executive is forced to sell his apartment. When he discovers that he still has the keys, he becomes obsessed with the family that now lives there and decides to recover the life he has lost, at any price.
documents.plot:
The Occupant (Spanish: Hogar, "home") is a 2020 Spanish psychological thriller written and directed by brothers David and Àlex Pastor. Javier Gutiérrez stars as an unemployed advertising executive who, forced to give up his luxurious apartment, uses an old set of keys to infiltrate the lives of the family who move in, with Mario Casas, Bruna Cusí and Ruth Díaz in the main supporting roles.

Once highly successful, Javier Muñoz can no longer find work, and he, his wife Marga and their son leave their apartment for a modest flat. Discovering that he still has a key, he secretly enters his old home and learns about the new tenants, Tomás, his wife Lara and their daughter Mónica. Finding that Tomás is a recovering alcoholic, Javier turns up at his support group posing as one himself, asks Tomás to be his sponsor, and wins an invitation to dinner. Javier learns that Tomás owes his job to Lara's father's company and that the couple often argue. He stages a drunken car crash, lets Tomás spill gin on himself while helping, and secretly sends himself a damning email from Tomás's phone. Damián, a groundsman who has noticed Javier's comings and goings, blackmails him into stealing Mónica's underwear and later planting a camera in her room. When Lara smells gin on Tomás and asks Javier to stay away, he shows her the email as proof that her husband has relapsed. Tomás, realising he has been played, beats Javier, while Damián is caught when a leaf blower Javier sabotaged explodes. Tended by Lara, Javier hints that Tomás is violent and gives her a pepper spray he has laced with peanut oil, knowing Tomás has a deadly peanut allergy. When the enraged Tomás comes home to confront Lara, she sprays him and he goes into anaphylactic shock; Javier arrives to "help", swaps the spray and suffocates him. Months later Javier has taken Tomás's job and married Lara. When Marga discovers the peanut oil and threatens to go to the police, he threatens to spend their son's savings on lawyers, and she backs down, leaving him content in his reclaimed home.

Gutiérrez plays Javier, with Casas as Tomás, Cusí as Lara, Díaz as Marga and David Ramírez as Damián. Planned to premiere at the Málaga Film Festival in March 2020 before the event was postponed by the COVID-19 pandemic, it was released on Netflix on March 25, 2020. Critics praised Gutiérrez's performance but found the character development meandering, giving it 61% on Rotten Tomatoes.

documents.title: MexZombies
documents.overview: A group of teenagers must face a zombie apocalypse, and help reestablish order.
documents.plot:
MexZombies is a 2022 Mexican horror comedy directed by Chava Cartas and written by Luis Gamboa and Santiago Limón. Iñaki Godoy stars as Tavo, with Marcelo Barceló as Cronos, Roberta Damián as Ana, Luciana Vale as Rex, Vincent Michael Webb as Johnny, Daniel Tovar and Bárbara de Regil as a dangerous drug-cartel boss known as Jefe Vargas. Produced by Draco Films, the film was shot in Durango in 2019. A cinema release planned for 2020 was cancelled because of the COVID-19 pandemic, and after screenings at genre festivals such as Sitges, the Brussels International Fantastic Film Festival and Toronto After Dark, it premiered on the streaming service ViX+ on 26 October 2022.

During the Day of the Dead and Halloween festivities, Tavo, a teenager with a talent for parkour and a natural instinct for leadership, climbs over the wall that separates his working-class neighborhood from Sierra Linda, an exclusive gated community in Mexico City. Inside he meets up with his best friend Jacobo, a film-obsessed nerd and devoted fan of Guillermo del Toro who insists on being called "Cronos." Tavo also hopes to catch the attention of Ana, a young social media activist on whom both friends have a crush.

As the residents prepare for a themed party, the boys witness the first signs of a zombie outbreak. The father of the community's caretaker, who died the night before, has been injected with an experimental substance that brings him back to life as a flesh-eating zombie, and the infection begins to spread among the costumed partygoers, many of whom mistake the creatures for part of the celebration. Realizing that the outbreak must not escape the gated community, Tavo and Cronos join forces with Ana; Rex, a tough, outspoken girl; and Johnny, an American exchange student baffled by Mexican customs. To survive, the teenagers are even forced into an uneasy alliance with Jefe Vargas, as they fight to contain the zombies and save the country.

The film combines teenage coming-of-age comedy with gory zombie action and social satire about class divisions in Mexico, and it makes frequent references to genre classics such as Zombieland. Critic Carlos Andrés Mendiola described it as pure entertainment, praising its understanding of the genre's conventions and de Regil's comic performance, while audience reactions were sharply divided.

documents.title: Zone 414
documents.tagline: What hides in the city of robots?
documents.overview: In the near future on a colony of state-of-the-art robots, a private investigator is hired by the colony's creator to bring his missing daughter home.
documents.plot:
Zone 414 is a 2021 American tech-noir thriller directed by Andrew Baird in his feature debut and written by Bryan Edward Hill. Guy Pearce stars as private investigator David Carmichael, with Matilda Lutz, Jonathan Aris and Travis Fimmel; Fimmel had originally been announced in the lead before Pearce replaced him and he moved to a supporting part.

Zone 414 is a walled city populated by sophisticated humanoid androids who provide companionship and sex to wealthy clients. It is run by the company of the robots' inventor, Marlon Veidt, and his brother Joseph, a psychologist. When Marlon's adult daughter, Melissa, disappears inside the zone, he hires David, a former police detective and recovering alcoholic forced off the force after a hostage situation in which his partner and a criminal died, and still haunted by his wife's suicide. The company tests him by ordering him to shoot a pleading woman, whom he correctly deduces is an android, and Joseph profiles him for discretion and willingness to bend the law. Marlon wants Melissa found without the police, fearing that news of a missing person would threaten the zone's regulatory exemptions.

David teams up with Jane, an advanced, self-aware robot whose feelings have grown beyond the emotions her work requires, and who fears a stalker leaving threatening messages. The pimp Royale denies that clients pay to terrorize robots, but says Melissa spent time in a rough part of the city pretending to be an android. As the threats against Jane continue, the pair find Melissa hanged in an empty boatyard warehouse. When David collects his fee, he goads Joseph into admitting that he is Jane's stalker and that he killed Melissa after she caught him torturing and destroying androids. Joseph tries to disable Jane with a handheld device, but she breaks free, and David hands her his gun so she can shoot him dead. A grieving Marlon builds an android replica of his daughter, and the company pressures David to declare the zone safe; in return for his silence, Jane is allowed to leave, and David meets her outside with papers that let her live in the outside world.

Shot in Northern Ireland in February 2020, the film was released in U.S. theaters and on VOD by Saban Films on September 3, 2021. Critics were largely negative, giving it 17% on Rotten Tomatoes and 36 on Metacritic.

documents.title: Shadow in the Cloud
documents.tagline: Every mission has its demons.
documents.overview: A WWII pilot traveling with top secret documents on a B-17 Flying Fortress encounters an evil presence on board the flight.
documents.plot:
Shadow in the Cloud is a 2020 American war drama film directed by Chris Storer and written by Chris Storer and Josh Appignanesi. The movie stars Anna Kendrick as Second Lieutenant Maude "Maude" Gunner, a young and ambitious pilot in the United States Army Air Forces during World War II.

The story begins with Maude, a talented but rebellious pilot, who is assigned to fly a B-17 bomber on a mission over Germany. As she prepares for takeoff, she meets her crew, including her co-pilot, Captain Dan Bradley (played by Alden Ehrenreich), and the rest of the team.

As they embark on their perilous journey, Maude struggles with her own demons, including her complicated relationship with her father, who was a pilot in World War I. She also faces sexism and misogyny from her male colleagues, who doubt her abilities as a female pilot.

The crew encounters various challenges during the flight, including bad weather, mechanical issues, and enemy fire. Maude's skills and determination are put to the test as she navigates these obstacles and proves herself as a capable pilot.

However, things take a dramatic turn when Maude discovers that one of her crew members is hiding a dark secret: he has been having an affair with a German woman, who is now on board the plane. The situation becomes increasingly tense as Maude tries to keep the peace while also protecting her crew and completing their mission.

As they near the end of their journey, the crew faces a final, desperate challenge when the plane is attacked by enemy fighters. In the heat of the battle, Maude makes a heroic sacrifice to save her crew, giving up her own life to ensure their survival.

The movie ends with a somber reflection on Maude's bravery and selflessness, as well as the sacrifices made by women during wartime. Despite its dark themes, Shadow in the Cloud is an inspiring story of female empowerment and determination, showcasing Anna Kendrick's impressive acting range and physical abilities as a pilot.

Overall, Shadow in the Cloud is a gripping and emotional war drama that explores the complexities of human relationships and the challenges faced by women in male-dominated fields during wartime.

documents.title: Sonic the Hedgehog 2
documents.tagline: Welcome to the next level.
documents.overview: After settling in Green Hills, Sonic is eager to prove he has what it takes to be a true hero. His test comes when Dr. Robotnik returns, this time with a new partner, Knuckles, in search for an emerald that has the power to destroy civilizations. Sonic teams up with his own sidekick, Tails, and together they embark on a globe-trotting journey to find the emerald before it falls into the wrong hands.
documents.plot:
Sonic the Hedgehog 2 is a 2022 American live-action/animated musical comedy-adventure film directed by Jeff Fowler and written by Pat Casey, Josh Miller, and John Whittington. The movie serves as a sequel to the 2020 film Sonic the Hedgehog.

The story takes place after the events of the first film, where Sonic (Ben Schwartz) is living in Green Hills with Tom Wachowski (James Marsden). However, their peaceful life is disrupted by Dr. Robotnik's (Jim Carrey) latest scheme: to steal the Master Emerald from Mobius and use its power to conquer the world.

Meanwhile, a new villain emerges in the form of Knuckles the Echidna (Idris Elba), who is tasked with protecting the Master Emerald on Angel Island. Sonic and Tom team up once again to stop Dr. Robotnik's plan, but they soon discover that Knuckles is not what he seems.

As Sonic navigates his new friendship with Knuckles, he also learns about the history of the Master Emerald and the ancient bond between the echidnas and the island. The movie features a mix of action, humor, and heartwarming moments as Sonic and Tom face off against Dr. Robotnik's robotic army.

Throughout the film, Idris Elba brings his signature charm to Knuckles, making him a compelling and complex character. His chemistry with Ben Schwartz is undeniable, and their banter adds a lot of comedic relief to the movie.

The movie also explores themes of identity, friendship, and the importance of understanding and respecting different cultures. The animation in the film is stunning, blending seamlessly with the live-action elements to create a visually stunning world that fans of the franchise will love.

Overall, Sonic the Hedgehog 2 is an entertaining and action-packed sequel that expands on the characters and world introduced in the first film. With its blend of humor, heart, and excitement, it's sure to delight both old and new fans of the Sonic franchise.

documents.title: PAW Patrol: The Movie
documents.tagline: Our fate is in their paws.
documents.overview: Ryder and the pups are called to Adventure City to stop Mayor Humdinger from turning the bustling metropolis into a state of chaos.
documents.plot:
PAW Patrol: The Movie is a 2021 computer-animated adventure comedy film based on the popular children's television series of the same name. The movie follows the PAW Patrol team, led by Ryder, as they embark on a mission to save Adventure City from an evil plot.

The story begins with the PAW Patrol team preparing for their annual summer training session at Lookout, their headquarters. However, things take a turn when Mayor Humdinger of Foggy Bottom, a rival city, steals the magical Golden Ticket, which is the key to unlocking the secrets of Adventure City's legendary treasure.

Ryder and the PAW Patrol team set out on a mission to retrieve the Golden Ticket and save their city from Mayor Humdinger's evil plans. Along the way, they meet new friends, including a young boy named Kai, who becomes an honorary member of the team.

As the adventure unfolds, the PAW Patrol team faces various obstacles and challenges, including navigating through treacherous terrain, avoiding danger, and working together to overcome their differences. The movie features plenty of action-packed sequences, humor, and heartwarming moments as the team learns valuable lessons about teamwork, empathy, and believing in themselves.

Throughout the movie, the characters' personalities shine through, with Marshall's bravery, Chase's speed, Skye's agility, Rubble's creativity, Rocky's strength, Zuma's aquatic skills, and Everest's intelligence all on display. The movie also explores themes of friendship, community, and the importance of working together to achieve a common goal.

Overall, PAW Patrol: The Movie is a fun, entertaining film that is sure to delight both children and adults alike. With its colorful animation, engaging storyline, and lovable characters, it's a must-see for fans of the popular TV series.

documents.title: Tad - The Explorer and the Emerald Tablet
documents.overview: Tad accidentally unleashes an ancient spell, endangering the lives of his friends Mummy, Jeff, and Belzoni. With everyone against him and only helped by Sara, he sets off on an adventure to end the Curse of the Mummy.
documents.plot:
Tad, the Lost Explorer and the Emerald Tablet (Spanish: Tadeo Jones 3: La tabla esmeralda) is a 2022 Spanish computer-animated adventure comedy directed by Enrique Gato and written by Josep Gatell and Manuel Burque. The third feature in the series about the accident-prone amateur archaeologist Tad Stones, it follows Tad the Lost Explorer and the Secret of King Midas (2017). The Spanish voice cast includes Óscar Barberán as Tad, along with Michelle Jenner and Alexandra Jiménez. Paramount Pictures distributed it worldwide, opening it in France on 24 August 2022 and in Spain two days later.

After Tad discovers an Egyptian sarcophagus and a pendant at a temple site in Mexico, he is fired from archaeology, and the sarcophagus is sent to a museum in Chicago. Professor Victoria Moon tells him the legend of the Emerald Tablet, created by Hermes Trismegistus to control magic; Hermes tried to use it to overthrow the pharaoh Cheops, who hid it away. Napoleon later found the tablet but returned it, though his archaeologist Dominique Vivant Denon left clues to its location, and Victoria holds his diary. When Tad sneaks into the museum with his friend Mummy and his pets Jeff and Belzoni to open the sarcophagus, the three are struck by a curse, which Tad realises is linked to the tablet.

The trail leads the group to Denon's secret study beneath the Louvre, where they meet a mummy named Ra and persuade her to help, while being chased by Agent Ramírez and his men. They discover that Mummy turns into a monstrous blend of animals when he gets upset. In Aswan, Tad recovers a hidden key, and with his friend Sara he uses it to reveal a map placing the tablet inside the Great Pyramid. Victoria then reveals that she has been taken over by the tablet's power, traps the group and sets off for the pyramid. Captured and jailed, Tad tearfully admits that he is a danger to everyone and doubts that he is a real archaeologist, but Mummy's transformation helps them escape.

In the pyramid they find that Victoria already holds the tablet, and she corrupts Mummy into a monstrous beast. In the struggle, the tablet's power turns back time and Tad destroys it, lifting the curse and restoring his friends. Freed, the group set off in search of the treasure of King Pakal.

The film topped the Spanish box office on its opening weekend and drew positive notices from Spanish critics, with Cinemanía praising its remarkable action scenes as a technical showcase for Spanish animation.

documents.title: Creed III
documents.tagline: You can't run from your past.
documents.overview: After dominating the boxing world, Adonis Creed has been thriving in both his career and family life. When a childhood friend and former boxing prodigy, Damien Anderson, resurfaces after serving a long sentence in prison, he is eager to prove that he deserves his shot in the ring. The face-off between former friends is more than just a fight. To settle the score, Adonis must put his future on the line to battle Damien - a fighter who has nothing to lose.
documents.plot:
Creed III is a 2023 American sports drama film directed by Michael B. Jordan in his directorial debut, the sequel to Creed II (2018) and the ninth film in the Rocky franchise. Written by Keenan Coogler and Zach Baylin from a story they developed with Ryan Coogler, it stars Jordan as retired boxing champion Adonis Creed and Jonathan Majors as his childhood friend Damian "Dame" Anderson, with Tessa Thompson, Wood Harris, Florian Munteanu and Phylicia Rashad.

In 2002, teenage Donnie sneaks out with his friend Dame, a Golden Gloves champion, to watch him win an underground fight in Los Angeles. On the way home, Donnie impulsively attacks a man named Leon outside a liquor store; Dame is arrested while Donnie flees, and the two lose contact. In the present, Donnie has retired from the ring and lives with his wife Bianca and their hearing-impaired daughter Amara, runs a gym with Tony "Little Duke" Evers and promotes the heavyweight champion Felix Chavez. Dame, newly released from prison, asks Donnie to help him resume his career. Donnie takes him on as Chavez's sparring partner, though his aggression alarms the others.

When Chavez's scheduled opponent, Viktor Drago, is attacked at a party, Donnie nominates Dame as the replacement. In his first professional bout, Dame wins the title with dirty tactics, exploiting a shoulder injury he inflicted on Chavez in sparring. Donnie's adoptive mother, Mary-Anne, then reveals the letters Dame wrote him from prison, which she hid, and a photo shows Dame with the inmate who attacked Drago. Confronted, Dame admits he manipulated Donnie and accuses him of abandoning him. After Mary-Anne's death, Donnie tells Bianca the truth about that night: Leon was the abusive caretaker of their group home, and Dame pulled a gun to save Donnie from Leon's friends. Publicly taunted, Donnie comes out of retirement and, after training with Duke and Drago, faces Dame at Dodger Stadium. In a grueling fight, he rises from a knockdown in the final round to knock Dame out and win back the title. Afterward the two men reconcile, each accepting that the past was not the other's fault, and Donnie shadowboxes with Amara in the empty stadium.

Released by MGM in the United States on March 3, 2023, Creed III opened at number one and grossed $276.1 million worldwide on a $75 million budget, the highest-grossing Creed film. Critics praised Jordan's direction and Majors's performance; Rotten Tomatoes reported 89% approval and Metacritic a score of 73.

documents.title: We Bare Bears: The Movie
documents.tagline: FUGITIVES, FRIENDS AND FOREVER BROTHERS.
documents.overview: When Grizz, Panda, and Ice Bear's love of food trucks and viral videos get out of hand, the brothers are now chased away from their home and embark on a trip to Canada, where they can live in peace.
documents.plot:
We Bare Bears: The Movie is a 2020 animated film produced by Cartoon Network Studios. The movie follows the story of the three bear siblings, Grizz, Panda, and Ice Bear, as they embark on a journey to find their father.

The movie begins with the bears living in their treehouse in the forest, where they spend most of their time trying to fit in with human society. However, their efforts are constantly thwarted by their own unique personalities and quirks. Grizz is a laid-back and easy-going bear who loves food, Panda is a sensitive and emotional bear who wears a mask to hide his feelings, and Ice Bear is a stoic and introverted bear who rarely speaks.

One day, the bears receive an invitation from their father, who has been missing for years, inviting them to meet him at a music festival in the city. The bears are overjoyed and excited to finally meet their father, but they soon realize that he's not what they expected. Their father is a famous musician who has abandoned his family years ago, and the bears are left feeling confused and hurt.

Despite their initial disappointment, the bears decide to follow their father to the music festival, where they become embroiled in a plot by a rival musician, who seeks to sabotage their father's performance. Along the way, the bears learn valuable lessons about family, love, and acceptance, and they begin to understand that their father's past mistakes do not define him as a person.

As the story unfolds, the bears face various challenges and obstacles, including run-ins with rival musicians, treacherous terrain, and their own personal struggles. However, through it all, they remain loyal and supportive of each other, using their unique skills and strengths to overcome every hurdle.

In the end, the bears finally meet their father, who has been hiding a secret that changes everything. The movie ends on a heartwarming note, with the bears learning to forgive and accept their father for who he is, and finding a new sense of purpose and belonging together as a family.

Throughout the movie, the animation is vibrant and colorful, with plenty of humor and wit. The characters are well-developed and relatable, and the story is full of heart and emotion. Overall, We Bare Bears: The Movie is a delightful and entertaining film that explores themes of family, love, and acceptance in a way that's both fun and meaningful.

documents.title: Marmaduke
documents.tagline: Man's biggest friend.
documents.overview: Great Dane Marmaduke epitomizes the overgrown lapdog, with an irascible streak and a penchant for mischief that is tempered with a deep sense of love and responsibility for his human family, the Winslows. The new animation is set in the world of elite dog shows, rife divas, rivalries and slapstick comedy.
documents.plot:
Marmaduke is a 2022 animated comedy directed by Mark Dippé, with Phil Nibbelink, Youngki Lee and Matt Whelan as co-directors, based on Paul and Brad Anderson's comic strip. Pete Davidson voices the title Great Dane, with J.K. Simmons as his rival, the Afghan Hound Zeus, David Koechner as Phil Winslow, Brian Hull as dog trainer Guy Hilton and Julie Nathanson as Dottie Winslow.

Phil and Dottie live in Maryland with their children, Barbara and Billy, and their clumsy but good-natured Great Dane, Marmaduke. At Billy's birthday party, Marmaduke cannonballs from the second floor into the pool, unleashing a tidal wave, and Barbara's video of the stunt goes viral. It catches the eye of the celebrated trainer Guy, who offers to turn Marmaduke into a champion show dog, and the hesitant family agrees once Phil learns of a $1 million top prize. After early resistance, Marmaduke starts to improve, and Guy enters him in a local show as a test. There Zeus tempts him into eating before the event, and the bloated Marmaduke fills the arena with noxious gas before relieving himself in the winner's trophy. Humiliated, Guy quits, and Marmaduke runs away.

On the street, Marmaduke rescues the family cat, Carlos, from an intersection, and with Carlos's encouragement he travels around the world performing heroic feats, which persuades Guy to take him back for the World Dog Championship. There he meets Zeus again along with rivals including the corgi Juan Pedro, the pink poodle Shantrelle and the Staffordshire Bull Terrier Vinnie. After the second of three challenges, Marmaduke lands on Guy, sending him to the hospital, so the family steps in as trainers, and for the final round Marmaduke and Billy perform a crowd-pleasing cowboy act with Carlos. Zeus is declared the winner, but Marmaduke exposes the rigged scores, and Zeus is disqualified. When Zeus tries to seize the trophy, he topples a camera platform, and Marmaduke is struck while saving his family and the cameraman. Feared dead, he survives, and the family lives happily.

Announced in 2017, with Davidson, Simmons and Koechner cast in 2018, the film was animated by Dippé's WonderWorld Studios. Planned for 2019 and then 2020 before COVID-19 delays, it was acquired by Netflix, which released it in the United States on May 6, 2022, while SC Films handled other territories. Critics panned it, with 0% on Rotten Tomatoes, and Davidson received a Golden Raspberry nomination for Worst Actor.

documents.title: Pompo the Cinephile
documents.original_title: 映画大好きポンポさん
documents.tagline: Bright lights. Big dreams. No experience.
documents.overview: Operating out of the movie capital "Nyallywood," Pompo has been shooting one B-grade entertainment flick after another that anyone would enjoy. One day, Pompo's "movie buff" assistant Gene spots a new script written by Pompo and is moved by its exquisite story. In a fit of passion, he proclaims, "I want to see this as a finished work in theaters as soon as possible!"  However, Pompo tells him, "So you shoot this film." Thus, Gene takes on his first directing gig. Meanwhile, Natalie, an ordinary girl who just arrived in town with movie actress dreams, has been discovered by Pompo...
documents.plot:
Pompo the Cinephile is a 2021 Japanese animated drama film directed by Haruo Sotozaki, produced by Shochiku. The movie takes place in the 1960s and follows the story of Pompo Aditya, a young Indian woman who becomes involved with a Japanese filmmaker.

The film begins with Pompo's arrival in Tokyo, where she is hired as an assistant to the renowned filmmaker, Kōichi Nagai. Pompo is fascinated by Western cinema and has come to Japan to learn from the masters. She quickly befriends Nagai's wife, Yumi, who becomes her confidante.

As Pompo settles into her new life in Tokyo, she begins to work on various film sets, learning the ins and outs of filmmaking from Nagai himself. However, it soon becomes apparent that Nagai is struggling with his own demons, including a troubled marriage and a sense of creative stagnation.

Pompo's presence in Nagai's life has an unexpected effect: she inspires him to take risks and try new things. Together, they embark on a series of filmmaking projects that push the boundaries of Japanese cinema. Pompo's passion for Western films and her own experiences as an outsider bring a fresh perspective to Nagai's work.

Throughout the film, Sotozaki explores themes of cultural exchange, identity, and the power of art to transcend borders. Pompo's character serves as a bridge between East and West, highlighting the complexities of cross-cultural relationships in the 1960s.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Nagai is struggling with his own sense of purpose. He feels stifled by the conventions of traditional Japanese cinema and is desperate to break free from them. Pompo's influence helps him to see the world in a new light, and he begins to experiment with new techniques and styles.

The film's climax features a dramatic turning point: Nagai's latest project is met with critical acclaim, but at a great personal cost. The success comes at the expense of his marriage and his relationships with those around him. Pompo must confront the consequences of her own involvement in Nagai's life and decide whether to stay by his side or forge her own path.

Ultimately, Pompo the Cinephile is a poignant exploration of the human spirit and the power of art to transform lives. The film's beautiful animation, stunning cinematography, and nuanced performances all contribute to a richly textured narrative that lingers long after the credits roll.

documents.title: Centigrade
documents.tagline: Based on chilling true events
documents.overview: A young American couple travel to the arctic mountains of Norway. After pulling over during a snowstorm, they wake up trapped in their SUV, buried underneath layers of snow and ice.
documents.plot:
Centigrade is a 2020 survival thriller directed by Brendan Walsh from a screenplay he wrote with Daley Nixon. Genesis Rodriguez and Vincent Piazza star as Naomi and Matt Ibbotson, an American couple trapped inside their car after it is buried beneath snow and ice in Norway. Nixon's original script was inspired by the real case of Peter Skyllberg, a Swedish man found barely alive in his snowbound car after surviving for two months in sub-zero temperatures. The film was shot in sequence, and both actors lost weight during production. It premiered at the Sidewalk Film Festival on 27 August 2020.

In 2002, Naomi, who is eight months pregnant, and her husband Matt are travelling through the Arctic mountains of Norway. During a heavy snowstorm they pull over to rest, and when they wake they discover that their SUV has been completely encased in snow and ice. The doors will not open, the windows are covered by a thick wall of frozen snow, and they have no way of signalling for help.

As days pass, the couple struggle to survive with only a few snacks, a small supply of water and whatever warmth they can generate. The temperature inside the car falls to dangerous levels, and they face hypothermia, frostbite, dehydration and disturbing hallucinations. In the confined space, tension, mutual blame and long-held secrets about their marriage rise to the surface, but they realise that they will only survive if they work together. After a panic attack, Naomi goes into labour, and Matt helps her deliver a baby girl, whom they name Olivia. Matt, weakened by the cold and his attempts to dig through the window, gives his coat to keep the baby warm. One morning Naomi wakes to find that he has died. Days later, as the snow begins to soften, she must find the strength to break free and carry her newborn daughter through the wilderness in search of help.

Almost the entire film takes place inside the car, making it a two-hander that relies on the performances of its leads and on the claustrophobic atmosphere. The closing captions explain that the snow may have acted like an igloo, trapping heat and protecting the family from the elements.

Centigrade received mixed to negative reviews. On Rotten Tomatoes it holds an approval rating of about 40 percent, with the consensus describing it as a survival thriller largely bereft of thrills that may leave audiences feeling as trapped as its characters, although the performances of Rodriguez and Piazza were praised.

documents.title: Over the Sky
documents.tagline: My feelings for you will change me.
documents.overview: Mio is a girl in high school who slacks off. She and her childhood friend Arata and best friend Madoka spend their after-school days in Ikebukuro hanging out. One day, Madoka tells Mio that she loves Arata, and Mio realizes that she loves Arata, too. But she’s scared of their relationship falling apart and lies, saying she’ll help them. Mio deliberately acts coldly to Arata, and they get into a fight. She decides to work things out with Arata, but gets into a car accident on her way to meet him. She wakes up in a mysterious world. It's the Ikebukuro she knows, but something’s different...
documents.plot:
Over the Sky (Kimi wa Kanata) is a Japanese animated teen fantasy from 2020, written, co-produced and directed by Yoshinobu Sena. Animated by Digital Network Animation, it is set in Ikebukuro. Honoka Matsumoto voices the heroine, Mio Miyamasu, in her first leading role in an animated feature, opposite Toshiki Seto as her childhood friend Arata Kishimo, with Saori Hayami as Kiku-chan and Yui Ogura as Mio's friend Madoka.

Mio and Arata are seventeen-year-old high-school students who have known each other since childhood. Arata tells her that the boundary between the sky and outer space is called "over the sky". Mio has feelings for him that she cannot bring herself to admit, and she is unsettled when her best friend, Madoka, confides that she likes Arata too. During a visit to a fortune-telling shop, Arata begins seeing strange white orbs. Afterwards they quarrel about their relationship, and Mio walks off without him. That night, having resolved to confess her love, she is caught up in a traffic accident.

The next day Arata does not seem to notice her, and on the way home Mio is carried off to a strange realm called the World Border, where she meets Gimon, her favourite character, who starts leading her toward a new world in which she will forget everything. They are stopped by a girl in a kimono, Kiku-chan, who explains that Mio has arrived by accident through an out-of-body experience and can return to the human world only with a train ticket and the genuine desire to go back. Mio manages to call Arata, who answers while visiting her unconscious body in hospital. At the Forgotten Things Counter she struggles to recount her memories of Arata, so the group seeks help from a goddess, Mrs. Mori. Meanwhile Arata, seeking answers from the fortune teller, finds his own soul leaving his body for the World Border. Although Mio obtains her ticket, the realm's guardian, Mogari, tries to stop her leaving. With her friends' help she reaches the human world but cannot re-enter her body until, at a clifftop that holds a cherished memory, she finally recognises that her desire is to tell Arata she loves him, and the two are reunited.

Sena expanded the project from a planned short into a feature, rewriting the script about twenty times and borrowing roughly ¥200 million to make it. Released in Japan on November 27, 2020, the film was a box-office bomb, selling only about 1,300 admissions on its opening day. THEM Anime Reviews found it derivative of other recent anime.

documents.title: The Rescue
documents.tagline: Courage runs deep
documents.overview: The enthralling, against-all-odds story that transfixed the world in 2018: the daring rescue of twelve boys and their coach from deep inside a flooded cave in Northern Thailand.
documents.plot:
The Rescue is a 2021 documentary film directed and produced by Elizabeth Chai Vasarhelyi and Jimmy Chin, the filmmakers behind Free Solo. It recounts the Tham Luang cave rescue of 2018, in which twelve boys from a junior football team and their coach were trapped deep inside a flooded cave in northern Thailand. Produced by National Geographic Documentary Films, it premiered at the Telluride Film Festival on 2 September 2021 and was released theatrically in the United States on 8 October 2021.

In June 2018, the young members of the Wild Boars football team and their assistant coach enter the Tham Luang Nang Non cave system in Chiang Rai province after practice. Monsoon rains suddenly flood the passages behind them, trapping them kilometers from the entrance. As the world's media gathers, Thai Navy SEALs and volunteers from many countries join a massive search, but the narrow, flooded tunnels, filled with murky water and strong currents, prove extremely dangerous even for professional military divers.

The film focuses on a small group of British cave divers, including Rick Stanton and John Volanthen, who were among the few people in the world with experience of diving in such conditions. Using interviews, archival news footage, previously unseen material filmed during the operation and reconstructions, it shows how Stanton and Volanthen located the boys and their coach alive on a ledge deep inside the cave after nine days. With water levels rising and oxygen falling, the rescuers face an agonizing decision about how to bring out children who cannot dive. They develop a daring plan, involving the Australian anesthetist and cave diver Richard Harris, to sedate each boy and carry him through the flooded passages. The film also recalls the death of former Thai Navy SEAL Saman Kunan, who died while placing air tanks in the cave, and the courage of the international team, including the Belgian diver Jim Warny, that brought all thirteen trapped people out alive.

The Rescue received widespread critical acclaim, with praise for its tension and its access to footage from the operation. It won the BAFTA Award for Best Documentary and was named one of the best documentaries of the year by several critics' groups.

documents.title: We Broke Up
documents.overview: Lori and Doug break up right before Lori's sister's wedding and decide to pretend they're still together for the weekend as to not disrupt the fun.
documents.plot:
We Broke Up is a 2021 American romantic comedy-drama film directed by Jeff Rosenberg, who co-wrote the screenplay with Laura Jacqmin. Aya Cash and William Jackson Harper star as Lori and Doug, a longtime couple whose relationship collapses just before a family wedding, with Sarah Bolger and Tony Cavalero as the bride and groom, Bea and Jayson, and Peri Gilpin as Lori's mother, Adelaide. Rosenberg and Harper had previously worked together on the television series The Good Place, on which Rosenberg was an assistant director and Harper a star.

Lori and Doug have been together so long that everyone expects them to marry. When Doug finally proposes, however, Lori balks in a way that raises troubling questions, and the couple decide to end their relationship. The timing could hardly be worse: they are due to attend the wedding of Lori's younger sister, Bea, who is marrying Jayson after knowing him for only a month. Unwilling to overshadow the celebration with their sad news, Lori and Doug agree to pretend they are still together for the weekend.

The wedding takes place at the summer camp where Lori and Bea spent so many adolescent summers, now reimagined as an upscale, semi-rustic resort that still has its old cabins. To revive the camp spirit, the cheerful, bubbly bride and groom insist that the wedding party compete in the Paul Bunyan games, a series of drinking and skills contests. The games unexpectedly bring Lori and Doug's wounded feelings to the surface, and neither wants to be outdone by the other as they throw themselves into the boozy competition. Meanwhile, Adelaide voices doubts about Bea's hasty decision to marry, adding to the tension. Over the course of the weekend, the hurt shifts back and forth between Lori and Doug as they try to decide what is right for them and whether they are truly over, leaving open a sliver of hope that the breakup may not be final.

The film was released in select theaters and on demand on April 23, 2021. Reviews were generally positive, with 67% approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 55; the Rotten Tomatoes consensus said that, despite not living up to the potential of its premise, the film was redeemed by Cash and Harper's relatable performances. Monica Castillo of RogerEbert.com praised the way it balanced existential questions about the relationship with silly wedding scenarios, tying its elements into a neat, bittersweet package, though she felt the conflicts sometimes escalated unnaturally quickly.

documents.title: The Mad Women's Ball
documents.overview: Eugenie has a unique gift: she hears and sees the dead.
