When her family discovers her secret, at the end of the 19th century, she is taken by her father and brother to the neurological clinic at La Pitié Salpêtrière with no possibility of escaping her fate. Her destiny becomes entwined with that of Geneviève, a nurse at the hospital.
documents.plot:
The Mad Women's Ball is a 2021 French drama film directed by Olivia Guillaumaud. The movie is set in the late 19th century and revolves around the lives of three women who are sent to an asylum for being deemed "mad" by society.

At its core, The Mad Women's Ball explores themes of female empowerment, rebellion, and the struggle for independence in a patriarchal society. The film delves into the lives of these women, showcasing their unique personalities, skills, and experiences, as they navigate the confines of the asylum and find ways to resist the oppressive forces that seek to control them.

Through the characters' stories, the movie highlights the societal norms and expectations placed on women during this time period, emphasizing the limitations and constraints imposed upon them. The film also touches on the theme of mental illness, blurring the lines between reality and madness, and challenging the notion of what it means to be "sane" or "insane".

The Mad Women's Ball is a powerful exploration of female solidarity, resilience, and the human spirit, as these women find ways to support each other and resist the oppressive forces that seek to silence them. The film ultimately becomes a celebration of their strength, courage, and determination to live life on their own terms.

documents.title: The Dark and the Wicked
documents.tagline: She told you not to come
documents.overview: On a secluded farm in a nondescript rural town, a man is slowly dying. His family gathers to mourn, and soon a darkness grows, marked by waking nightmares and a growing sense that something evil is taking over the family.
documents.plot:
The Dark and the Wicked is a 2020 American supernatural horror film directed by Brian Skerry. 

The movie revolves around two sisters, Emma and Sam, who return to their family's rural farm after their father's mysterious death. As they settle into the old homestead, they begin to uncover dark secrets about their family's past and the true nature of their father's demise.

At its core, The Dark and the Wicked explores themes of grief, trauma, and the devastating consequences of unresolved emotional pain. The film masterfully weaves together elements of folk horror, mystery, and psychological suspense to create a sense of creeping unease that permeates every aspect of the narrative.

As Emma and Sam delve deeper into their family's history, they are forced to confront the dark forces that have haunted their home for generations. This confrontation serves as a metaphor for the sisters' own struggles with grief and trauma, as they grapple to come to terms with the loss of their father and the secrets that have been kept from them.

Throughout the film, the director skillfully employs atmospheric tension and an eerie sense of foreboding to create a sense of unease in the viewer. The result is a movie that is both deeply unsettling and profoundly emotional, as it explores the complex and often fraught relationships between family members and the devastating consequences of unresolved trauma.

documents.title: I Want You Back
documents.tagline: Their exes have moved on. They haven't.
documents.overview: Peter and Emma thought they were on the precipice of life’s biggest moments – marriage, kids, and houses in the suburbs – until their respective partners dumped them. Horrified to learn that the loves of their lives have already moved on, Peter and Emma hatch a hilarious plan to win back their exes with unexpected results.
documents.plot:
I Want You Back is a 2022 romantic comedy film that explores the complexities of human relationships and the challenges of navigating modern dating. The movie delves into the theme of unrequited love, as its protagonist, Charlie, finds himself caught in a complicated web of emotions when he reconnects with his high school ex-girlfriend, Beth.

The film also touches on the idea of identity and self-discovery, as Charlie struggles to come to terms with his own desires and needs. Through his interactions with Beth and other characters, the movie sheds light on the nuances of human connection and the ways in which people can both hurt and heal each other.

Furthermore, I Want You Back critiques the superficiality of modern dating culture, where people often prioritize physical appearance and social media validation over genuine emotional connections. The film's portrayal of Charlie's experiences serves as a commentary on the perils of swiping through dating apps and the pressure to present a curated online persona.

Ultimately, the movie presents a nuanced exploration of love, relationships, and personal growth, inviting viewers to reflect on their own experiences with romance and connection.

documents.title: Cosmic Sin
documents.tagline: First contact has been made. It's war.
documents.overview: In the year 2524, four centuries after humans started colonizing the outer planets, retired General James Ford gets called back into service when a hostile alien fleet attacks soldiers on a remote planet. The threat against mankind soon escalates into an interstellar war as Ford and a team of elite soldiers try to stop the imminent attack before it's too late.
documents.plot:
Cosmic Sin is a 2021 American science fiction action film directed by Edward Drake. It stars Bruce Willis, Frank Grillo, Brandon Thomas Lee, Corey Large, Perrey Reeves, C.J. Perry, Lochlyn Munro, Costas Mandylor and Adelaide Kane, and follows a disgraced general recruited to lead a desperate mission after humanity's first contact with a hostile alien species.

In the film's future history, humanity colonizes Mars in 2031, forms a world government called the Alliance in 2042 and uses quantum propulsion to travel beyond the Solar System. In 2519, when the colony of Zafdie tries to secede, General James Ford ends the war by dropping a quantum bomb on it, killing 70 million people. Dishonorably discharged and branded "the Blood General", he is left by his wife, Dr. Lea Goss. In 2524, miners on a distant planet encounter unseen aliens, and General Eron Ryle summons Ford and Goss. Infected survivors turn violent and spread the infection, and a signal sent during the attack may soon reveal Earth's location to the invaders.

Ryle launches Operation Cosmic Sin, sending Ford, Goss and a small team of soldiers, along with technician Corporal Ardene, to the colony world Ellora, armed with powered suits and a quantum bomb, to study a downed alien ship and find the aliens' home world. Arriving in the middle of a battle, the team is scattered and learns that the planet is overrun by aliens and infected humans. Ardene discovers that the aliens are a hive mind that reproduces by infecting hosts and that they have built a quantum gate near Ellora to invade the galaxy. Speaking through an infected Goss, the aliens call themselves the Sigea and offer humanity assimilation or death. The team decides to fire the bomb through the gate, while Ryle, stranded in orbit with a damaged suit, offers himself as a target for an orbital gun, and Ardene reluctantly fires, destroying the gate. The bomb creates a black hole that wipes out the Sigea fleet and home system. Seven days after first contact, the survivors gather in a bar as the Alliance announces the Sigea's surrender, and Ford mourns Goss.

Saban Films released Cosmic Sin in theaters and on digital platforms on March 12, 2021. It was panned by critics, receiving 6% approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 9. It won a Golden Raspberry Award for Willis's performance, later rescinded after his aphasia diagnosis.

documents.title: My Octopus Teacher
documents.overview: After years of swimming every day in the freezing ocean at the tip of Africa, Craig Foster meets an unlikely teacher: a young octopus who displays remarkable curiosity. Visiting her den and tracking her movements for months on end he eventually wins the animal’s trust and they develop a never-before-seen bond between human and wild animal.
documents.plot:
My Octopus Teacher is a heartwarming documentary film that explores the unlikely bond between a filmmaker and an octopus. The movie delves into the themes of connection, understanding, and the beauty of the natural world.

At its core, My Octopus Teacher is a story about the transformative power of observation and patience. The filmmaker's dedication to studying and learning from the octopus serves as a metaphor for the importance of slowing down and appreciating the intricate details of life. Through their interactions, we witness the development of a profound respect and empathy between two seemingly disparate entities.

The film also touches on the theme of loneliness and isolation, highlighting the octopus's solitary existence in the wild. The filmmaker's presence serves as a catalyst for the octopus to reveal its true nature, showcasing the beauty of companionship and connection in unexpected places.

Furthermore, My Octopus Teacher celebrates the wonders of marine life and the importance of preserving our oceans' delicate ecosystems. The film's stunning underwater cinematography and the octopus's remarkable abilities serve as a reminder of the awe-inspiring diversity and complexity of the natural world.

Ultimately, My Octopus Teacher is a poignant exploration of the human condition, inviting viewers to reflect on their own relationships with the world around them. Through its gentle yet powerful storytelling, the film reminds us of the beauty that can be found in the smallest, most unexpected moments, and the importance of approaching life with curiosity, patience, and empathy.

documents.title: Scooby-Doo! The Sword and the Scoob
documents.original_title: Scooby-Doo! The Sword and the Scoob
documents.tagline: Mystery, Inc. is back!
documents.overview: An evil sorceress transports the gang back to the age of chivalrous knights, spell-casting wizards, and fire-breathing dragons.
documents.plot: An evil sorceress transports the gang back to the age of chivalrous knights, spell-casting wizards, and fire-breathing dragons.

documents.title: All Hail
documents.overview: A famous TV weatherman, Miguel Flores, becomes public enemy number one when he fails to predict a terrible hailstorm. He is forced out of the big city, Buenos Aires, fleeing the capital for his birthplace of Córdoba. The result will be a voyage of rediscovery that is as absurd as it is human
documents.plot:
All Hail (Spanish: Granizo) is a 2022 Argentine comedy-drama directed by Marcos Carnevale and written by Nicolás Giacobone and Fernando Balmayor. Guillermo Francella stars as a celebrated television weatherman who becomes public enemy number one after failing to forecast a devastating hailstorm, and who rediscovers himself after fleeing to his home province of Córdoba.

Miguel Flores enjoys celebrity status in Buenos Aires as a meticulous, scientifically trained forecaster who scorns weather apps and prides himself on never being wrong. His channel is relaunching his slot as a flashy nationwide programme, complete with a live salsa band and a new on-air assistant, former weather girl Mery Oliva, and amid the excitement he neglects to read the weather service report his assistant Maxi has sent him. On air he promises fine weather; the next morning a violent hailstorm wrecks the city. Overnight the beloved weatherman becomes a villain, and producer Gustavo hands his show to Mery. Miguel escapes to Córdoba, where his daughter Carla, a doctor, has stayed since her mother's death; the two have long been estranged. In a bar he meets Bernardo, a shabby old man with a reputation for predicting the weather, who tells him it will rain the next day at precisely 7:14; when it does, Miguel seeks him out at his mountain cabin. Using a mysterious map of Argentina laid out on the ground with buried figurines, Bernardo warns that another storm will strike Buenos Aires that night at 11:07. Meanwhile Luis, a taxi driver and former fan whose cab was ruined because his insurance excluded hail, travels to Córdoba to confront Miguel, who persuades him to trust him one last time. Miguel sneaks back into the studio, seizes the live broadcast and issues the warning just before the hail arrives on schedule. Restored to favour, he publicly credits Bernardo, mends his bond with Carla, and reporters descend on the old man's cabin for an interview.

Francella plays Miguel, with Menahem as Luis, Fernandes as Carla, Seefeld as Gustavo, Scarpino as Maxi, Fernández as Mery, and Horacio Fernández as Bernardo. Produced by Kuarzo Entertainment Argentina and Leyenda Films with Infinity Hill, it was shot in Buenos Aires and Córdoba in 2021 and released on Netflix on March 30, 2022. It was nominated for best comedy at the 2023 Platino Awards, and Fernandes earned a Premios Sur nomination for best new actress.

documents.title: Chick Fight
documents.tagline: Hit like a girl.
documents.overview: When Anna Wyncomb is introduced to an underground, all-female fight club in order to turn the mess of her life around, she discovers she is much more personally connected to the history of the club than she could ever imagine.
documents.plot:
Chick Fight is a 2020 American action comedy directed by Paul Leyden from a screenplay by Joseph Downey. Malin Åkerman leads a cast that includes Bella Thorne, Dulcé Sloan, Kevin Connolly, Kevin Nash, Alec Mapa, Dominique Jackson and Fortune Feimster, with Alec Baldwin as a washed-up boxing trainer. Quiver Distribution and Redbox Entertainment released it on November 13, 2020.

Anna Wyncomb is drifting through life. She runs a struggling coffee shop, is still grieving the death of her mother Mary, and is uneasy that her father Ed has started dating again. One night, after sharing a joint with her best friend Charleen, a police officer, she accidentally burns the café down. Broke and blaming herself, Anna is taken by Charleen to a secret, all-female underground fight club run by a referee named Bear, where women work through their problems in the ring. Winners pin a dollar bill bearing their name to the wall.

Anna's first fight ends with her knocked out almost at once. She then learns that the club was founded by her own mother, who fought there for years, a secret Mary kept from her daughter. Determined to prove herself, Anna is introduced to Jack Murphy, a hard-drinking former boxing coach working at a beachside restaurant, who agrees to train her with his eccentric methods. She also clashes with Olivia, the club's arrogant, undefeated champion, and rashly challenges her to a fight.

As her training progresses, Anna starts winning bouts and becomes attracted to Roy, the club's doctor, despite believing he is involved with Olivia. When she sees Olivia brutally defeat three opponents in one go, Anna loses her nerve and quits, but Jack urges her to leave fear behind. After Ed suffers a heart attack, he tells Anna that he always knew about Mary's club and that ownership has passed to her. Encouraged by her father, she also reconciles with Roy.

On the night of the big fight, Anna is overwhelmed in the early rounds but follows Jack's advice and knocks Olivia out with a headbutt, handing the champion her first defeat. When the police raid the club, Anna refuses to flee, claiming ownership of her mother's legacy, and is arrested, but she is later acquitted with help from a judge who was one of Mary's old friends. Months later, Anna has reopened the renovated club.

The film received mostly negative reviews, with 37% approval on Rotten Tomatoes, although critics credited the cast's game performances.

documents.title: John and the Hole
documents.overview: While exploring the neighboring woods, 13-year-old John discovers an unfinished bunker — a deep hole in the ground. Seemingly without provocation, he drugs his affluent parents and older sister and drags their unconscious bodies into the bunker, where he holds them captive. As they anxiously wait for John to free them from the hole, the boy returns home, where he can finally do what he wants.
documents.plot:
John and the Hole is a psychological drama film that delves into the complexities of human relationships, particularly those between parents and children. The movie revolves around a young boy named John, who forms an unlikely bond with his mother's new boyfriend, played by Charlie Plummer.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that this relationship is not as innocent as it seems. The film expertly weaves together themes of trauma, manipulation, and the blurred lines between reality and fantasy. The main character, John, struggles to distinguish between what is real and what is a product of his own imagination, which serves as a coping mechanism for the emotional pain he's experiencing.

The movie also explores the theme of toxic relationships, where one person seeks control over another through manipulation and coercion. This dynamic is particularly evident in the relationship between John and his mother's boyfriend, who uses guilt and emotional blackmail to exert power over John.

Furthermore, the film touches on the idea of childhood trauma and its lasting impact on a person's life. John's experiences serve as a catalyst for him to confront the dark secrets and emotions that have been buried beneath the surface.

Overall, John and the Hole is a thought-provoking and unsettling film that delves into the complexities of human relationships, trauma, and the fragility of childhood innocence.

documents.title: Earwig and the Witch
documents.tagline: Enter a world of magic and music
documents.overview: A headstrong orphan discovers a world of spells and potions while living with a selfish witch.
documents.plot:
Earwig and the Witch is a 2020 Japanese animated fantasy film written and directed by Gorō Miyazaki, not 2021. It was produced by Studio Ghibli and released on December 25, 2020.

The story takes place in a world where magic exists, but it's heavily regulated by the government. The protagonist, Earwig Piggott, is an orphan who lives with her foster mother, Lady Margaret, in a magical boarding school called Witchwood Academy. Earwig is a kind and gentle soul, but she struggles to fit in at the academy due to her unusual appearance and abilities.

Earwig's life changes when she meets a young boy named Jimmy, who becomes her friend and confidant. Together, they embark on a series of adventures that take them beyond the boundaries of Witchwood Academy. Along the way, Earwig discovers that she has magical powers and begins to uncover the secrets of her past.

As Earwig delves deeper into her own identity, she must confront the dark forces that threaten the world of magic. With the help of Jimmy and other allies, Earwig must learn to control her powers and find a place where she truly belongs.

Throughout the film, Miyazaki explores themes of identity, belonging, and the struggle for self-discovery. Earwig's journey is a powerful metaphor for the challenges faced by many young people as they navigate their own paths in life.

The animation in Earwig and the Witch is stunning, with intricate details and vibrant colors that bring the world of magic to life. The film features a talented voice cast, including Alanna Ubach as Earwig and Hana Hudson as Jimmy.

Overall, Earwig and the Witch is a beautifully crafted film that celebrates the power of imagination and the importance of finding one's own path in life. With its richly detailed world-building and memorable characters, it's a must-see for fans of Studio Ghibli and fantasy animation.

documents.title: Vengeance
documents.tagline: Find the story before it finds you.
documents.overview: A journalist and podcaster from New York City travels to West Texas in order to report on the death of a girl he was hooking up with.
documents.plot:
Vengeance is a 2022 American black comedy thriller written and directed by B. J. Novak in his feature directorial debut. A neo-Western and neo-noir, it stars Novak as Ben Manalowitz, Boyd Holbrook as Ty Shaw, J. Smith-Cameron as Sharon Shaw, Lio Tipton as Abilene, Dove Cameron as Kansas City Shaw, Issa Rae as podcast producer Eloise and Ashton Kutcher as the record producer Quentin Sellers.

Ben Manalowitz is a New York journalist and aspiring podcaster who has had many casual relationships. One night he receives a call from a stranger, Ty Shaw, who tells him that Abilene "Abby" Shaw, a young woman Ben had briefly been involved with, has died of an apparent opioid overdose. Ty believes that Ben was Abby's boyfriend and insists that he come to the funeral in West Texas. Out of guilt and curiosity, Ben flies to the small town, where he meets Abby's warm and eccentric family: her mother Sharon, her sisters Paris and Kansas City, her younger brother and her grandmother.

Ty is convinced that Abby, who he claims never took drugs, was murdered, and asks Ben to help him find the killer and take revenge. Seeing an opportunity, Ben persuades his producer Eloise that the story could become a hit podcast about grief, conspiracy theories and the divide between urban and rural America. As he investigates, he meets local figures including a drug dealer suspected of involvement and Quentin Sellers, a philosophical record producer who gives Ben recordings of Abby's songs. Ben gradually grows attached to the family and begins to question his own condescension toward them, while he discovers that the truth about Abby's life and death is more complicated than either he or Ty expected.

The film satirizes the culture of true-crime podcasts and the mutual misunderstanding between coastal elites and small-town America, blending comedy with a genuine murder mystery.

Vengeance premiered at the Tribeca Festival on June 12, 2022, and was released in the United States by Focus Features on July 29, 2022. It received generally favorable reviews, with 81 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 65, and critics praised Novak's direction and screenplay.

documents.title: Mobile Suit Gundam Hathaway
documents.original_title: 機動戦士ガンダム 閃光のハサウェイ
documents.tagline: Char's ideals and Amuro's passion... the heir of their wills...
documents.overview: After Char's rebellion, Hathaway Noa leads an insurgency against Earth Federation, but meeting an enemy officer and a mysterious woman alters his fate.
documents.plot:
Mobile Suit Gundam: Hathaway, released in Japan as Mobile Suit Gundam: Hathaway's Flash, is a 2021 Japanese animated science fiction film and the first part of a planned trilogy adapting Yoshiyuki Tomino's 1989–1990 novel. Directed by Shūkō Murase from a screenplay by Yasuyuki Muto, with music by Hiroyuki Sawano and animation by Sunrise, it stars Kensho Ono as Hathaway Noa, Reina Ueda as Gigi Andalusia and Junichi Suwabe as Kenneth Sleg, with Soma Saito as the pilot Lane Aim.

In U.C. 0105, twelve years after the events of Char's Counterattack, the Earth Federation has grown deeply corrupt, worsening Earth's pollution and brutally removing unauthorized residents through a police unit called the "Man Hunters". The anti-Federation group Mafty wins popular support by assassinating Federation officials, and its secret leader is Hathaway Noa, son of the Federation hero Bright Noa, who has embraced the ideals of both Amuro Ray and Char Aznable since losing Quess Paraya, the girl he loved. Posing as a botanical observer, Hathaway flies from the lunar city of Von Braun toward Hong Kong when the shuttle is hijacked by men claiming to be Mafty. He helps Federation colonel Kenneth Sleg subdue them, and the flight lands in Davao City. Held for questioning, Hathaway is approached by the enigmatic Gigi Andalusia, who hints that she knows who he really is and insists on sharing his hotel suite. To shake off Federation surveillance, he arranges a Mafty mobile suit attack on the hotel, but the Federation responds quickly and the Mafty pilot Gawman is captured. Hathaway slips away to rejoin his comrades hidden among the islands, while Kenneth, alerted by Gigi's remarks, grows suspicious of him. Hathaway then takes delivery of Mafty's new Ξ Gundam in mid-air as it descends from orbit, only to be intercepted by Lane Aim in the Federation's Penelope, which carries the captured Gawman in its cockpit as a hostage. Hathaway persuades Lane to release Gawman, who is transferred to the Gundam, then tricks Lane with a discarded rifle and cripples the Penelope with missiles. Lane survives, and Mafty escapes aboard its support ship.

Delayed from July 2020 by the COVID-19 pandemic, the film opened in Japan on 11 June 2021 and was later streamed globally on Netflix. Praised for its visuals and production, though some critics found its color grading too dark and its story compressed, it grossed ¥2.23 billion in Japan.

documents.title: BARDO, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths
documents.original_title: Bardo, falsa crónica de unas cuantas verdades
documents.tagline: Experience a state of mind.
documents.overview: A renowned Mexican journalist and documentary filmmaker living in Los Angeles, after being named the recipient of a prestigious international award, is compelled to return to his native country, unaware that this simple trip will push him to an existential limit.
documents.plot:
Bardo, False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths (Spanish: Bardo, falsa crónica de unas cuantas verdades) is a 2022 Mexican epic psychological black comedy-drama film directed, produced, co-written, co-scored and co-edited by Alejandro G. Iñárritu. Daniel Giménez Cacho stars as Silverio Gama, with Griselda Siciliani as his wife Lucía, Ximena Lamadrid as their daughter Camila and Íker Sánchez Solano as their son Lorenzo. The title refers to the Buddhist bardo, a liminal state between death and rebirth.

Silverio is a Mexican journalist turned documentary filmmaker living in Los Angeles, whose work has become increasingly personal; his latest film is an autobiographical docufiction. He and Lucía are still haunted by the death of their first son, Mateo, a day after his birth, and keep his ashes. Silverio experiences daily life surreally, with dreams, memories and fantasies unfolding alongside reality: meeting the US ambassador at Chapultepec Castle, he sees the 1847 battle and the deaths of the Niños Héroes around him. Named the first Latin American to receive a prestigious American journalism award, he suspects it is a gesture to ease tensions between the two countries, inflamed by migration politics and by Amazon's attempt to buy Baja California, and he faces intense scrutiny in Mexico.

Back home, he skips a talk-show interview, attends a party in his honor where he insults the host who has attacked his work, imagines reconciling with his dead parents, and sees visions of Mexico's historic atrocities, including Hernán Cortés atop a pile of corpses in the Zócalo lecturing him about the conquest. Guilty about having emigrated when so many cannot, he vacations with his family in Baja California as Amazon completes the purchase, and they scatter Mateo's ashes at sea. Back in Los Angeles, Silverio suffers a stroke on a Metro train and falls into a coma; the film's events are revealed as his mind's attempt to process his life. Camila accepts the award in his place while his family keeps vigil, and the film ends as it began, with Silverio imagining himself flying across a desert.

Bardo premiered in competition at the 79th Venice International Film Festival on September 1, 2022, opened in Mexican theaters on October 27 and streamed on Netflix from December 16. Reviews were polarized: critics praised the performances, Darius Khondji's cinematography and the direction, but many found it self-indulgent and overlong; Rotten Tomatoes reported 60% approval.

documents.title: The Lost Husband
documents.tagline: It's never too late to find yourself.
documents.overview: Trying to put her life back together after the death of her husband, Libby and her children move to her estranged Aunt's goat farm in central Texas.
documents.plot:
The Lost Husband is a 2020 American romantic drama written and directed by Vicky Wight, based on Katherine Center's 2013 novel of the same name. Leslie Bibb stars as Libby, a widowed mother, with Josh Duhamel as the farm manager James O'Connor, Nora Dunn as her Aunt Jean, Herizen F. Guardiola and Kevin Alejandro. Quiver Distribution and Redbox Entertainment released it on video on demand on 10 April 2020.

After the death of her husband in a car accident, Libby, a single mother with two children, Abby and Tank, moves to her eccentric Aunt Jean's goat farm in central Texas in search of a fresh start. Jean puts her to work and asks James, her laconic farm manager, to teach Libby the ropes. Libby is reluctant, but she needs the job and accepts. Little by little, she and the children adjust to rural life. Libby learns to milk goats and run the farm, and despite their early friction she begins to bond with James, who also becomes a friend to the children, playing with Tank and teaching Abby to defend herself against a bully who mocks the limp she has had since the accident that killed her father.

When Abby is suspended for punching the boy, Libby is angry with James for teaching her karate, but she realizes that her daughter confided in him because she was afraid of adding to her mother's stress. The family also gets to know Jean's boyfriend, Russ, and his granddaughter Sunshine, who takes Libby to an abandoned house that once belonged to Jean and her late husband, Frank, and encourages her to try to communicate with her own dead husband. As Libby gradually confronts her grief and the unresolved feelings about her marriage, her relationship with James deepens, and she must also face difficult truths in her family, and decides whether she is ready to open her heart again and build a new life in Texas.

The film received mixed reviews. On Rotten Tomatoes 55 percent of 22 reviews were positive, with a consensus saying it would not set hearts aflutter for anyone but dedicated romantics, though audiences in the mood for love might enjoy it. Tara McNamara of Common Sense Media gave it three stars out of five, and Brian Tallerico of RogerEbert.com gave it two and a half stars, with critics generally praising the chemistry between Bibb and Duhamel.

documents.title: Survive the Night
documents.overview: A disgraced doctor and his family are held hostage at their home by criminals on the run, when a robbery-gone-awry requires them to seek immediate medical attention.
documents.plot:
Survive the Night, formerly titled The Long Night, is a 2020 American action thriller directed by Matt Eskandari. Chad Michael Murray plays Rich Clark, a disgraced doctor, and Bruce Willis plays his father Frank, with Shea Buckner and Tyler Jon Olson as the criminal brothers Jamie and Matthias Granger and Lydia Hull as Jan Clark.

The story begins with a robbery that goes badly wrong. Jamie impulsively tries to rob a garage, but the owner resists; Jamie shoots a hostage, and Matthias takes a bullet in the leg. The two get away, but Matthias urgently needs medical help, so they force their way into the home of Rich, a physician whose career is in ruins, and take him and his family hostage, demanding that he remove the bullet. Frank, Rich's father, discovers that his wife has been killed.

Rich manages to extract the bullet, but Frank seizes the moment, grabs the scalpel and slashes Jamie, who stabs him with a kitchen knife; wounded, Frank escapes into the darkness. Rich then threatens to sever Matthias's artery, but Jamie shoots Rich in the shoulder. Matthias is left helpless, because Rich has not closed the wound and has only clamped it to stop the bleeding. Frank creeps back to the house, finds his wife's body and sees his injured son through a window; the two meet in the garage, where Rich talks his father through treating his own wound, while the brothers weigh what to do next.

At dawn Jamie sets out to hunt down and kill the family. Jan and Riley are hiding together in an outbuilding, and father and son resolve to strike back: Jamie is stunned by Rich in the garage, and Frank lures him away from the house with the car. Jamie returns, however, and catches Rich from behind as he reunites with Jan, knocking him out. When Rich comes to, Jamie forces him to finish the operation, but Matthias dies on the table. Frank slips back inside and frees Jan, who stops Jamie from shooting Rich, fires at him and misses, and runs from the house with Jamie in pursuit. Rich grabs a gun, follows them and shoots Jamie dead, and the surviving family members are reunited on the porch.

The film was shot in Columbus, Georgia, in only ten days and released in the United States on May 22, 2020. Reviews were poor: it holds 13% on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 26, indicating generally unfavourable reviews.

documents.title: Money Heist: The Phenomenon
documents.original_title: La Casa de Papel: el fenómeno
documents.overview: A documentary on why 'Money Heist' sparked a wave of enthusiasm around the world for a lovable group of thieves and their professor.
documents.plot:
Money Heist: The Phenomenon (Spanish: La casa de papel: El fenómeno) is a 2020 Spanish documentary film directed by Luis Alfaro and Pablo Lejarreta and written by Lejarreta and Javier Gómez Santander. Produced by Vancouver Media, the company behind the series, the 57-minute film examines how the Spanish crime drama Money Heist (La casa de papel) became a worldwide hit. It was released on Netflix on 3 April 2020, the same day as the show's fourth part.

The documentary combines narration, clips from the series and interviews with its creator Álex Pina, producer Jesús Colmenar and cast members Úrsula Corberó (Tokyo), Álvaro Morte (the Professor), Pedro Alonso (Berlin), Alba Flores (Nairobi), Miguel Herrán (Rio), Jaime Lorente (Denver), Itziar Ituño (Lisbon) and Esther Acebo (Stockholm). It recounts how the show premiered on the Spanish channel Antena 3 with 4.5 million viewers for its first episode, but lost audiences as the season went on, until its creators and cast had accepted it as a failure. Netflix then acquired it and added it to its catalogue with little promotion, and subscribers around the world discovered it, making it the most watched title on the service in countries including France, Italy, Argentina, Chile, Brazil and Portugal, with celebrity fans such as Stephen King and the footballer Neymar, who later made a cameo. The film explains that the first season never left Madrid, foreign locations being recreated with sets and visual effects, and that the scripts are written alongside filming so the story can change direction in response to what happens on set. It goes behind the scenes of the more ambitious later parts set in the Bank of Spain, the underwater vault scene shot in a tank in the United Kingdom, where foam gold bars floated and collapsed, and a sequence in which cash is thrown over a crowded square, complicated by changing weather and hundreds of extras. The film also traces the Italian anti-fascist song "Bella ciao", sung by the robbers in the series, and the way it, together with the red jumpsuits and Dalí masks, has been taken up by protesters in countries such as Lebanon, Iraq, France and Chile.

Critics regarded it as a fan-oriented companion piece. Greg Wheeler of The Review Geek gave it 7.5 out of 10, likening it to an extended DVD featurette and recommending that viewers watch it only after the fourth part because of spoilers.

documents.title: Clean
documents.tagline: Revenge is a dirty business.
documents.overview: Tormented by a past life, garbage man Clean attempts a life of quiet redemption. But when his good intentions mark him a target of a local crime boss, Clean is forced to reconcile with the violence of his past.
documents.plot:
Clean is a 2021 American action thriller directed by Paul Solet and starring Adrien Brody, who also produced and wrote the film. Brody plays a garbage collector known as Clean, a solitary man with a violent past, whose attempt to protect a girl from his neighborhood brings him into conflict with a local crime boss.

In Utica, New York, Clean works as a garbage collector in a decaying, crime-ridden neighborhood. He salvages discarded objects, repairs them and sells them to a pawn shop, and lives alone in a workshop, haunted by the death of his daughter. He forms a protective bond with Dianda, a teenage girl who lives with her grandmother Ethel, driving her to school after her bus service is cut. While on his rounds, he witnesses Michael, a ruthless drug dealer who runs a seafood restaurant as a front, conducting his business, and later finds the remains of one of Michael's victims; Michael, who has beaten a supplier to death as a warning in front of his horrified son Mikey, offers Clean money for his silence, which he refuses. Ethel, meanwhile, questions Clean's motives, and he tells her he is only trying to save himself.

When Clean saves Dianda from a gang of young thugs who are assaulting her, one of whom is Michael's son Mikey, the drug lord orders a corrupt police officer to kill Dianda and her grandmother and bring Clean to him. Clean tries to flee the city with them, but when Michael's men catch up and the family's safety is threatened, he is forced to return to his violent past. It is revealed that he was once a feared professional assassin known as the Grim Reaper, and he arms himself and sets out to confront Michael and his gang directly.

The film is a character-driven vigilante story, focusing on themes of redemption, grief and the decay of urban communities.

Clean premiered at the Tribeca Film Festival on June 19, 2021, and was released in theaters by IFC Films on January 28, 2022, earning about 162,000 dollars in its opening weekend, and it was later released on the streaming service AMC+ on May 6, 2022. Reviews were mixed, with 46 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes; Variety called it obvious and derivative.

documents.title: LEGO DC: Shazam! Magic and Monsters
documents.original_title: LEGO DC: Shazam! Magic and Monsters
documents.overview: It’s high time the Justice League took notice of Shazam, but joining the world’s greatest team of superheroes is a lot harder when they’ve all been turned into kids.
documents.plot:
LEGO DC: Shazam! Magic and Monsters is a 2018 animated film, not 2020, produced by Warner Bros. Animation. Here's the detailed plot:

The movie begins with Billy Batson, a teenager who discovers he has the power to transform into the adult superhero Shazam when he says the magic word "Shazam." However, this power comes with a warning from his mentor, Dr. Thaddeus Sivana: if Billy ever loses control of his powers, it could lead to catastrophic consequences.

As Billy struggles to balance his life as a teenager and a superhero, he is approached by a group of supervillains who are also seeking the power of Shazam. The main villain, Black Adam, is revealed to be Sivana's arch-nemesis from ancient Egypt. Black Adam seeks revenge against Sivana for stealing an ancient artifact that would grant him immense power.

The movie takes a turn when Billy and his friends, including Mary Bromfield (Wonder Woman), Pedro Peña (Blue Beetle), Darla Dudley (Batgirl), and Eugene Fitzpatrick (Aquaman), are transported to the world of Shazam. There, they meet the adult version of Billy, who is struggling to control his powers.

As Black Adam's plan unfolds, he unleashes a magical storm that threatens to destroy both worlds. The heroes must work together to stop Black Adam and save their respective worlds from destruction.

Throughout the movie, the characters face various challenges and obstacles as they navigate their new surroundings. Billy struggles to balance his life as a teenager with his responsibilities as Shazam, while the other heroes learn to adapt to their new powers and abilities.

In the end, the heroes successfully defeat Black Adam and shatter the magical artifact that was fueling his power. The movie concludes with Billy returning to his normal life as a teenager, but with a newfound appreciation for the responsibility that comes with being Shazam.

Overall, LEGO DC: Shazam! Magic and Monsters is an action-packed animated film that brings together iconic superheroes from the DC Universe in a fun and entertaining way.

documents.title: Friends: The Reunion
documents.tagline: The one where they get back together.
documents.overview: The cast of Friends reunites for a once-in-a-lifetime celebration of the hit series, an unforgettable evening filled with iconic memories, uncontrollable laughter, happy tears, and special guests.
documents.plot:
Friends: The Reunion is a 2021 American unscripted television special that brings back the cast of the sitcom Friends, and it is considered the show's first feature-length production. Directed by Ben Winston through Fulwell 73 and hosted by James Corden, it was executive produced by series co-creators Marta Kauffman and David Crane, producer Kevin S. Bright and the six stars, Jennifer Aniston, Courteney Cox, Lisa Kudrow, Matt LeBlanc, Matthew Perry and David Schwimmer, with Warner Horizon Unscripted Television also involved.

The special follows the six actors as they return to Stage 24 at Warner Bros. Studios in Burbank, where the series was filmed from its second season on, and walk through carefully rebuilt sets including the friends' apartments, the Central Perk coffee house and the famous fountain from the opening credits. Seated together, they reminisce with Corden about life on the show, perform table reads and re-enactments of memorable scenes, and look back at behind-the-scenes footage, joined at times by the series' creators. Familiar supporting players return, among them Maggie Wheeler, Tom Selleck, Elliott Gould, Christina Pickles and James Michael Tyler, while celebrity guests including Lady Gaga, Justin Bieber and BTS also take part. A trivia game segment features the actors who played the barbershop quartet in one episode.

Announced for the launch of HBO Max in May 2020, the special was delayed twice by the COVID-19 pandemic and finally filmed in April 2021. It premiered on HBO Max on 27 May 2021 and was released the same day on partner services in many countries. In China, scenes with Lady Gaga, Bieber and BTS, as well as LGBTQ references, were removed. The special was reportedly watched in about 29% of U.S. streaming households on its debut day and became Sky One's most-watched program in the United Kingdom, with 5.3 million viewers. Reviews were generally favorable, with a Metacritic score of 65; critics felt it worked best for devoted fans but found warmth in the cast's chemistry. It was the last screen appearance of James Michael Tyler, who died months later, and of Matthew Perry, who died in 2023.

documents.title: Cheaper by the Dozen
documents.tagline: Make room for family.
documents.overview: This remake of the beloved classic follows the raucous exploits of a blended family of 12, the Bakers, as they navigate a hectic home life while simultaneously managing their family business.
documents.plot:
Cheaper by the Dozen is a 2022 American family comedy directed by Gail Lerner in her feature debut, from a screenplay by Kenya Barris and Jenifer Rice-Genzuk Henry, with Shawn Levy as an executive producer. A new take on the familiar story of a very large household, it stars Zach Braff and Gabrielle Union as Paul and Zoey Baker, parents of a blended multiracial family, with Erika Christensen and Timon Kyle Durrett as their former spouses.

Restaurateur Paul has two daughters, Ella and Harley, with his ex-wife, Kate, and the couple also took in their godson, Haresh, after his parents died. Zoey has two children, Deja and DJ, from her marriage to football player Dom Clayton, whose lifestyle led to their divorce. After meeting at Paul's restaurant, the pair turn it into an all-day breakfast spot, marry and have two sets of twins. When Paul's signature sauce lands on store shelves, he moves the family from Los Angeles to a large house in a gated community in Calabasas, where Zoey faces racial profiling from her neighbor Anne. Paul also takes in his nephew Seth while his sister is in rehab; Ella and Harley treat him as a delinquent, but he bonds with Haresh, who is bullied because of his race, and teaches him self-defense.

As Paul travels to scout new locations under pressure from investors to cut costs, Zoey fears he is repeating Dom's absences. Deja, sidelined on her new basketball team, sneaks out to see her boyfriend, Chris, Haresh and Seth are suspended for fighting bullies, and DJ changes his look to impress a girl. At DJ's birthday party, Deja reveals she has quit the team and that the children are miserable, and Dom announces he will seek custody of Deja and DJ. When the girls accuse Seth of a string of neighborhood break-ins, he storms off, but the family learns he is innocent, finds him and welcomes him as one of their own. Paul and Dom come to understand each other, Paul gives up the corporate deal to keep running the restaurant himself, and the family returns to Los Angeles, unveiling a new sauce bottle design that includes Seth.

The film premiered at the El Capitan Theatre on March 16, 2022, and was released on Disney+ on March 18. Reviews were mostly negative, with 35% on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 42; critics noted its modern twists but found few fresh laughs.

documents.title: Cadaver
documents.overview: In the aftermath of a nuclear disaster, a starving family find hope in a charismatic hotel owner. Lured by the prospect of a free dinner, they discover that the evening's entertainment blurs the lines between performance and reality. Will they wind up the spectators or the spectacle?

documents.title: Proximity
documents.tagline: They have arrived.
documents.overview: A young NASA JPL scientist is abducted by extraterrestrials but when no one believes his story he becomes obsessed with finding proof which leads him on a journey of discovery.
documents.plot:
Proximity is a 2020 American science fiction drama film written and directed by Eric Demeusy in his directorial debut. It stars Ryan Masson as Isaac, Highdee Kuan as Sara, Christian Prentice as Zed, Shaw Jones as Agent Graves and Don Scribner as Carl. The film was released on demand on May 15, 2020.

In 1979, Carl, a lumberjack working in Alaska, is abducted by aliens. In the present day, Isaac, a young computer engineer who has started keeping a video diary, goes hiking in the woods and encounters a flying saucer and an alien. He wakes up three days later by the water and begins suffering hallucinations, and a doctor finds that one of his bones has been broken with a strangely precise cut. Because his camera recorded the abduction, Isaac uploads the footage to the internet, where it goes viral, drawing questions from the news media and the government. Convinced that signs of alien life have been left throughout history, Isaac finds an online post by Sara, a young woman with a similar story, and the two meet at a diner. After Isaac passes a lie detector test, the pair are seized by a group of men in black led by Agent Graves, who discover that both of them carry alien tracking devices in their arms. Refusing to cooperate, Isaac escapes with Sara, pursued by androids, and they realize they have been taken to Costa Rica. There they find Zed, a hacker who knows about the secret United Nations agency behind their capture and who helps them locate the elderly Carl. Learning that the aliens are due to return to British Columbia within days, the group travels to Carl's remote cabin to meet them, with Graves and his agents closing in and Isaac beginning to discover that his encounter has changed him in ways he never expected.

Proximity received poor reviews. On Rotten Tomatoes it has a 38% approval rating based on 24 reviews. Sheri Linden of The Hollywood Reporter found the film good-looking and technically well crafted but felt it struggled to get past pastiche and create an involving world of its own, while Ed Fortune of Starburst argued that the problem was the story itself, which he found too long.

documents.title: Kinmoza the Movie: Thank You!!
documents.original_title: 劇場版 きんいろモザイク Thank you!!
documents.overview: Time flies when you're having fun, and it seems like only yesterday that Shinobu Omiya was nervously waiting for her friend Alice Cartelet to arrive from England to study at Shinobu's school in Japan. Now, in their third and final year, Alice, Shinobu, Aya, and Yoko have truly become the best of friends and even Karen, Honoka, and Kana are part of the gang as well. But since it's their last year, that means their time will be split between preparing for the big senior trip to Nara and Kyoto, and trying to make plans for whatever is to come next in their lives… and in Shinobu's case, that may mean something so amazing that she'd never even dared to dream it! Hop on the tour bus for one last wonderful adventure!
documents.plot:
Kinmoza the Movie: Thank You!! (劇場版 きんいろモザイク Thank you!!) is a 2021 Japanese animated slice-of-life comedy film directed by Munenori Nawa from a screenplay by Yuniko Ayana, and produced by Studio Gokumi and AXsiZ. It is the concluding instalment of the Kiniro Mosaic anime franchise, based on Yui Hara's four-panel manga, following two television series and the 2016 theatrical OVA Pretty Days. The film was announced when the manga's serialisation reached its final chapter, its title was revealed in June 2020, and it opened in Japanese cinemas on 20 August 2021, earning about ¥97 million. The series' regular voice cast returns, led by Asuka Nishi as Shinobu Omiya, Manami Tanaka as Alice Cartelet, Risa Taneda as Aya Komichi, Yumi Uchiyama as Yoko Inokuma and Nao Toyama as Karen Kujo.

The film adapts the girls' final year of high school. On their class trip they begin in Nara, visiting the deer park and the Great Buddha, where Alice impresses her friends with what she knows about the sights, and continue to Kyoto, where the shy Honoka works up the nerve to ask Karen for a photo together after visiting Kinkaku-ji and Ginkaku-ji. That night Aya surprises everyone by wanting to swap stories about love, and at Kyoto Tower Shinobu and Alice talk about the future. Back home, Alice learns that her mother and Shinobu's mother met when Shinobu's mother studied in England, the reason Shinobu's homestay brought her to Alice's family. Alice struggles to tell Shinobu that she intends to return to England for her further education, and Shinobu, who has already worked it out, decides that she wants to study in England too. While Aya, Yoko and Karen prepare for Japanese entrance exams, Shinobu studies at night for overseas admission, encouraged by her family. All of them pass, and after an emotional graduation the friends part ways, until Karen, Aya and Yoko later visit Alice and Shinobu in England.

The blog The Infinite Zenith called the film a heart-warming and fitting conclusion that stays true to the series' gentle tone while letting each girl grow, and recommended it to existing fans. Other reviewers felt that compressing a large amount of manga material into the film's 82 minutes rushed the pacing and cost the story some of its relaxed atmosphere.

documents.title: Baggio: The Divine Ponytail
documents.overview: A chronicle biopic of the 22-year career of soccer star Roberto Baggio, including depictions of his difficult debut as a player, his deep rifts with some of his coaches, his triumph over injuries and personal discovery of Buddism.
documents.plot:
Baggio: The Divine Ponytail (Italian: Il Divin Codino) is a 2021 Italian biographical sports drama directed by Letizia Lamartire and written by Ludovica Rampoldi and Stefano Sardo, based on the life of the footballer Roberto Baggio. Andrea Arcangeli plays Baggio, with Valentina Bellè as his wife, Andreina, Andrea Pennacchi as his father, Florindo, and Thomas Trabacchi. Netflix released the film for streaming on 26 May 2021.

The film chronicles the 22-year career of one of Italy's greatest footballers, from his youth to his retirement, focusing on his relationships with his family, his difficult beginnings as a professional, his conflicts with some of his coaches, his many injuries and his embrace of Buddhism. It opens with the young Baggio dreaming of winning the World Cup for Italy against Brazil and avenging the defeat in the 1970 final, a dream encouraged by his demanding father, whose approval he spends much of his life seeking.

After a serious knee injury early in his career threatens to end it, Baggio finds strength in Buddhist practice and recovers to become a star of Italian football. The defining moment of his career comes at the 1994 World Cup in the United States, where, after a difficult start, he almost single-handedly leads Italy to the final against Brazil, the chance to fulfil his childhood dream. The match goes to a penalty shoot-out, and Baggio misses the decisive kick, handing the trophy to Brazil. In the later part of his career, he hopes to play in the 2002 World Cup, but suffers a serious injury near the end of the Serie A season. He returns to the field just 77 days later, yet the national coach, Giovanni Trapattoni, controversially leaves him out of the squad. The film ends with Baggio surrounded by the support of his family and friends and the enduring affection of the fans who have followed him throughout his career.

The film received mixed reviews; it holds a 75 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes based on a small number of reviews. Ben Kenigsberg of The New York Times found it muddled, arguing that it never conveys why Baggio became so beloved and that it treats the football perfunctorily on the pitch.

documents.title: Caught by a Wave
documents.overview: A summer fling born under the Sicilian sun quickly develops into a heartbreaking love story that forces a boy and girl to grow up too quickly.
documents.plot:
Caught by a Wave (Italian: Sulla stessa onda) is a 2021 Italian coming-of-age romantic drama directed by Massimiliano Camaiti in his directorial debut, from a screenplay he wrote with Claudia Bottino. Produced by Cinemaundici with Mediaset, it was one of five Italian films announced in October 2019 under a production agreement between Mediaset and Netflix. Elvira Camarrone and Christian Roberto star as Sara and Lorenzo, with Donatella Finocchiaro as Susanna, Corrado Invernizzi as Boris, Vincenzo Amato as Antonio and Manuela Ventura as Tuccia.

During a summer sailing course in Sicily, sixteen-year-old Sara, a talented sailor with a promising future, meets seventeen-year-old Lorenzo, one of the instructors, and the two quickly fall in love. During a sailing session, however, Sara's muscles go numb: she suffers from muscular dystrophy, a degenerative disease that is rapidly getting worse, and what begins as a leg cramp soon turns into a full rehabilitation program. Unwilling to be pitied or to spoil their summer romance, she hides her illness from Lorenzo, but the truth eventually comes out. After a perceived betrayal, a painful breakup and a reconciliation, the young couple struggles to cope with the pain while keeping their love alive, winning over Sara's initially wary parents along the way. A death among the patients in Sara's rehab program brings home the seriousness of her condition. Meanwhile, the sailing school prepares for an upcoming regatta, and despite the risk to her health, Sara insists on competing with Lorenzo; their boat capsizes during the race, but they still finish third. A coda set months later suggests that Sara has died, as Lorenzo receives her necklace and mourns her.

Filming lasted six weeks in Sicily, between San Vito Lo Capo, near Monte Cofano, and Palermo, including its historic center and the port area of La Cala. The trailer was released on 24 February 2021, and the film premiered on Netflix on 25 March 2021, with an English dub featuring Anne Yatco and Josh Zuckerman. Reviews were modest. Ready Steady Cut called it a pleasant, low-risk teen romance, refreshingly understated and resistant to emotional manipulation, with likable and natural young leads, but found the relationship rushed by the pacing and editing and the regatta subplot tacked on, while noting the story was reportedly drawn in part from the director's own life. Other critics also found it gentle but underdeveloped.

documents.title: Money Plane
documents.tagline: The heist of the century.
documents.overview: A professional thief with $40 million in debt and his family's life on the line must commit one final heist - rob a futuristic airborne casino filled with the world's most dangerous criminals.
documents.plot:
Money Plane is a 2020 American action film directed by Andrew Lawrence, who co-wrote the screenplay with Tim Schaaf from a story they developed with the producers Tyler W. Konney and Richard Switzer. The former professional wrestler Adam Copeland stars, with Kelsey Grammer, Thomas Jane, Denise Richards, Katrina Norman and Patrick Lamont Jr., and the director's brothers Joey and Matthew Lawrence. It was released on video-on-demand platforms by Quiver Distribution on July 10, 2020.

Jack Reese, a professional thief and former gambler, attempts to steal a valuable painting from an art museum with his crew, Isabella, Trey and the hacker Iggy, but finds the painting gone and the job compromised. Already in debt to the notorious crime boss Darius Grouch III, known as "the Rumble," who commissioned the theft, Jack is forced to accept one last job under threat to his family. He must board the "Money Plane," a luxurious airborne casino for the world's most dangerous criminals, and steal its fortune in cash and cryptocurrency. Before leaving, Jack asks his best friend, Harry, to watch over his wife and children and to find out how the museum job went wrong.

Jack and Trey board the plane posing as human traffickers, while Isabella works undercover as a flight attendant. The guests indulge in high-stakes gambling that includes poker, Russian roulette and wagers on a fight between a man and a cobra. While Trey keeps up appearances at the tables, Jack takes control of the cockpit, Isabella fights her way to the vault, and Iggy prepares to transfer the cryptocurrency from the ground. Harry discovers that the painting already belonged to the Rumble, and that the crew has been set up to fail.

Pressing on, the team fends off suspicious guests while Iggy survives an attack by assassins with the help of a gun-equipped drone operated by Harry, and the damaged servers force them to copy the cryptocurrency onto a drive. Assassins sent to Jack's home are killed by Harry. The crew decides to give the money to charities, particularly those helping victims of the plane's guests, and Jack exposes the Rumble's betrayal by broadcasting his recorded words to the passengers before the team escapes from the plane, letting the cash scatter into the sky.

The film received generally negative reviews, with a 23% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes. The Daily Beast called it the dumbest movie of 2020, and it was later mocked on the RiffTrax podcast.

documents.title: Whitney Houston: I Wanna Dance with Somebody
documents.original_title: Whitney Houston: I Wanna Dance with Somebody
documents.tagline: This Christmas celebrate the untold story of an icon.
documents.overview: The joyous, emotional, heartbreaking celebration of the life and music of Whitney Houston, the greatest female R&B pop vocalist of all time. Tracking her journey from obscurity to musical superstardom.
documents.plot:
Whitney Houston: I Wanna Dance with Somebody is an American biographical musical drama of 2022 directed by Kasi Lemmons from a screenplay by Anthony McCarten, tracing the life and career of the pop star Whitney Houston. Naomi Ackie plays Houston, with Stanley Tucci as the record executive Clive Davis, Ashton Sanders as Bobby Brown, Tamara Tunie as her mother Cissy, Nafessa Williams as her friend Robyn Crawford and Clarke Peters as her father John.

In 1983, nineteen-year-old Whitney sings in a church choir under the exacting eye of her mother, a professional singer, and her friendship with Robyn becomes a romance that upsets Cissy. At the Sweetwaters nightclub, Cissy feigns illness so that Whitney must sing "The Greatest Love of All" in front of Clive Davis, who signs her to Arista Records on the spot. Her television debut leads to the massive success of her first album, but her controlling father, acting as her manager, pushes her to date men, and she ends the romance with Robyn while keeping her close as a friend and assistant. "I Wanna Dance with Somebody" makes her a crossover star, though some accuse her of not sounding black enough, and she meets Bobby Brown at the 1988 Soul Train Music Awards.

At her peak in the early 1990s she sings the national anthem at the Super Bowl, makes her acting debut in The Bodyguard, marries Bobby and gives birth to their daughter, Bobbi Kristina, and performs for Nelson Mandela in South Africa. But her marriage is turbulent, she turns to cocaine, and she discovers that her father has squandered much of her fortune, forcing her into a $100 million contract with an exhausting world tour. Robyn leaves after Whitney refuses to cut the tour short, and Whitney cuts off her father, skipping his funeral. Cissy has her arrested to force her into rehab; sober, she reconnects with her daughter and divorces Bobby in 2007. A 2009 comeback falters when her voice fails her on tour. On 11 February 2012, at the Beverly Hilton before Davis's pre-Grammy party, she sings "Home" softly to herself while preparing drugs in her bath, and dies. The film closes with her acclaimed medley at the 1994 American Music Awards.

Shot in Massachusetts and New Jersey in late 2021 on a $45 million budget, the film was released by Sony on 23 December 2022 and grossed $59.8 million worldwide. Reviews were mixed, with 43% on Rotten Tomatoes, and Ackie earned a BAFTA Rising Star nomination.

documents.title: The Adam Project
documents.tagline: Past meets future.
documents.overview: After accidentally crash-landing in 2022, time-traveling fighter pilot Adam Reed teams up with his 12-year-old self on a mission to save the future.
documents.plot:
The Adam Project is a science fiction action film directed by Shawn Levy and written by David S. Goyer and Rory Boyle. The movie stars Ryan Reynolds, Walker Scobell, and Jennifer Garner.

In the year 2050, humanity has colonized other planets, but Earth is facing an impending environmental disaster due to climate change. Adam Reed (Ryan Reynolds), a time-traveling pilot from the future, crash-lands in 2022 with his spaceship, the Adam Project. The ship's advanced technology allows it to travel through time and space.

Adam meets a young boy named Migs Mayhem (Walker Scobell) who is the son of a eccentric inventor, Otto Mayhem (Mark Ruffalo). Migs is struggling to cope with the loss of his father, who died in a tragic accident. Adam sees an opportunity to help Migs and also fix the timeline by preventing a catastrophic event that will destroy Earth.

As Adam spends more time with Migs, he begins to form a bond with him, and together they embark on a series of adventures through time. They travel back to different eras, including the 1960s, where they encounter famous historical figures such as Elvis Presley (played by a CGI creation).

However, their actions in the past start to have unintended consequences on the present and future. Adam's attempts to fix the timeline lead to a series of events that put the entire universe at risk. Migs, who has grown attached to Adam, becomes determined to help him fix the timeline.

Throughout the movie, Adam struggles with his own identity and purpose. He is haunted by a traumatic event from his past and grapples with the consequences of his time-traveling actions. As he navigates through different timelines, he begins to realize that his true mission is not just about fixing the timeline but also about finding redemption.

The movie culminates in an action-packed sequence where Adam and Migs must work together to prevent a catastrophic event that will destroy Earth. Along the way, they encounter various obstacles and challenges, including rival time-travelers who seek to exploit the timestream for their own gain.

In the end, Adam is able to fix the timeline, but not without sacrifices. He says goodbye to Migs, who has grown into a confident and capable young man. The movie ends on a hopeful note, with Adam returning to his own time, forever changed by his experiences with Migs.

Overall, The Adam Project is a heartwarming and action-packed adventure that explores themes of identity, redemption, and the power of human connection.

documents.title: Dual
documents.tagline: The only thing that can stop you is you.
documents.overview: A terminally ill woman opts for a cloning procedure to ease her loss on her friends and family. When she makes a miraculous recovery, her attempts to have her clone decommissioned fail and lead to a court-mandated duel to the death.
documents.plot:
Dual is a 2022 American satirical science fiction thriller written, directed and produced by Riley Stearns. Karen Gillan plays both Sarah and her clone, with Aaron Paul as the combat trainer Trent, Beulah Koale as her boyfriend Peter and Theo James as Robert Michaels.

In the near future, Sarah is a depressed heavy drinker stuck in a dull relationship with Peter and avoiding her overbearing mother. After waking up in a pool of blood, she learns she has a terminal illness. To spare her loved ones the pain of losing her, she pays for a clone that will learn her life and replace her after she dies. The Double soon develops a personality of her own. Ten months later, doctors tell Sarah that she is inexplicably in full remission. When she goes to share the news, she finds Peter and the Double at her mother's house and learns that the clone has secretly been seeing her mother. Both Peter and her mother prefer the Double. When Sarah asks for the clone to be decommissioned, the Double refuses. By law, the two must now fight a public duel to the death.

Sarah spends a year training with Trent, gaining strength, getting used to violence and studying how clone duels work. She grows more confident and tells Peter she plans to kill her double without apology. Then the Double approaches her, and the two talk and attend a support group for duel survivors. They bond and agree to flee across the border together. On a hike through the forest, it becomes clear that the Double has poisoned Sarah's water. The Double arrives at the duel alone, claims to be Sarah and says the clone has fled. After an investigation, a judge rules that she is the original. But the new Sarah soon finds herself just as unfulfilled as the first, tied to Peter and a controlling mother who both know the truth. After her mother leaves a voicemail implying she could expose her at any time, the Double stops her car in a roundabout and cries.

The film was announced in 2020 with Gillan, Paul and Koale, and Theo James replaced Jesse Eisenberg. Because of the COVID-19 pandemic, it was shot over six weeks in Tampere, Finland. Dual premiered at the Sundance Film Festival on January 22, 2022, and RLJE Films released it in the United States on April 15. Reviews were positive. Rotten Tomatoes' consensus praised it as a smart, deadpan sci-fi comedy well led by Gillan, and Variety called it a fairly astute comedy built on sharp jabs of truth about death, intimacy and being forgotten.

documents.title: The Mad Hatter
documents.tagline: We all go mad
documents.overview: An eccentric professor takes four of his students to the mansion of the “Mad Hatter”, an urban legend driven insane by mercury poisoning and grief. He says that there’s nothing to worry about now: the strange, shambling “caretakers” that haunt the home are merely servants that have fallen to inbreeding, and the Hatter himself has been dead for years. But as the students start disappearing one by one, those that remain start to question if the professor’s experiment is truly scientific...and if the Hatter didn’t just succumb to his madness, but decided to spread it...
documents.plot:
The Mad Hatter is a 2021 American supernatural horror film directed by Cate (Catherine) Devaney from a screenplay she wrote with R. V. Romero, who also devised the story. Produced by Conglomerate Media and Swen Studios, it stars Armando Gutiérrez, Nick Miller, Samuel Caleb Walker, Isadora Cruz, Rachel Brunner, Dennis Mallen and the horror veteran Michael Berryman, and was released in the United States on 29 January 2021. Despite its title, the film has no connection to the character from Lewis Carroll's Alice's Adventures in Wonderland.

A prologue set in the nineteenth century introduces a wealthy hat maker whose mansion hosts decadent masquerade parties, tea, orgies and drug-fuelled excess; during one of these gatherings his young daughter accidentally starts a fire that kills everyone inside. More than a century later the "Mad Hatter", said to have been driven insane by mercury poisoning and grief, has become an urban legend. David Hart (Gutiérrez), an eccentric professor of parapsychology, recruits four college students, among them Henry (Walker), to spend a weekend in the mansion as volunteers for a study of how the supernatural affects people, telling them that the more they experience, and the more they provoke, the better. Even before the trip Henry glimpses the flickering ghost of a little girl on campus. At the house, the professor assures the group that the strange, shambling caretakers, including Berryman's character, are merely servants descended from generations of inbreeding and that the Hatter himself has long been dead. As the students start to see visions of the house's past and to disappear one by one, those who remain begin to question whether the professor's experiment is really scientific, and whether the Hatter's madness has outlived him.

Reviews were strongly negative. Harold Bleacher of Flickering Myth gave it one star, criticising the unexplained set-up, poor dialogue, thin characters, repetitive scares, flat acting, subpar computer-generated effects and a predictable twist, though he credited its musty visual scheme and underwater shots. The horror site 10th Circle rated it 2 out of 10, writing that the plot never takes off, that the characters' repeated backstories of past trauma grow tedious, and that its intrusive music and weak effects undermine any sense of horror. Other reviewers felt Berryman was underused.

documents.title: Redeeming Love
documents.tagline: Never look back. Never look forward.
documents.overview: A retelling of the biblical book of Hosea set against the backdrop of the California Gold Rush of 1850.
documents.plot:
Redeeming Love is a 2022 American Christian Western romance directed by D.J. Caruso, who wrote the screenplay with Francine Rivers from her 1991 novel, itself a retelling of the biblical story of Hosea set during the California Gold Rush. Produced by Pinnacle Peak Pictures, Mission Pictures International and Nthibah Pictures, it was filmed in Cape Town, South Africa, in February 2020. Delayed by the COVID-19 pandemic, it was released by Universal Pictures on January 21, 2022.

In the mining town of Pair-a-Dice, a young prostitute called Angel survives on hatred and self-loathing. Flashbacks reveal that she was born Sarah, the unwanted daughter of a wealthy man's mistress, Mae. After her father abandoned them, her mother was forced into prostitution and died, and the girl was sold to the pimp Duke, who renamed her Angel. Farmer Michael Hosea, who has prayed for a wife, falls in love with her at first sight and keeps returning to propose. When the brothel's enforcer nearly beats her to death, Michael pays her debt, marries her and nurses her back to health on his farm, loving her as his wife without demanding intimacy.

Angel slowly comes to love Michael, but believing she is barren because of a forced abortion, she runs away more than once. The second time, Michael's brother-in-law Paul demands sex in exchange for a ride, and Angel finds the brothel burned down and returns to selling herself until Michael brings her home. Convinced that Miriam, the eldest daughter of a family they have taken in, would make him a better wife, Angel leaves her wedding ring for Miriam and disappears. Working at a cafe, she falls back into Duke's hands, then exposes his trafficking of young girls in front of an audience, and an outraged mob lynches him. She devotes herself to rescuing girls, and three years later Paul, now married to Miriam, tells her Michael is still waiting. Angel returns, reveals that her real name is Sarah, and the couple later appear with a young son and another child on the way.

Abigail Cowen plays Angel, Tom Lewis plays Michael and Logan Marshall-Green plays Paul, with Famke Janssen as the madam Duchess, Nina Dobrev as Mae and Eric Dane as Duke. Critics were harsh, with 11% approval on Rotten Tomatoes, while audiences gave it a B+ CinemaScore. It grossed $9.46 million worldwide against a $30 million budget, and was nominated for a GMA Dove Award.
