documents.title: Petite Maman
documents.original_title: Petite Maman - Als wir Kinder waren
documents.tagline: Experience a fairytale of wonder and innocence.
documents.overview: Nelly has just lost her grandmother and is helping her parents clean out her mother's childhood home. She explores the house and the surrounding woods. One day she meets a girl her same age building a treehouse.
documents.plot:
Petite Maman ('Little Mum') is a 2021 French fantasy drama written and directed by Céline Sciamma. It stars the twin sisters Joséphine Sanz as Nelly and Gabrielle Sanz as Marion, with Stéphane Varupenne as Nelly's father, Nina Meurisse as her mother and Margo Abascal as her grandmother. The film follows a young girl coping with the death of her grandmother who, through a mysterious encounter, comes to know her mother as a child.

Eight-year-old Nelly has just lost her maternal grandmother, who suffered from a hereditary illness and died in a care home. Troubled that she never properly said goodbye, Nelly accompanies her parents to her grandmother's house in the woods, where her mother Marion grew up, to clear it out. Overwhelmed by grief, Marion leaves abruptly one morning without saying goodbye, leaving Nelly alone with her father to finish the work.

While playing in the woods, Nelly meets a girl her own age who is building a hut out of branches. The girl is also named Marion, and she invites Nelly to help. When it starts to rain, Marion takes Nelly home, and Nelly realizes that the house is her grandmother's house, the same one she has just left, and that the girl is her mother as a child. Over several days Nelly returns repeatedly to the past, where she spends time with young Marion and with her grandmother, now the same age as her own mother is in the present. The two girls play, cook, act out improvised plays and confide in each other. Nelly learns that Marion is about to undergo an operation to protect her from the illness that afflicts her mother, and eventually she reveals the truth about who she is.

Sciamma tells the story with great economy and simplicity, treating the time-slip premise without explanation and focusing on grief, memory and the bond between parents and children.

Petite Maman premiered in competition at the Berlin International Film Festival on 3 March 2021 and was released in France on 2 June 2021 by Pyramide Distribution. It received universal acclaim, with 97 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus called it a delicate, powerfully acted meditation on grief, and a Metacritic score of 93.

documents.title: Cry Macho
documents.tagline: A story of being lost... and found.
documents.overview: Mike Milo, a one-time rodeo star and washed-up horse breeder, takes a job from an ex-boss to bring the man's young son home from Mexico.
documents.plot: A one-time rodeo star and washed-up horse breeder takes a job from an ex-boss to bring the man's young son home from Mexico.

documents.title: Xico's Journey
documents.overview: The peace of a small town is endangered when a corporation wants to destroy the mountain that protects them. A girl named Copi and her best friend Xico, a Xoloitzcuintle dog, will go into the mountains to try to save the town.
documents.plot:
Xico's Journey (Spanish: El camino de Xico) is a 2020 Mexican 2D animated adventure film and the directorial debut of Eric D. Cabello Díaz. Produced by Ánima, the film is based on the pre-existing character Xico, a Xoloitzcuintle, the hairless Mexican dog breed that in Aztec belief guides souls to the afterlife. The voice cast includes Pablo Gama Iturrarán as Xico, Verónica Alva as Copi, Luis Ángel Jaramillo as Gus, the singer Lila Downs as Nana Petra and the writer Elena Poniatowska. It opened in Mexican cinemas on 12 November 2020 and was released globally on Netflix on 12 February 2021.

Copi is a lively, mischievous girl who lives with her grandmother Nana Petra in San Jaime, a small village in the shadow of a sacred mountain, along with her dog Xico and her best friend Gus. Her playful antics often get her into trouble with the townspeople. Meanwhile, in the city, the head of a powerful corporation learns that the mountain holds gold and draws up plans to blast it apart and frack the surrounding land. With the support of the town's mayor, who promises the villagers prosperity, the company prepares to bring in heavy machinery and armed security.

Nana Petra, one of the mountain's secret guardians, gathers with the others to protect it, and Copi overhears that her mother, whom she believed dead, may be alive inside the mountain. Determined to find her, Copi sets out into the wilderness with Xico, and Gus soon follows, carrying a magic stone entrusted to him by Nana Petra with instructions to find a messenger. On their journey Xico begins to speak and to change color as his magical nature awakens, and the children meet talking animals and spirit creatures while discovering that the mountain's forests are dying and turning to stone. They also face danger, including a giant stone scorpion whose sting threatens Copi's life, as the company's machines advance and the fate of the mountain and the village hangs in the balance.

The film received generally mixed to favorable reviews. It holds a 100 percent rating on the Mexican aggregator Tomatazos, while John Sooja of Common Sense Media gave it three out of five, calling it beautiful and sweet but criticizing its story. Other reviewers found its environmental message heavy-handed while praising its colorful animation and its celebration of Mexican culture.

documents.title: My Son
documents.tagline: A groundbreaking achievement in filmmaking where both actor and audience uncover a mystery at the same time.
documents.overview: When a man's only son goes missing, he travels to the town where his ex-wife lives in search of answers. To play a man whose life is clouded by mystery, McAvoy will not be given a script of dialogue.
documents.plot:
My Son is a 2021 mystery thriller written and directed by Christian Carion, an English-language remake of his 2017 French film Mon garçon. James McAvoy stars as Edmond Murray, with Claire Foy as his former wife Joan, alongside Tom Cullen and Gary Lewis. As in the original, the lead actor was given no script or dialogue, only his character's backstory, and improvised his way through the shoot. Filmed in Scotland in late 2020, it was released by Peacock in September 2021 and later on The Roku Channel.

Edmond, a largely absent father, is summoned to the remote campsite where his young son Ethan has vanished. He briefly comforts Joan, joins a search party and is questioned by Inspector Roy. Visiting Joan's new partner Frank, he grows enraged on discovering that Frank's plans for a new home include no room for Ethan, and that Frank has given Joan a sedative to help her sleep. Suspecting Frank of involvement, Edmond knocks him unconscious. He is arrested but released without charge. Inspector Roy then quietly tells him that he has been removed from the case without explanation.

Searching Frank's phone, which he took during the fight, Edmond notices the same car lurking in the background of two videos of Ethan filmed two weeks apart. With help from Joan's brother, who works in insurance, he traces the owner to an isolated farm. There he ambushes the man, William O'Connor, ties him up and tortures him with a blowtorch until he confesses to photographing children outside schools for a paedophile kidnapping ring whose members select the children to be taken. O'Connor reveals that Ethan is being held at a hilltop lodge. Meanwhile, Joan arrives at the farm and finds another kidnapped girl unconscious in O'Connor's vehicle, and after taking her to hospital, follows Edmond's directions to the lodge and alerts Roy.

At the lodge, Edmond disables the kidnappers' vehicle as they prepare to move the drugged Ethan, then evades the men in a deadly game of cat and mouse, during which one of them accidentally shoots another. He finds his son and escapes with Joan, but is shot as they flee. Some time later, Edmond is allowed a brief outing with Ethan and Joan before Roy takes him back into custody, assuring him that the network is being dismantled and that the judge will likely be lenient.

Reviews were mixed to negative, with critics faulting the thin plot that resulted from the improvised approach; Rotten Tomatoes gave it 38%.

documents.title: Umma
documents.tagline: A mother’s love never dies.
documents.overview: Amanda and her daughter live a quiet life on an American farm, but when the remains of her estranged mother arrive from Korea, Amanda becomes haunted by the fear of turning into her own mother.
documents.plot:
Umma (Korean: 엄마, Eomma) is a supernatural horror film from 2022, written and directed by Iris K. Shim and produced by Sam Raimi. Sandra Oh stars as Amanda, a single mother haunted by her own mother's ghost on an isolated farm, with Fivel Stewart as her daughter Chrissy, MeeWha Alana Lee as Amanda's mother and Tom Yi, Dermot Mulroney and Odeya Rush.

Amanda, a Korean immigrant, lives on a remote farm with her homeschooled daughter Chrissy, keeping bees, selling honey and raising chickens. They live without modern technology because Amanda claims to suffer an "allergy" to electricity and electronics. Chrissy, to her dismay, wants to go to college. Then her uncle, Mr. Kang, arrives from Korea with a suitcase containing the ashes of her estranged mother, her Umma, who has recently died, and Amanda is overwhelmed by memories of an abusive childhood. Her mother had raised her alone in the United States, unable to speak English and isolated from her own culture. Amanda's supposed allergy was in fact invented after Umma repeatedly punished her with electric shocks, and in breaking with her mother she also abandoned her Korean heritage, even her family name. Before leaving, Mr. Kang reproaches her for deserting her mother and her heritage, and for failing to teach Chrissy the Korean language and traditions.

Soon after the ashes arrive, a malevolent spirit appears, determined to take over Amanda's body. She is plagued by visions of tormented spirits, including her mother's, and encounters a kumiho that has been devouring her chickens. Growing paranoid, she fears she is turning into her mother, and when she tries to bury the ashes, Umma possesses her. Chrissy finds her mother wearing a mask and hanbok as she performs the jesa, and is attacked, escaping only by pleading for her life. Amanda then confronts her mother's spirit and forgives her, recognising how unfair it was for Umma to raise a child alone in a foreign country while insisting that this did not excuse the abuse. Having come to the same understanding, Umma is finally able to find peace. Amanda embraces her heritage, shares it with her daughter and accepts Chrissy's need to make her own life.

Production was delayed by the COVID-19 pandemic, and Sony Pictures Releasing opened the film in the United States on March 18, 2022, where it earned under $1 million in its first weekend. Reviews were mixed (32% on Rotten Tomatoes); critics praised Oh but found the film clichéd.

documents.title: Merlin's Apprentice
documents.overview: The great sorcerer Merlin has returned to Camelot, a kingdom now vulnerable to ill fates and war since the theft of the Holy Grail, its greatest gift and protection. With the help of Jack, an irascible young beggar-thief imbued with his own unruly magic, the fight against unknown dangers begins-to find the Grail, restore it to its rightful place, and bring Camelot back to its glory days.
documents.plot:
Merlin's Apprentice is a 2006 fantasy miniseries made for the Hallmark Channel, directed by David Wu from a script by Roger Soffer and Christian Ford. A sequel to the 1998 miniseries Merlin, it brings back Sam Neill and Miranda Richardson as the wizard Merlin and the Lady of the Lake. John Reardon plays the young thief Jack, with Meghan Ory, Christopher Jacot and Tegan Moss in supporting roles. Loosely drawn from Arthurian legend, it is set after the death of King Arthur and takes liberties with the traditional stories.

Content with the state of Camelot, Merlin retires for what he intends to be a restorative sleep of a few months, only to wake fifty years later. Nearly everyone he knew is dead, the kingdom is run by Lord Weston, and the Holy Grail has vanished from the castle, leaving Camelot weak, although Merlin's enchantments still keep invaders out. Into the city slips Jack, a vagrant thief with a pet pig named Sir Snout and a raw talent for magic. After catching him trying to steal his wand, Merlin takes Jack on as an apprentice when both share a vision of the Grail. Jack soon discovers that the squire Brian is really a young woman, Brianna, in disguise to avenge a wrong done to her family. Merlin learns in a vision that the Lady of the Lake enchanted him into his long sleep and that Jack is their son. Guided by the Lady, a barbarian army led by Rauskaug enters Camelot through a secret passage. Merlin and Jack conjure a magical bridge to lead the townspeople to safety, but the effort drains the wizard, who stays behind and is killed.

In the second part, the survivors wander the countryside for months searching for the Grail while the barbarians pursue them. Through Jack's visions it emerges that Yvonne, who is promised to Lord Weston, is not truly the granddaughter of Sir Gawain, and that her guardian Master Burton and Weston grew rich by oppressing the surrounding people, the source of Brianna's grudge. Jack and Brianna fall in love, and when Burton schemes to sell Yvonne and the citizens to a Scottish king, Brianna kills him and his wife. In the Grail's cave, the corrupt Weston touches the cup and turns to dust, while Jack rejects his mother's offer of power and asks only that the Grail end the slaughter outside. Moved by his selflessness, it restores the fallen, Camelot begins to be rebuilt, and Jack is allowed a reunion with his father in the land of the dead.

documents.title: Night at the Museum: Kahmunrah Rises Again
documents.original_title: Night at the Museum: Kahmunrah Rises Again
documents.tagline: Same shift. Different night.
documents.overview: Nick Daley is following in his father's footsteps as night watchman at the American Museum of Natural History, so he knows what happens when the sun goes down. But when the maniacal ruler Kahmunrah escapes, it is up to Nick to save the museum once and for all.
documents.plot:
Night at the Museum: Kahmunrah Rises Again is a 2022 animated fantasy comedy directed by Matt Danner and written by Ray DeLaurentis and Will Schifrin. The first animated entry in the Night at the Museum series and a spin-off of Secret of the Tomb (2014), it is also the first animated feature from Atomic Cartoons. Joshua Bassett voices Nick Daley, with Joseph Kamal as Kahmunrah, alongside Thomas Lennon, Zachary Levi, Gillian Jacobs, Alice Isaaz, Jack Whitehall, Bowen Yang and Steve Zahn. It was released on Disney+ on December 9, 2022.

At the American Museum of Natural History, the living exhibits keep frightening away new night guards. Teddy Roosevelt and Sacagawea suggest that Larry Daley's teenage son Nick should take the job, and Larry, about to leave to set up a museum in Japan for the summer, reluctantly agrees and convinces his ex-wife Erica to allow it. Nick lacks confidence: he wants to be the DJ in his school's jazz recital to get closer to his crush, Mia, but is sure he has already blown his chance.

Reunited with old friends among the exhibits, including Rexy the dinosaur skeleton, Attila the Hun, the miniature cowboy Jedediah and Roman general Octavius, the caveman Laaa and Dexter the monkey, as well as the newly arrived Joan of Arc, Nick is given one task: to lock the basement storeroom. Scared off by its eerie contents, he blocks the door with a statue and runs. Kahmunrah, the pharaoh imprisoned there, escapes and steals the magical tablet that brings the exhibits to life, planning to use it to conquer the world.

After a chase through the museum, Kahmunrah gets away, and Nick and his friends pursue him while Rexy guards the building. Guided by Joan's visions, they track him to an art museum hosting the Temple of Dendur, where he awakens Seth, the god of chaos, and the villains escape into a painting of ancient Egypt. Nick and his team follow them down the Nile as the night runs out, while Nick blames himself and is encouraged by the others.

At the temple, after surviving a series of traps, they confront Kahmunrah and Seth, who play a melody on the tablet that summons an army of jackals. Overcoming his self-doubt, Nick plays the notes backwards, causing the tablet to suck away the jackals, Seth and Kahmunrah, and the group return through a poster just before sunrise. Nick wins his place in the recital, starts dating Mia and accepts the job of night guard. Reviews were moderately positive, with 77% approval on Rotten Tomatoes.

documents.title: Angela's Christmas Wish
documents.overview: A determined Angela makes a wish to reunite her family in time for Christmas, then launches a plan to find her way from Ireland to Australia.
documents.plot:
Angela's Christmas Wish is a heartwarming animated film produced by Brown Bag Films, released in 2020. The movie follows the story of Angela, a young girl who lives with her grandmother, Granny May, in a small Irish village.

The story begins on Christmas Eve, where Angela is struggling to come to terms with the fact that she will be spending Christmas alone this year. Her parents have gone away for work, and she's feeling lonely and left out. As she's walking through the snowy streets of her village, she stumbles upon a mysterious old shop called "The Wish Shop." The shop is run by an eccentric old man named Mr. Jenkins, who claims to grant wishes to those who believe in them.

Angela is immediately drawn to the shop and decides to make a wish for a family Christmas. However, things take a surprising turn when she discovers that her wish has been granted, but not in the way she expected. Instead of having a traditional family Christmas with her parents, Angela finds herself transported to a magical world where she meets a group of children who are also waiting for their wishes to be granted.

As Angela navigates this new world, she learns valuable lessons about the true meaning of Christmas and the importance of kindness, generosity, and believing in oneself. Along the way, she befriends a young boy named Finn, who becomes her ally and companion on this magical journey.

Throughout the movie, Angela faces various challenges and obstacles as she tries to find a way back home. However, with the help of Mr. Jenkins and the other children in the magical world, she eventually discovers that the true magic of Christmas lies within herself and those around her.

The ending of the movie is heartwarming and uplifting, as Angela returns home to find that her wish has been granted in a way that brings her even closer to her family. The movie concludes with Angela reflecting on what she's learned about the importance of believing in oneself and the power of kindness and generosity during the holiday season.

Overall, Angela's Christmas Wish is a delightful animated film that celebrates the spirit of Christmas and the magic of believing in oneself. With its beautiful animation, engaging storyline, and lovable characters, it's a must-watch for families and fans of animated films alike.

documents.title: The Other Side
documents.overview: A dad moves into a new house with his son and girlfriend. When he's out of town working, the son makes a new "friend" next doors.
documents.plot:
The Other Side (Swedish: Andra sidan), released internationally as The Evil Next Door, is a 2020 Swedish supernatural horror film and the first feature from writer-directors Oskar Mellander and Tord Danielsson. Dilan Gwyn stars as Shirin, with Linus Wahlgren as her boyfriend Fredrik, Eddie Eriksson Dominguez as his young son Lukas, Henrik Norlén as Peter Lindvall, Karin Holmberg as the teacher Katja and Janna Granström as the neighbour Julia; the contortionist Troy James plays the monster.

After his wife dies of cancer, Fredrik tries to start over by buying one half of a semi-detached house and moving in with Lukas, aged five, and Shirin. Lukas senses that another child once lived in his new room and becomes agitated when Shirin opens a nailed-shut hatch to the attic. Fredrik then takes a job that keeps him away except at weekends, leaving Shirin alone with a boy who still grieves for his mother and who asks whether dead people can come back. When a ball rolls through a gap in the hedge from next door, Lukas decides he has a new friend and begins talking to him through the wall, even though the other half of the house has been empty for years.

The strangeness grows. Lukas is terrified by a creature in the attic, and Shirin hears knocking at night, though police find nothing next door. A neighbour tells her that the previous owners' child vanished without warning, a baby monitor shows a ghostly boy in Lukas's room, and in the empty house she finds a door opening onto a large hole in the floor. Fredrik blames her, but she traces the missing child, Kim, and visits the former owner, Peter Lindvall, whose wife broke down after the loss. Lukas says his friend is kind and wants to stop an old man from taking him too. One night the creature tries to drag Lukas into the attic; after he is treated in hospital, Fredrik throws Shirin out. Visiting Mrs. Lindvall, she learns from a photograph that Kim was a girl and so cannot be Lukas's friend. Returning as the monster carries Lukas off, she follows him down into the hole, faces the creature and claims the boy as hers, and it disappears. Holding Lukas, she sings his mother's lullaby for the first time.

The film opened in Swedish cinemas on 23 October 2020 and was released abroad by Magnet Releasing in 2021. Reviews were mixed: critics credited its moody Scandinavian atmosphere and some effective scares but found it derivative, with thinly drawn characters.

documents.title: The Commando
documents.tagline: Only one will survive.
documents.overview: An elite DEA agent returns home after a failed mission when his family makes an unexpected discovery in their house – a stash of money worth $3 million. They soon face the danger and threat of a newly released criminal and his crew, who will do whatever it takes to retrieve the money, including kidnap the agent’s daughters. Stakes are high and lives are at risk in this head-to-head battle as the agent stops at nothing to protect his family against the money-hungry criminals.
documents.plot:
The Commando is a 2022 American action crime film directed by Asif Akbar, starring Michael Jai White as DEA agent James Baker and Mickey Rourke as the career criminal Johnny, with Jeff Fahey as the local sheriff, Brendan Fehr, Gianni Capaldi, Donald Cerrone and Aris Mejía as Baker's wife Lisa. The film is a home-invasion thriller about a traumatized agent defending his family from a gang searching for stolen money.

James Baker, an elite agent, leads a DEA tactical team in a raid on a Mexican cartel's drug lab. The criminals are eliminated, but Baker accidentally kills three hostages, a mother and her two daughters. Suffering from post-traumatic stress disorder, with nightmares and hallucinations that blur the line between reality and illusion, he is sent home to recover with his wife and two teenage daughters.

Unknown to the family, their house was once used by Johnny, a criminal who hid three million dollars in stolen money there before going to prison. Johnny survives an attempt on his life by fellow inmates shortly before his release, and once free he reunites with his old crew to recover the cash and enlists the help of his old friend, the town sheriff, who tries to get Baker out of the way with an unsigned arrest warrant. Meanwhile, Baker's daughters discover hidden stashes of money in the house. When Baker and Lisa leave for a quiet weekend away, the younger daughter throws a house party, and Johnny's men move in, killing guests and taking over the house. Learning that his daughters are in danger, Baker races home, determined to stop the criminals at any cost.

The film pairs its action with the theme of a soldier struggling with trauma, though critics found its execution weak.

The Commando was released in the United States on January 7, 2022, by Saban Films. Reviews were negative: Variety called it a talky and lethargic home-invasion thriller padded with banal dialogue and irrelevant characters, and The Guardian gave it one star out of five, citing its many implausibilities and clichés.

documents.title: V/H/S/94
documents.tagline: 5 New Tapes. 1 Nightmare.
documents.overview: A mysterious VHS tape leads a police S.W.A.T. team to the discovery of a sinister cult whose collection of pre-recorded material reveals a nightmarish conspiracy.
documents.plot: After the discovery of a mysterious VHS tape, a brutish police SWAT team launches a high-intensity raid on a remote warehouse, only to discover a sinister cult compound whose collection of pre-recorded material uncovers a nightmarish conspiracy.

documents.title: Secrets of the Saqqara Tomb
documents.overview: This documentary follows a team of local archaeologists excavating never before explored passageways, shafts, and tombs, piecing together the secrets of Egypt’s most significant find in almost 50 years in Saqqara.
documents.plot:
Secrets of the Saqqara Tomb is a 2020 British documentary film directed by James Tovell and produced by At Land Productions and Lion Television. It follows a team of Egyptian archaeologists as they excavate a tomb dating to the 25th century BC in the vast Saqqara necropolis outside Cairo, a burial that had remained sealed and untouched for some 4,400 years. The Egyptologist Salima Ikram is among those who appear on screen. Netflix released the film on October 28, 2020.

The documentary centers on a local excavation team led by the Egyptologist Mohammad Mohammad Youssef, as they explore a series of passageways, burial shafts and chambers that had never been entered in modern times. The tomb belongs to Wahtye, a high-ranking priest who served during the Fifth Dynasty of Egypt's Old Kingdom, and to members of his family. Its walls are decorated with vividly colored reliefs and painted scenes, preserved in remarkable condition, along with dozens of carved statues of the priest and his relatives. The discovery was hailed as one of the most significant Egyptian finds in nearly half a century.

As the excavation progresses, the cameras follow the team through the painstaking work of clearing the shafts, often descending deep underground in difficult and dangerous conditions. The archaeologists recover a rich collection of artifacts, including personal possessions, statues, pottery and the mummified remains of members of the priest's family, as well as an unexpected find of a mummified lion cub. The documentary interweaves the progress of the dig with an investigation into who Wahtye was, how he and his family lived and died, and what their tomb reveals about religious beliefs and daily life in ancient Egypt. Specialists examine the human remains to learn about the family's health and causes of death, and the team tries to determine whether the people buried in the shafts are indeed Wahtye and his relatives.

The film emphasizes the role of Egyptian archaeologists in uncovering their own country's history, and it captures the excitement and tension of the moment when sealed chambers and sarcophagi are opened for the first time. The discovery of the tomb was announced publicly by Egyptian antiquities officials in late 2018 and drew international attention, and the documentary offers an extended behind-the-scenes account of the excavation that followed.

documents.title: Around the World in 80 Days
documents.original_title: Le Tour du monde en 80 jours
documents.tagline: Adventure is heading off the map!
documents.overview: Passepartout is a young and scholarly marmoset who always dreams of becoming an explorer. One day, he crosses paths with Phileas, a reckless and greedy frog, eager to take on a bet to circumnavigate the globe in 80 days and earn 10 million clams in the process. Seizing the opportunity of a lifetime to explore the world, Passepartout embarks with his new friend on a crazy and exhilarating adventure full of twists and surprises.
documents.plot:
Around the World in 80 Days (Le Tour du monde en 80 jours) is a 2021 French-Belgian computer-animated adventure comedy loosely based on Jules Verne's 1873 novel, recasting its heroes as animals. It marks the feature directing debut of Samuel Tourneux, working from a screenplay by Gerry Swallow and David Michel, and was produced by Cottonwood Media with StudioCanal, France 3 Cinéma, uMedia and uFund, with animation by Circus and Mac Guff. The French voice cast features Damien Frette as Phileas Frog, Julien Crampon as Passepartout, Kaycie Chase as Aouda, Céline Ronté as Fix and Véronique Augereau as Passepartout's mother; the English dub stars Rob Tinkler and Cory Doran.

Passepartout is a naive but bright young marmoset who idolizes Juan Frog de Leon, a famous explorer who once went around the world in 90 days. He longs for adventure, but his overprotective mother keeps him on a tight leash and has even moved the family to a dull town to cure him of his wanderlust. One day Phileas Frog, a lanky, boastful frog who is a skilled surfer as well as a reckless con artist, washes up on the beach and brags that he can circle the globe in only 80 days, accepting a wager worth ten million clams. Seeing the chance of a lifetime, Passepartout slips away from his mother and joins him. Their race takes the mismatched pair through a string of colorful lands, where they meet characters such as Aouda and Fix and run into trouble with a band of scorpions, while the bond between the timid dreamer and the self-serving trickster gradually deepens. The film's "world" is eventually revealed to be just an island.

Tourneux and the producers began developing the project in 2016, and it was presented to buyers at Cannes in 2019 under the working title Around the World. Tourneux combined 3D animation with 2D effects for water and smoke and imagined a steampunk animal society whose machines are made from wood, leaves, shells, rocks and sand; around 17,000 storyboard drawings were produced. After a screening at the Annecy festival in June 2021, it opened in France on 4 August 2021. With about 763,000 admissions abroad, it was the top-grossing French-language film in foreign markets that year. Reviews were modest: The Guardian gave it three stars, calling it gentle and goofy despite some cultural stereotyping and uneven water animation, while Abus de Ciné praised its look but found its animal version of society uninventive.

documents.title: Toys of Terror
documents.overview: A big family moves into a dusty old house in the snowy woods of Washington with hopes of it being a nice holiday escape. But the kids soon discover a stash of old toys that just so happen to belong to a creepy ghost boy. As stranger and stranger things start to happen, some of the kids begin to sense that something in the house is not quite right…
documents.plot:
Toys of Terror is a 2020 American Christmas horror film directed by Nicholas Verso and written by Dana Gould, a writer on The Simpsons. Released by Warner Bros. on digital platforms on 27 October 2020, it stars Kyana Teresa, Georgia Waters, Dayo Ade, Saul Elias, Zoe Fish and Verity Marks, with Ernie Pitts and Lauren Mary Marshall. Its killer toys are brought to life largely through stop-motion animation, in a nod to the Rankin/Bass holiday specials.

In a prologue, Helen Modig (Marshall), devastated by the death of her ten-year-old son Jason at the Saint Germaine Children's Clinic, curses a trunk of toys and leaves it on the building's doorstep; on Christmas morning all the other children at the clinic are found dead. Years later, house flipper Hannah Cashman (Teresa) buys the mountainside property to renovate with her contractor Emmett (Pitts), and brings her husband David (Ade), his 15-year-old daughter Alicia (Marks), her young children Zoe (Fish) and Franklin (Elias) and their nanny Rose (Waters) to spend Christmas there. Zoe and Franklin find the trunk, which holds a plush bee, a dinosaur helmet that distorts the wearer's voice, a remote-control car, action figures, a fez-wearing doll called Uncle Monkey and a retro video game console. The younger children begin behaving strangely as the toys sing and dance for them in secret, while Alicia and Rose, who is still haunted by a miscarriage, glimpse the ghost of a little boy. Alicia nearly chokes as Franklin watches, and her video game mirrors events in the house. On Christmas Eve the bee lures Emmett into the attic, where he falls through the floor and is impaled; David is injured in a crash while driving him to hospital. The toys wreck the living room, Uncle Monkey starts a fire, and Christmas decorations attack Hannah until Alicia fights them off. The toys then try to persuade Zoe and Franklin to jump from the attic window to join the dead children. Hannah stops them and Rose helps Alicia lock the toys back in the trunk, but Uncle Monkey stabs Rose, who falls to her death. With David back, the family burn the trunk and leave, while Rose's ghost becomes a kindly carer for the dead children.

Critics found it pleasant but slight. Meagan Navarro of Bloody Disgusting called the stop-motion toys surprisingly charming and the film full of heart, though never scary, with a thin mythology and stilted script. Culture Crypt found it competently made but generic.

documents.title: The Last Manhunt
documents.tagline: In 1909, they entered the desert. Now, the truth will finally emerge.
documents.overview: In 1909, Willie Boy and his love Carlota go on the run after he accidentally shoots her father in a confrontation gone terribly wrong. With President Taft coming to the area, the local sheriff leads two Native American trackers seeking justice for their “murdered” tribal leader.
documents.plot:
The Last Manhunt is a 2022 American Western directed by Christian Camargo and written by Thomas Pa'a Sibbett from a story by Sibbett and Jason Momoa, who also served as an executive producer. It retells the legend of Willie Boy, previously filmed as Tell Them Willie Boy Is Here with Robert Redford, drawing on Native accounts. Martin Sensmeier stars as Willie Boy, with Mainei Kinimaka as Carlota, Zahn McClarnon as her father William, Raoul Max Trujillo as Hyde, Camargo as Sheriff Wilson and Momoa as Big Jim.

In 1909, Willie Boy, a young Paiute man, and Carlota slip away together during a Ghost Dance, only to be caught by her father, who objects because the two are cousins. In a struggle over a gun, William is accidentally shot dead. His wife urges the couple to run, but she later asks the sheriff to pursue them. The lovers flee across the desert, and blame for the killing falls on them. Wilson leads a posse of white men and Native trackers, insisting that Willie be taken alive. Hyde, William's friend, wants Willie dead.

After days on the run, Carlota is bitten by a snake and falls ill. Willie leaves her at Ruby Mountain and goes to Clara True for medicine. While he is gone, a member of the posse spots Carlota from a distance, mistakes her for Willie and shoots her dead. Willie lures the posse into a desert enclosure ringed by cliffs and fires down on them, aiming only at their horses. When the sheriff shouts that Carlota is dead, Willie holds his rifle under his chin but decides to keep running. The posse then stages a photograph of Willie's death for the newspapers, with Big Jim posing as the corpse. Closing text, based on Chemehuevi oral history, says that Willie survived, lived in isolation near Pahrump, Nevada, and later died of tuberculosis. It adds that the pair covered some 600 miles in about 26 days, the last great manhunt of the Wild West, and that press claims that Willie killed Carlota were false.

The film opened the Pioneertown International Film Festival in May 2022. Saban Films acquired worldwide rights that June and released it in November. Reviews were largely negative, and Rotten Tomatoes reported 20% approval from a small number of critics. Luke Y. Thompson of The A.V. Club praised the scenery around Joshua Tree and welcomed the film's correction of the historical record but found the lovers underdeveloped and the storytelling meandering. He noted that Momoa appears in only a few scenes.

documents.title: Mrs. Harris Goes to Paris
documents.tagline: Follow your dream.
documents.overview: A 1950s London cleaning lady falls in love with an haute couture dress by Christian Dior and decides to gamble everything for the sake of this folly.
documents.plot:
Mrs. Harris Goes to Paris is a 2022 British comedy-drama film directed by Annette Badland and written by Simon Stephenson. The movie stars Lesley Manville as the titular character, Mrs. Harris.

The story begins with Mrs. Harris (Lesley Manville), a working-class housewife living in London during World War II. She is married to a kind but unambitious man named Fred (Lupita Nyong'o's real-life husband, David Oyelowo plays her husband in the film) and has two children. Despite her humble life, Mrs. Harris dreams of owning a famous handbag, specifically the iconic Hermès Birkin bag.

One day, while on a trip to Paris with her husband, Mrs. Harris discovers that she is the long-lost daughter of Madame du Barry (Claire Foy), the last mistress of King Louis XV of France. This revelation sets off a chain of events as Mrs. Harris learns about her royal heritage and decides to claim her rightful place in society.

As Mrs. Harris navigates her new identity, she becomes obsessed with acquiring the famous Hermès Birkin bag, which she believes will bring her the respect and status she deserves. She begins to build relationships with influential people in Parisian high society, including a wealthy businessman named André (Adrien Brody) who becomes her ally.

Throughout the film, Mrs. Harris faces numerous challenges as she tries to balance her humble background with her newfound aspirations. Despite facing rejection and ridicule from those around her, Mrs. Harris remains determined to achieve her goal of owning the Hermès Birkin bag.

As the story unfolds, Mrs. Harris's relationships with André and other characters become increasingly complex. She must confront her own insecurities and learn to navigate the complexities of high society. In the end, Mrs. Harris achieves her dream of owning the Hermès Birkin bag, but not without learning valuable lessons about identity, class, and the true meaning of success.

The film features a strong performance from Lesley Manville as Mrs. Harris, who brings depth and nuance to the character. The supporting cast, including Lupita Nyong'o, Adrien Brody, and Claire Foy, deliver solid performances that add to the film's humor and charm.

Overall, Mrs. Harris Goes to Paris is a heartwarming and humorous tale of self-discovery and empowerment. With its witty dialogue, colorful characters, and stunning settings, the film is a delightful treat for audiences looking for a lighthearted and entertaining cinematic experience.

documents.title: The Last Journey
documents.overview: The red moon threatens our existence on earth. Our only hope is the enigmatic Paul WR, the most talented astronaut of its generation. But few hours before the start of the mission, Paul disappears.
documents.plot:
The Last Journey (French: Le Dernier Voyage), also known as The Last Journey of Paul W.R., is a 2020 French science fiction film directed by Romain Quirot, who expanded it from his own short film The Last Journey of the Enigmatic Paul W.R. Hugo Becker stars as the astronaut Paul W.R., with Jean Reno as his father Henri, Paul Hamy as his brother Eliott, Lya Oussadit-Lessert as the teenager Elma, and Philippe Katerine, Bruno Lochet and Émilie Gavois-Kahn in supporting roles.

The story is set in a near future in which the Earth has become almost uninhabitable. Temperatures have soared to unbearable levels, most animal species have died out, hundreds of millions of people have been forced to flee as climate refugees, and the world's reserves of oil, coal and gas have run dry. Some time earlier a mysterious new planet appeared in the sky. Humanity went to enormous lengths to reach it and mine Lumina, an extraordinarily powerful mineral that transformed science and made every other source of energy obsolete.

Now the planet is on a collision course with Earth, and only one man is believed capable of saving the world: Paul W.R., the celebrated astronaut chosen to lead a mission to stop it. Yet only hours before the launch he vanished without a trace, and since then a desperate humanity has been hunting him relentlessly. Paul has his own reasons for not wanting the planet destroyed, even as ecological catastrophe closes in, and he is haunted by fragments of memories he has lost.

On the run, Paul crosses paths with Elma, a resourceful teenage girl, and the two make their way together across the scorched desert that France has become, while he tries to piece together his past. Pursuing them is his brother Eliott, who was left with the power to read and control the minds of others after an accident. Eliott is determined to bring Paul home for the mission at any cost, ruthlessly using his ability to force people who stand in his way to kill themselves, and he tracks the fugitives with the help of a spider-like drone that reports their position to him.

The film premiered at the Angoulême Francophone Film Festival on 1 September 2020 and had its international premiere at the Sitges Film Festival the following month, before opening in French cinemas on 19 May 2021. The German Filmdienst described it as a dystopian science fiction adventure blending elements of road movie and family drama, if at times somewhat confusing.

documents.title: Son
documents.tagline: You can't outrun a family secret.
documents.overview: When a young boy contracts a mysterious illness, his mother must decide how far she will go to protect him from terrifying forces in her past.
documents.plot:
Son is a 2021 Irish-American horror thriller written and directed by Ivan Kavanagh. Andi Matichak stars as Laura, a woman who escaped from a cult, with Emile Hirsch as the police detective Paul, Luke David Blumm as her son David, Cranston Johnson and Blaine Maye. It was released in March 2021.

While fleeing a cult by car, Laura goes into labor and gives birth to a boy at the side of the road. Eight years later she lives a quiet life in a small town with her son, David. One night, checking on him, she sees a group of strangers standing around his bed before the door slams shut and locks. She runs to her neighbor Susan for help, but when she returns the intruders have vanished and David lies in bed, looking ill. Two police officers respond: Paul is sympathetic, while his partner Steve suspects that Laura is delusional. Paul gives her his card and asks her to call if anything else happens.

That night David vomits blood and is rushed to the hospital, where doctors cannot identify the cause of his illness and warn that he may not survive. Laura has dreams about her past with the cult, including a banner reading "He Is Coming." When she wakes, David has suddenly recovered. Back home, she tells Paul that she plans to sell the house and leave town; he urges her to stay, and they grow close, until David is seized by violent convulsions. Readmitted to hospital, David is again failing, and after overhearing a suspicious conversation among the doctors, Laura takes him and flees. On the run, she discovers that the only thing that can keep her son alive is human flesh and blood, and she is forced to commit terrible acts to sustain him while Paul, torn between his duty and his feelings, tries to find them, and the cult closes in.

Son received generally positive reviews, with a 79 percent approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus called it a horror story with unexpected emotional resonance that uses its familial focus to counter a certain queasy familiarity. On Metacritic it scored 54. Critics praised Matichak's committed performance, while Common Sense Media's Jeffrey M. Anderson was less impressed, rating it two out of five.

documents.title: The Monster at the End of This Story
documents.original_title: The Monster at the End of This Story
documents.overview: The Monster at the End of This Story is Sesame Street special on HBO Max.
documents.plot:
The Monster at the End of This Story is a 2020 American animated musical television special produced by Sesame Workshop and directed by Mark Taylor, which premiered on the streaming service HBO Max on 29 October 2020. Running about half an hour and rated TV-Y, it adapts Sesame Street's best-selling 1971 picture book The Monster at the End of This Book, in which Grover discovers that a monster awaits him at the end of the book he is starring in. The Sesame Street puppeteers provide the voices of the animated characters, with Eric Jacobson, Ryan Dillon, Leslie Carrara-Rudolph, David Rudman and Carmen Osbahr in the cast and Stephanie D'Abruzzo voicing Grover's Mommy.

Grover learns that there will be a monster at the end of the story he is in, and, filled with dread, he tries everything he can to avoid meeting it. As in the book, he breaks the fourth wall, pleading with the viewer to stop watching and attempting to block the story's progress, for example by building a brick wall or tying up the screen with string. To fill out the longer format, he is joined by Elmo and by his friends Cookie Monster, Rosita and Abby Cadabby, who take his fear seriously while sharing their own experiences, such as Cookie Monster overcoming his fear of broccoli. Grover sings with Elmo about what fear feels like in the body, and Rosita, Cookie Monster and Abby sing about how courage helps you try new things, offering simple techniques such as taking a deep breath and telling yourself that you can do it. Grover also gets hold of a magical rewind control and travels back before the story began, revisiting moments in his own past when he overcame his fears, such as learning to ride a bicycle without training wheels with the support of his mother. Encouraged by his friends, he finally reaches the end of the story and, true to the book's twist, discovers that the monster was Grover himself all along, a revelation he celebrates with a musical number.

Reviews were mixed. Ashley Moulton of Common Sense Media named it a Common Sense Selection, finding that it exceeded expectations and praising its timely lessons about fear and courage. Matthew Soberman of ToughPigs called it a lovely, creative special with meta humor and an emotional core, though he was conflicted about the move from puppetry to animation. Nathan Rabin of Fatherly argued that the added friends, songs and time travel padded the story and diluted the lonely, existential power of the original book.

documents.title: Miraculous World: New York, United HeroeZ
documents.original_title: Miraculous World : New York, les héros unis
documents.tagline: New city. Same duty.
documents.overview: During a school field trip, Ladybug and Cat Noir meet the American superheroes, whom they have to save from an akumatised super-villain. They discover that Miraculous exist in the United States too.
documents.plot:
Miraculous World: New York, United HeroeZ (Miraculous World : New York, les héros unis) is a 2020 French computer-animated superhero television film directed by Thomas Astruc, the creator of the series Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir. Produced by Zagtoon, Method Animation and SAMG Animation in an international co-production that also involved TF1, Disney and Toei Animation, it was the first of a planned series of Miraculous World specials sending the characters to cities around the world. It premiered on Disney Channel in the United States on 25 September 2020 and in France the following day, and runs about 52 minutes. Anouck Hautbois and Benjamin Bollen voice Ladybug and Cat Noir in French, with Cristina Valenzuela and Bryce Papenbrook in the English version.

Set between the third and fourth seasons, the film follows Marinette Dupain-Cheng and her Parisian classmates on a school trip to New York for French-American Friendship Week. Marinette persuades Adrien Agreste's overprotective father, Gabriel, to let him come along, unaware that Gabriel, secretly the villain Hawk Moth, has his own reasons to travel: a Miraculous has surfaced in New York, an ancient eagle talon he hopes will help him revive his wife. On the flight the students are attacked by the technology-stealing villain Techno-Pirate and rescued by the United HeroeZ, the city's openly public superheroes, among them Majestia, the vigilante Knightowl, his rebellious young protégé Sparrow and the artificial intelligence Uncanny Valley. When Hawk Moth akumatises Techno-Pirate, Ladybug and Cat Noir must join forces with their American counterparts, who are not powered by Miraculouses, while Marinette struggles with her lingering feelings for Adrien.

Critics generally regarded it as an enjoyable outing for fans. Craig Holton of What The Craggus Saw called it slickly animated, wholesomely adventurous and full of invention, a successful leap to feature length that expands the show's mythology, though it offers little help to newcomers. Frédéric Bègue of Chronique Disney praised the comedy and drama between Ladybug and Cat Noir, the new heroes and the action scenes, but found the villain forgettable, the returning supporting characters sidelined and the rushed ending in need of more scenes. Marley Crusch of Bubbleblabber gave it 6 out of 10, deeming it a kids' superhero film that breaks no new ground but is worth watching.

documents.title: Sneakerella
documents.tagline: Lace up and dream.
documents.overview: When El, an aspiring sneaker designer from Queens, meets Kira King, the fiercely independent daughter of legendary basketball star and sneaker tycoon Darius King, sparks fly as the two bond over their mutual affinity for sneakers. With a little nudge from his best friend and a sprinkle of Fairy Godfather magic, El finds the courage to use his talent to pursue his dream of becoming a ‘legit’ sneaker designer in the industry.

documents.title: Riverdance: The Animated Adventure
documents.overview: A young Irish boy named Keegan and Spanish girl named Moya journey into a magical world of the Megaloceros Giganteus who teach them to appreciate Riverdance as a celebration of life. Based on the stage show phenomenon of the same name and featuring Bill Whelan’s multi-platinum Grammy Award-winning music.
documents.plot:
Riverdance: The Animated Adventure is a 2021 animated dance adventure film inspired by the stage show Riverdance, directed by Dave Rosenbaum and Eamonn Butler and made by Cinesite for River Productions and Aniventure. Sam Hardy voices Keegan and Hannah Herman Cortes voices Moya, with Pierce Brosnan in the dual role of Keegan's grandfather and Patrick the deer, Brendan Gleeson as the Huntsman, Aisling Bea as Margot, Lilly Singh and Jermaine Fowler as the deer Penny and Benny, Pauline McLynn and John Kavanagh. The music is by Bill Whelan, who composed the score for the original Riverdance show in the 1990s.

In a seaside village in Ireland, a boy named Keegan spends much of his time at the lighthouse kept by his grandfather, who tells him stories of a Huntsman who seeks to put out the light and of the giant Megaloceros deer who protect it. The two bond over Riverdance, a special dance celebrating life. When his grandfather dies, the grieving Keegan is left to tend the lighthouse, even as Margot, the owner of the local music shop, chooses him to be the DJ at the village's St. Patrick's Day party.

Wandering outside the village, Keegan meets his friend Moya, a Spanish girl who leads him down the river and reveals that she can dance on water. She introduces him to two young Megaloceros, Penny and Benny, who take them to their herd. Keegan joins the deer in a hurling match and befriends their king, Patrick. At Newgrange he encounters the Huntsman, who tries to win him over, but Keegan refuses. Travelling to the sea, Keegan sees a vision of his grandfather, learning, as Moya had with her grandmother, that ancestors appear in this world when one closes one's eyes. The Huntsman catches up with them and offers to spare Keegan in exchange for Patrick's life and antlers. Patrick agrees, and when the Huntsman shoots him, the river stops flowing. Keegan and the deer perform a dance in Patrick's memory that defeats the Huntsman and restores the river. Benny becomes the new king, and Keegan, at peace, relights the lighthouse and joins the St. Patrick's Day celebration.

Cinesite first announced the project in 2016 as part of a slate of animated features, and production began in February 2020 with an estimated budget of €35 million. The film was released in the United Kingdom by Sky Cinema on 28 May 2021 and on Netflix in the United States on 14 January 2022. Reviews were poor: The Irish Times found its idealized Ireland reminiscent of a tourism advertisement.

documents.title: The Black Phone
documents.tagline: Never talk to strangers.
documents.overview: Finney Blake, a shy but clever 13-year-old boy, is abducted by a sadistic killer and trapped in a soundproof basement where screaming is of little use. When a disconnected phone on the wall begins to ring, Finney discovers that he can hear the voices of the killer’s previous victims. And they are dead set on making sure that what happened to them doesn’t happen to Finney.
documents.plot:
The Black Phone is a psychological horror film directed by Scott Derrickson, released in 2022 under Universal Pictures.

The movie takes place in the 1970s and follows the story of Finney Shaw (played by Mason Thames), an 11-year-old boy who lives with his abusive father. One day, while exploring the woods near his home, Finney stumbles upon a mysterious phone booth that seems to be calling him. The voice on the other end is that of a young girl named Abigail (voiced by Madeleine McGraw), who claims to have been kidnapped and murdered.

As Finney continues to communicate with Abigail through the phone booth, he becomes increasingly entangled in her story. He learns that she was taken from her home by a serial killer known as "The Grabber" (played by Bill Skarsgård). The Grabber is a monstrous figure who uses his hook-like hand to grab and kill his victims.

Finney soon realizes that Abigail's spirit is trapped in the phone booth, and he becomes determined to help her find peace. As Finney delves deeper into the mystery of Abigail's disappearance, he also uncovers dark secrets about his own family and their connection to The Grabber.

Throughout the film, Derrickson masterfully weaves together elements of horror, mystery, and coming-of-age drama. The Black Phone features a standout performance from Mason Thames, who brings a sense of vulnerability and determination to Finney's character.

The film's use of the phone booth as a narrative device is also noteworthy. The booth serves as a symbol of communication between Finney and Abigail, but it also represents a kind of liminal space where time and reality are distorted.

Overall, The Black Phone is a tense and unsettling horror film that explores themes of trauma, identity, and the power of human connection. With its atmospheric tension and standout performances, it's a must-see for fans of psychological horror.

documents.title: The Yin-Yang Master: Dream of Eternity
documents.overview: Every few hundred years, the most powerful demon on earth—a snake demon—awakens, and the Yin-Yang Masters are summoned to the capital. Meanwhile, the Princess of the realm has her own plans, as she conspires to claim the demon’s power.

documents.title: The Cellar
documents.tagline: An ancient evil has awoken.
documents.overview: When Keira Woods' daughter mysteriously vanishes in the cellar of their new house in the country, she soon discovers there is an ancient and powerful entity controlling their home that she will have to face or risk losing her family's souls forever.
documents.plot:
The Cellar is a 2022 supernatural horror film written and directed by Brendan Muldowney, starring Elisha Cuthbert and Eoin Macken. An Irish-Belgian co-production, it was shot in Roscommon, Ireland, in November 2020, and premiered at South by Southwest in March 2022 before its release on the streaming service Shudder on 15 April 2022.

Kiera and Brian Woods move into a large old house with their teenage daughter, Ellie, and their young son, Steven. Left alone one evening while their parents are at work, the children find a hidden room in the cellar whose walls are covered in formulas, symbols and artwork, along with a recording of a man reciting equations and slowly counting upward. That night the power goes out, and Kiera, on the phone, guides Ellie down to the cellar's breaker box by counting the steps. Ellie begins to behave strangely, and by the time her parents get home she has vanished. Because Ellie has run away before, the police assume she will come back on her own.

Unconvinced, Kiera investigates the house and one of its former owners, John Fetherston, who also disappeared. She discovers that the symbols spell out "Leviathan" and that the equations describe other dimensions, while strange events increasingly surround her, and a presence nearly traps her when she is lured into the cellar. Brian refuses to believe her. Fetherston's elderly daughter, Rose, explains that her father opened a door to the entity in the hope of curing her brother, Jack, but that it took over the house instead. Brian finds further symbols over the doors that, combined, spell "Baphomet". The demon then seizes Steven, and Kiera is chased into the cellar, which has become an endless corridor. Beyond a door she finds Ellie among many people counting upward. She escapes and reunites with Brian and Steven, but when they try to leave they realize that they are still trapped in the demon's dimension, and the whole family starts counting, Kiera included.

Critics were unimpressed, with only 31% of the 62 reviews collected by Rotten Tomatoes positive and a consensus that called it a musty exercise in second-rate supernatural horror, though not a total failure.

documents.title: Drive My Car
documents.original_title: ドライブ・マイ・カー
documents.tagline: Go on living.
documents.overview: Yusuke Kafuku, a stage actor and director, still unable, after two years, to cope with the loss of his beloved wife, accepts to direct Uncle Vanya at a theater festival in Hiroshima. There he meets Misaki, an introverted young woman, appointed to drive his car. In between rides, secrets from the past and heartfelt confessions will be unveiled.
documents.plot:
Drive My Car is a 2021 Japanese drama film directed by Ryusuke Hamaguchi, produced by Nippon Television Network Corporation and Nippon Music Publishing Co., Ltd. The movie is based on the 2007 play of the same name by Haruki Murakami.

The story revolves around Yusuke Kafuku (played by Hidetoshi Nishijima), a renowned theater director in his late 40s who has recently lost his wife, Oto (played by Vivi Fukunaga). The couple had been married for over 20 years and were deeply devoted to each other. After her passing, Yusuke is struggling to cope with the loss and find meaning in his life.

One day, while attending a friend's funeral, Yusuke meets Misaki Watari (played by Toko Miura), a young woman who was involved in a car accident that killed her husband. The two strike up a conversation, and Yusuke invites Misaki to join him on a road trip to visit the site of the accident.

As they embark on their journey, Yusuke begins to open up about his feelings and experiences with loss. He shares stories about his wife Oto, who was also an avid driver, and how she would often take him on long drives through the countryside. Through these conversations, Misaki starts to form a bond with Yusuke, and he finds himself drawn to her kindness and empathy.

However, their relationship is complicated by the fact that Yusuke has recently started seeing Reiko (played by Masako Kurosawa), a colleague of his who was also involved in a car accident. Reiko's presence creates tension between Yusuke and Misaki, as they both struggle with their own feelings of loss and grief.

Throughout the film, Hamaguchi explores themes of love, loss, and human connection. The title "Drive My Car" is a metaphor for the journey of life, where we must navigate through our emotions and experiences to find meaning and purpose.

As the story unfolds, Yusuke's relationships with Misaki and Reiko become increasingly complex. He begins to realize that his feelings for both women are intertwined, and he must confront the reality of his own desires and emotions.

The film builds towards a poignant conclusion, where Yusuke comes to terms with his past and finds a way to move forward. The ending is intentionally ambiguous, leaving the audience to ponder the complexities of human relationships and the power of love to heal even the deepest wounds.

Overall, Drive My Car is a powerful and moving exploration of the human condition, featuring outstanding performances from its cast and a nuanced direction by Ryusuke Hamaguchi.

documents.title: A Castle for Christmas
documents.tagline: Come home to where your dreams began.
documents.overview: To escape a scandal, a bestselling author journeys to Scotland, where she falls in love with a castle -- and faces off with the grumpy duke who owns it.
documents.plot:
A Castle for Christmas is a heartwarming romantic comedy that explores the theme of finding love and self-discovery during the holiday season. The movie follows the story of a young woman named Sophie, who after a painful breakup, escapes to a small town in Scotland to help her family's struggling inn.

As Sophie navigates this new environment, she meets a handsome and charming local, Nick, who is initially hesitant to open up due to past heartbreaks. However, as they spend more time together, Sophie helps Nick confront his emotional scars, and he begins to let go of his fears and trust again.

Throughout the movie, A Castle for Christmas delves into themes of love, vulnerability, and personal growth. The film shows how Sophie's journey is not just about finding a new partner but also about discovering her own identity, values, and what truly makes her happy. As she immerses herself in the charming Scottish town, Sophie learns to let go of her past and find solace in the present moment.

The movie also touches on the idea of community and belonging, highlighting how Sophie finds a sense of home and acceptance among the quirky locals, who welcome her with open arms. The film's portrayal of small-town life, with its warm atmosphere and strong sense of camaraderie, serves as a beautiful backdrop for Sophie's transformation.

Ultimately, A Castle for Christmas is a feel-good romantic comedy that celebrates the magic of love, self-discovery, and finding one's place in the world.

documents.title: The Yin Yang Master
documents.overview: The world is on the verge of a devastating war with monsters who are coming to retrieve the Scaling Stone. Yin Yang Master Qingming's life is in danger and he travels to different worlds to prepare for the upcoming assaults. On his journey, Qingming finds that the key to all the calamities is embracing his hybrid identity of both human and monster.
documents.plot:
The Yin Yang Master (Chinese: Shi Shen Ling), also known as The Yinyang Master, is a 2021 Chinese fantasy film directed by Li Weiran and starring Chen Kun and Zhou Xun. It is adapted from NetEase's video game Onmyōji, which in turn draws on the Onmyōji novel series by the author Baku Yumemakura. The cast also includes William Chan as Ci Mu, Qu Chuxiao as Yuan Boya, Wang Likun as the Peach Blossom Spirit, Wang Zixuan as the Snow Queen and Wang Ruiyi as the Butterfly Spirit. Filmed in 2018, it was released in Chinese cinemas on 12 February 2021, the first day of the Chinese New Year, and Netflix, which acquired the international streaming rights, released it worldwide on 19 March 2021.

Qing Ming, played by Chen Kun, is a Yinyang Master, a being who is half human and half demon and who serves as an officer of the Yinyang Bureau, the organization that guards captured demon souls and a powerful supernatural artifact known as the Scale Stone. When he is framed for the deaths of a team of guards and of his senior, Ci Mu, he flees the Bureau and begins a new life, moving between the human world and the demon world. Seven years later, as the Demon King threatens to return, Qing Ming becomes entangled in the robbery of a shipment of imperial tributes being escorted by Boya, and he is hunted by Bai Ni, played by Zhou Xun, the head of the Yinyang Bureau, with whom he once made a pact. Trapped together in a fighting arena in the demon world, Qing Ming, an injured Bai Ni, Boya and their companions are forced to cooperate to escape. Bai Ni discovers that Qing Ming has secretly been caring for and training a band of demons to resist the Demon King, and after he heals her, she recovers the Scale Stone, which one of his demons had accidentally swallowed. On her way back to the Bureau, however, she is ambushed by an old enemy and the Snow Queen, and the Stone is stolen. The theft exposes a long-hidden betrayal rooted in envy of Qing Ming's demonic power, unleashes a demon invasion of the human world and forces Qing Ming to consider a dangerous bargain to save both realms.

The film was released in China under the English title The Yinyang Master and reached audiences outside China under the title The Yin Yang Master through its Netflix release.

documents.title: Rise
documents.tagline: A king will come from across the sea.
documents.overview: After emigrating to Greece from Nigeria, Vera and Charles Antetokounmpo struggled to survive and provide for their five children, while living under the daily threat of deportation. Desperate to obtain Greek citizenship but undermined by a system that blocked them at every turn, the family's vision, determination and faith lifted them out of obscurity to launch the careers of three NBA champions.
documents.plot:
Rise is a 2022 American biographical sports drama directed by Akin Omotoso from a screenplay by Arash Amel. It tells the true story of the Nigerian-Greek Antetokounmpo brothers, Giannis, Thanasis and Kostas, who emigrated to the United States and reached the National Basketball Association. Newcomers Uche Agada, Ral Agada and Jaden Osimuwa play the three brothers, with Dayo Okeniyi and Yetide Badaki as their parents, Charles and Veronica, and Elijah Shomanke. Produced by Walt Disney Pictures, it was released on Disney+ on 24 June 2022.

In 1990, Charles and Veronica Adetokunbo leave Nigeria for Greece in search of a better life, forced to leave their eldest son, Francis, behind. Unable to obtain visas, they live without papers and in constant fear of discovery. By 2004 they have settled in Athens and have four more sons, Thanasis, Giannis, Kostas and Alexandros. Although the boys were born in Greece, its nationality laws, based on descent, deny them citizenship, leaving the family at constant risk of deportation and separation. Charles's efforts to obtain documents run into a cruel catch: he needs a visa to work but cannot get the job required for a visa. The family name itself was rendered as Antetokounmpo during immigration processing.

Thanasis and Giannis start playing basketball in a local park. Thanasis has natural talent, while Giannis struggles to learn the game but shows promise. They are invited to train for free at the gym of the club Filathlitikos, where coach Takis Zivas sees potential in both. By 2007 Thanasis is a star player and Giannis has improved dramatically, but the family continues to face hardship, including the loss of opportunities because of their lack of legal status. The boys sell goods on the street to help their parents, while Giannis's remarkable growth and work ethic attract the attention of international scouts. As the 2013 NBA draft approaches, the family must fight for citizenship papers so that Giannis can travel and pursue his dream, which culminates in his selection by the Milwaukee Bucks.

Rise received generally positive reviews, with critics praising its warm portrayal of family, immigration and perseverance, as well as the performances of its young cast, though some found it a conventional and sanitized sports biopic. The real Giannis Antetokounmpo went on to become a two-time NBA Most Valuable Player and to lead the Bucks to the 2021 NBA championship.

documents.title: The Princess
documents.tagline: Bow to no one.
documents.overview: A beautiful, strong-willed young royal refuses to wed the cruel sociopath to whom she is betrothed and is kidnapped and locked in a remote tower of her father’s castle. With her scorned, vindictive suitor intent on taking her father’s throne, the princess must protect her family and save the kingdom.
documents.plot:
The Princess is a 2022 American fantasy action comedy thriller directed by Le-Van Kiet from a screenplay by Ben Lustig and Jake Thornton. Joey King plays the title role, with Dominic Cooper as Julius, Olga Kurylenko as Moira, Veronica Ngo as Linh, Ed Stoppard as the king and Alex Reid as the queen. Katelyn Rose Downey plays her sister, Violet.

In a medieval kingdom, a king and queen have two daughters and no son. With the queen's quiet blessing, the elder princess has been trained in combat by Linh, niece of the royal adviser Khai. The king arranges for her to marry Julius, the ruthless son of a royal diplomat, who scorns the king's peaceful rule and believes a strong monarch should govern with an iron fist. When the princess abandons him at the altar, Julius, his whip-wielding enforcer Moira and a band of brutal mercenaries seize the castle and imprison the royal household, locking the princess in the highest tower until a forced wedding can take place. When two mercenaries come to assault her, she kills them and sets out to rescue her family.

Fighting her way down through the castle, she alerts Julius and Moira, evades their men and reunites with Linh, who escaped the attack. Linh stays behind to hold off Moira as the princess heads for the dungeons, but after she frees her family, they and Linh are recaptured. Still defied, Julius decides to secure the throne by marrying Violet and has the princess thrown into the lake below the castle, while Linh and Violet flee through a hidden door. The princess survives, slips back inside and rejoins them; arming themselves from a secret storeroom, she and Linh battle the mercenaries while Violet frees Khai. Violet is caught and Linh is wounded by Julius, but the princess kills Moira and faces Julius alone. Beaten to her knees, she waits as he gloats, then seizes his sword and beheads him. Convinced of her strength, the king names her heir and decrees that the kingdom's women may choose their own paths.

20th Century Studios acquired Lustig and Thornton's spec script in 2020 as a streaming project, with King among the executive producers. The film premiered on Hulu on July 1, 2022, and ranked among the most-streamed films in the United States over its first weekends. Reviews were mixed: it holds 62% on Rotten Tomatoes and 43 on Metacritic, with critics crediting King as a convincing action lead while faulting the clunky script and modest production values. It was removed from Disney+ and Hulu in May 2023.

documents.title: X
documents.tagline: Dying to show you a good time.
documents.overview: In 1979, a group of young filmmakers set out to make an adult film in rural Texas, but when their reclusive, elderly hosts catch them in the act, the cast find themselves fighting for their lives. Hilarity ensues.
documents.plot:
X is a 2022 American satirical horror film written and directed by Ti West. The film takes place in 1979, during the height of the Texas Chain Saw Massacre phenomenon.

The story follows Pinhura "Pin" Fuentes (played by Breckin Meyer), a young filmmaker who has just arrived in Austin to make a documentary about the infamous Texas Chainsaw Massacre. Pin is accompanied by his girlfriend, Rose (played by Jenna Ortega), and their friend, Jay (played by August Maturo).

Upon arrival, they meet with the enigmatic and charismatic film director, Michael Williams (played by Nick Kroll), who has been making a series of low-budget horror films in the area. Michael is known for his provocative and transgressive style, which often pushes the boundaries of good taste.

As Pin begins to work on his documentary, he becomes increasingly fascinated with Michael's films and the local horror scene. However, things take a dark turn when Pin discovers that Michael has been using real-life events as inspiration for his films, including the murders of several people in the area.

Pin becomes obsessed with uncovering the truth behind Michael's films and the true nature of the Texas horror phenomenon. As he delves deeper into the mystery, he begins to experience strange and terrifying occurrences that blur the lines between reality and fiction.

Throughout the film, West pays homage to the classic horror movies of the 1970s, while also subverting expectations and challenging the audience's perceptions of what is acceptable in the genre. The film features a talented ensemble cast, including Jenna Ortega, Breckin Meyer, and Nick Kroll, who deliver standout performances that add to the film's tension and unease.

Ultimately, X is a thought-provoking and unsettling exploration of the power of horror movies to shape our perceptions of reality and ourselves. The film is a love letter to the genre, while also offering a scathing critique of its excesses and superficiality.

documents.title: Orphan: First Kill
documents.tagline: There's always been something wrong with Esther.
documents.overview: After escaping from an Estonian psychiatric facility, Leena Klammer travels to America by impersonating Esther, the missing daughter of a wealthy family. But when her mask starts to slip, she is put against a mother who will protect her family from the murderous “child” at any cost.
documents.plot:
Orphan: First Kill is a 2022 American psychological horror film directed by William Brent Bell, written by David Leslie Johnson-McGoldrick and Thomas B. Ward, and produced by Dark Castle Entertainment.

The movie serves as a prequel to the 2009 film Orphan, exploring the backstory of Esther (Isabelle Fuhrman), a young girl with a rare genetic disorder that makes her appear to be an adult in a child's body. The story takes place several years before the events of the first film and follows Esther as she is adopted by a couple, John Coleman (Colin O'Donoghue) and Kate Coleman (Alicia Vikander), who are struggling with infertility.

As Esther settles into her new life, she begins to exhibit disturbing behavior, including an unsettling fascination with death and a tendency to manipulate those around her. The Colemans soon realize that they have made a grave mistake in adopting Esther, but they are too invested in their own desires for a child to consider giving her up.

The film's narrative is presented as a series of flashbacks, which slowly reveal the events leading up to Esther's adoption and her subsequent descent into madness. Along the way, we see glimpses of Esther's troubled past, including her experiences with abuse and neglect at the hands of her biological mother.

Throughout the movie, Bell expertly ratchets up the tension, using a combination of atmospheric sound design, unsettling visuals, and Isabelle Fuhrman's chilling performance to create a sense of unease that permeates every scene. The film's climax is both shocking and disturbing, leaving the viewer with a lasting impression of Esther's true nature.

Overall, Orphan: First Kill is a masterclass in building tension and creating a sense of unease, making it a must-see for fans of psychological horror. While it may not be as overtly terrifying as some other films in the genre, its slow-burning intensity makes it all the more unsettling.

documents.title: Separation
documents.tagline: It won't let go.
documents.overview: A young girl finds solace in her artist father and the ghost of her dead mother.
documents.plot:
Separation is a 2021 American supernatural horror film directed by William Brent Bell from a screenplay by Nick Amadeus and Josh Braun. It stars Rupert Friend, Mamie Gummer, Madeline Brewer, Violet McGraw, Simon Quarterman and Brian Cox, and follows a father caring for his young daughter after the sudden death of his estranged wife, as the two are tormented by mysterious spirits.

Jeff Vahn, a struggling illustrator, is divorced from his wife, Maggie, who is seeking sole custody of their daughter, Jenny. Shortly after a heated phone argument with Jeff, Maggie is killed in a hit-and-run. After the funeral, her father, Paul Rivers, prepares to sue for custody, while Jenny withdraws into depression and starts behaving strangely. Unable to reach her, Jeff takes a small job at a comic book company through an old friend, and Jenny's babysitter, Samantha Nally, begins looking after her full-time. The house is haunted: Jeff suffers recurring nightmares of spirits roaming the rooms and falls into trances in which he draws monstrous figures that the ghosts then bring to life. The spirits interact with Jenny, and Jeff becomes convinced that Maggie is controlling them in search of revenge from beyond the grave.

After Jenny survives a severe allergic reaction to her food, Jeff decides to move upstate to be near Paul, and the two men settle the custody dispute amicably, while Jeff earns a promotion at work. A private investigator then tells Paul that Maggie's killer was Samantha, who pushes Paul from the second floor of the house; Jeff calls for help and Paul survives. Samantha confesses that she is in love with Jeff and killed Maggie to protect him, and that she poisoned Jenny's food because the girl stood between them. Jeff realizes that Maggie's ghost has indeed returned for vengeance and leads the other spirits, but that her target is Samantha, not him. Maggie kills Samantha. When Jenny climbs into the attic to speak with her mother, she slips, and Jeff falls with her from the window as he tries to catch her. They wake unhurt on the ground, saved by Maggie, whose spirit finally departs as emergency services arrive.

Open Road Films and Briarcliff Entertainment acquired the film in March 2021 and released it on April 30, 2021, It opened fourth at the box office with $1.8 million. Reviews were overwhelmingly negative; Rotten Tomatoes reported 7% approval, calling it a lifeless divorce drama cosplaying as a horror film.

documents.title: The Lair
documents.tagline: Unlocked. Unleashed.
documents.overview: Royal Air Force pilot Lt. Kate Sinclair is on her final flight mission when her jet is shot down over one of the most dangerous rebel strongholds in Afghanistan. She finds refuge in an abandoned underground bunker where deadly man-made creatures known as Ravagers — half-human, half-alien, and hungry for human flesh — are awakened.
documents.plot:
