documents.title: Watcher
documents.tagline: Evil wants to be seen.
documents.overview: As a serial killer stalks the city, Julia — a young actress who just moved to town with her husband — notices a mysterious stranger watching her from across the street.
documents.plot:
Watcher is a 2022 American psychological thriller written and directed by Chloe Okuno in her feature debut, from an original screenplay by Zack Ford. Set in Bucharest, it follows a young American woman who becomes convinced that a man in the building across the street is watching her while a serial killer stalks the city, and who finds her fears dismissed by those around her.

Julia moves to Bucharest with her husband Francis, and the couple settle into an apartment with a wide picture window. Left alone during his long working days, Julia notices a figure in a window opposite who seems to watch her constantly. Local news reports of "the Spider", a killer who decapitates young women, sharpen her unease, and she becomes sure she is being followed to a theatre and a supermarket, though the store's security footage proves nothing. She befriends her neighbour Irina, a dancer who keeps a pistol given to her by her boyfriend Cristian. When Julia waves at the window and the figure waves back, she calls the police, but Francis concludes she is overreacting. Trailing the man to the strip club where he works as a janitor, she learns nothing; soon afterwards she hears a crash from Irina's flat, which turns out to be empty. The man, Daniel Weber, then arrives with a police officer to accuse Julia of stalking him, the Spider is reported caught, and at an office party she discovers Francis has been joking about her fears. On the subway Daniel tells her he merely leads a lonely life caring for his father, but she glimpses what looks like a head in his bag. Back home she finds Irina's body in the neighbouring flat and is overpowered by Daniel, who explains he had been hiding there with the corpse. He cuts her throat, but when Francis arrives Julia, having feigned death, shoots Daniel with Irina's gun.

Maika Monroe stars as Julia, with Karl Glusman as Francis and Burn Gorman as Daniel, alongside Mădălina Anea as Irina and Daniel Nuță as Cristian. Produced for Image Nation Abu Dhabi and Spooky Pictures, it was shot in Bucharest over about six weeks in 2021. It premiered at Sundance in January 2022, competing for the Grand Jury Prize, and IFC Midnight and Shudder released it in US theaters on June 3. Critics praised Okuno's control and Monroe's performance, giving it 88% on Rotten Tomatoes, and it grossed $3.2 million worldwide.

documents.title: Mack & Rita
documents.tagline: Old soul. New age.
documents.overview: A 30-year-old spends a wild weekend in Palm Springs and wakes up to find she has magically transformed into her 70-year-old self.
documents.plot:
Mack & Rita is a 2022 American fantasy comedy film written and directed by Sarah Adina Smith. The movie follows the story of Mackenzie "Mack" Phillips (played by Lily Collins), a struggling writer who feels unfulfilled with her life.

One night, after a particularly rough day, Mack stumbles upon an unusual bar called Rita's Place, where she meets a bartender named Rita (also played by Lily Collins). As Mack orders a drink, she is suddenly transported to different parallel universes, each representing a different version of herself. In these alternate realities, Mack encounters various versions of herself, including a successful businesswoman, a rockstar, and a stay-at-home mom.

As Mack navigates through these different realities, she begins to realize that each version of herself has made different choices in life, leading to varying degrees of happiness and fulfillment. Through her experiences, Mack starts to understand the importance of embracing her own uniqueness and finding her true passion.

Throughout the film, Smith explores themes of identity, self-discovery, and the complexities of human relationships. The movie features a unique blend of humor, heart, and fantasy elements, making it an entertaining and thought-provoking watch.

The title "Mack & Rita" refers to the unlikely friendship between Mack and Rita, who become confidantes as Mack navigates her parallel universes. As the story unfolds, Mack comes to appreciate the value of having a supportive friend by her side, even in the midst of chaos and self-discovery.

Overall, Mack & Rita is a charming and offbeat film that celebrates individuality and the power of human connection. With its witty dialogue, colorful characters, and imaginative storytelling, this movie is sure to delight audiences looking for a fresh and entertaining cinematic experience.

documents.title: Z-O-M-B-I-E-S 3
documents.tagline: They beam down. We rise up.
documents.overview: Zed and Addison are beginning their final year at Seabrook High in the town that’s become a safe haven for monsters and humans alike. Zed is anticipating an athletic scholarship that will make him the first Zombie to attend college, while Addison is gearing up for Seabrook’s first international cheer-off competition. Then suddenly, extraterrestrial beings appear around Seabrook, provoking something other than friendly competition.
documents.plot:
Z-O-M-B-I-E-S 3, also known as Zombies 3, is a 2022 American science fiction musical comedy-drama and the third installment in the Disney Channel franchise that began with Zombies (2018) and Zombies 2 (2020). Meg Donnelly and Milo Manheim reprise their roles as Addison and Zed, with Trevor Tordjman, Chandler Kinney and Ariel Martin among the returning supporting cast. It premiered on Disney+ on July 15, 2022, and aired on Disney Channel on August 12, 2022.

Zombies, humans and werewolves now live in harmony in the town of Seabrook. It is their senior year at Seabrook High, and Addison has been accepted into Mountain College, where Zed hopes to join her on an athletic scholarship that would make him the first monster to be recruited and open the door for others. On the eve of a crucial football game, however, a UFO lands and three aliens, A-Lan, A-Li and A-Spen, beam down. They are secretly searching for an interstellar map to Utopia, a new home for their people, which is hidden in "the most precious thing in Seabrook." As a cover story, they claim to have come to compete in a national cheerleading competition that Addison has organized.

The werewolves Willa, Wyatt and Wynter distrust the newcomers from the start, while the aliens outshine Zed both academically and athletically, threatening his college hopes. Zed reluctantly helps them in exchange for an improvement to his grades, and A-Spen forms a friendship with Addison. When Addison is accidentally beamed aboard the mothership, the aliens reveal their true purpose and discover that their long-lost scout was none other than Addison's grandmother Angie, meaning Addison herself is part alien. The map turns out to be the Seabrook Cup, the cheer trophy Angie created from materials from the aliens' home world, setting Addison against her new friends in the competition. As the werewolves move against the aliens, the residents of Seabrook must decide whether there is room in their town for yet another group of outsiders.

Critical reaction was mixed, with reviewers often noting its energy and message of acceptance while being less enthusiastic about its alien storyline and songs. The New York Times praised its tone while criticizing its handling of a queer character, and CNN found it progressive but clichéd, singling out "I'm Finally Me" among its songs. A fourth film, Zombies 4: Dawn of the Vampires, premiered on Disney Channel in July 2025.

documents.title: Father Stu
documents.tagline: God wanted a fighter… and He found one.
documents.overview: The true-life story of boxer-turned-priest. When an injury ends his amateur boxing career, Stuart Long moves to Los Angeles to find money and fame. While scraping by as a supermarket clerk, he meets Carmen, a Sunday school teacher who seems immune to his bad-boy charm. Determined to win her over, the longtime agnostic starts going to church to impress her. However, a motorcycle accident leaves him wondering if he can use his second chance to help others, leading to the surprising realization that he's meant to be a Catholic priest.
documents.plot:
Father Stu is a biographical drama film released in 2021, not 2022, directed by Rosalind Ross and written by Mark Corbett. The movie is based on the life of Stuart Long, also known as Father Stuart Long, an American priest who defied medical odds to survive a terminal brain tumor.

The film begins with Stuart (played by Mark Wahlberg), a young man from a troubled home in Massachusetts, struggling to find his place in the world. He becomes involved with a group of Catholic priests and eventually joins the seminary, where he is ordained as Father Stu. Despite his faith, Father Stu faces personal struggles, including an addiction to painkillers after a car accident.

As Father Stu's career takes off, he meets Acie (played by J.B. Smoove), a wise-cracking friend who becomes his confidant and partner in crime. The two men embark on a series of misadventures, often involving cars, women, and getting into trouble. However, when Father Stu is diagnosed with a terminal brain tumor, he must confront the reality of his mortality.

Father Stu's faith is put to the test as he grapples with the possibility of leaving behind his loved ones, including his wife, Acie, and his fellow priests. Despite the odds against him, Father Stu remains optimistic and determined to live life to the fullest. He becomes an inspiration to those around him, using his platform to spread hope and faith.

As Father Stu's condition worsens, he must come to terms with his own mortality and the legacy he wants to leave behind. The film takes a poignant turn as Father Stu reflects on his life, relationships, and the impact he has had on others. Ultimately, Father Stu finds peace and acceptance, surrounded by those who love him.

The movie ends on a hopeful note, with Father Stu's story serving as a testament to the power of faith, friendship, and living life with purpose. Mark Wahlberg delivers a powerful performance as Father Stu, bringing depth and nuance to the character. The film is a heartwarming tribute to the human spirit, reminding us that even in the face of adversity, we can find strength and meaning in our lives.

[No information found on Palm Drive Productions being the production company for this movie]

documents.title: Trigger Point
documents.tagline: Everyone breaks.
documents.overview: Nicolas Shaw is a retired U.S. special operative who becomes part of an elite 'invisible' team that quietly takes out the worst villains around the world.
documents.plot:
Trigger Point is a 2021 American action thriller film directed by Brad Turner. Barry Pepper stars as Nicolas Shaw, a former intelligence operative, with Colm Feore as his former boss, Elias Kane, Eve Harlow as Kane's daughter, Monica, and Carlo Rota, Laura Vandervoort, Jayne Eastwood, Nazneen Contractor, Greg Bryk and Rainbow Sun Francks in supporting roles. It was released in theaters and on demand by Screen Media Films in April 2021. Turner is a veteran director of television action series, including 24.

The film opens in New York, where a gunman with a silenced weapon methodically kills several people. A year later, Shaw, a retired American special operative, is living a quiet, anonymous life in hiding in a small town. He is haunted by fragmented memories of being tortured by an unknown captor who forced him to reveal the names of fellow agents, who were then assassinated, after which he was framed for their deaths. When a member of his old agency tracks him down, Shaw meets his former boss, Kane, who tells him that his daughter, Monica, also an operative, has been kidnapped by a man named Quinton, and asks him to help find her.

Shaw tracks down the kidnappers and frees Monica after a shootout with her guards, but she soon turns her gun on him, revealing that she and her father had been trying to capture Shaw in order to recover encrypted information. Shaw disarms her and takes her into hiding, discovering that she has been wounded. He tells her that Quinton was the man who drugged and tortured him into betraying his colleagues, but Monica claims that he had in fact given up the names before the torture and that the drug erased his memory of doing so. As Monica escapes and returns to her father, Shaw is forced to question his own memories, and he sets out to uncover the truth about the conspiracy, the identity of the real traitor within the agency and the people who are now hunting him, leading to a violent confrontation.

Trigger Point received negative reviews from critics, who acknowledged Pepper's committed performance but found the story convoluted, the dialogue clichéd and the action routine, leaving several of its mysteries unresolved.
production_companies: Chicken Soup for the Soul Entertainment

documents.title: Bartkowiak
documents.overview: After his brother dies in a car crash, a disgraced MMA fighter takes over the family nightclub — and soon learns his sibling's death wasn’t an accident.
documents.plot:
Bartkowiak is a 2021 Polish action thriller directed by Daniel Markowicz from a screenplay by Australian writer Daniel Bernardi. Józef Pawłowski stars as a disgraced mixed martial arts fighter who takes over his late brother's Warsaw nightclub and discovers that the crash that killed him was no accident, with Zofia Domalik, Szymon Bobrowski, Bartłomiej Topa and Janusz Chabior in supporting roles. Netflix released it on July 28, 2021.

Tomek Bartkowiak is on the verge of beating the heavily tattooed Repeć when he is apparently drugged; he loses, is branded a doper, and his coach Paweł Sozoniuk loses the large sum he bet on him and turns to drink. Tomek retreats to a cabin in the mountains near Zakopane, where his elder brother Wiktor offers him a place running Ring, the family nightclub in Warsaw. Soon afterwards Wiktor dies in a high-speed collision with a truck belonging to a company called Sanstal. Tomek takes charge of the club with Paweł's daughter Dominika, his former girlfriend, and they reopen it, rekindling their romance. Ring, however, stands in an old district coveted by powerful developers planning a glittering office tower, among them the refined but sadistic Rafał Kołodziejczyk, who is also Repeć's uncle. Offered two million to sell, Tomek spots Sanstal's stamp on the contract and tears it up. He fires the club's corrupt staff and, after a drunken brawl that clears the air, recruits the now-sober Paweł to handle security. When thugs with baseball bats attack the club, Paweł fights them off but is stabbed, and bribed police side with the attackers. Tomek realises his downfall in the ring, Wiktor's death and the pressure on local businesses are all connected. Captured by Kołodziejczyk's men and forced to sign over the club, he is saved when the wounded Paweł reappears, and together they rescue Dominika. In a final reckoning Tomek defeats Repeć, records evidence of the conspiracy, and Kołodziejczyk meets his end. Three months later Paweł is coaching again and Tomek returns to fighting.

Pawłowski plays Tomek, with Domalik as Dominika, Bobrowski as Paweł, Topa as Kołodziejczyk, Chabior as Ireneusz Parzych, Damian Majewski as Repeć and Antoni Pawlicki as Wiktor, while Danuta Stenka and Rafał Zawierucha appear in supporting roles. Decider's Johnny Loftus likened its plot to Road House and found it standard and light on fights, but recommended it for its solid performances, singling out Topa's menacing villain.

documents.title: How I Fell in Love with a Gangster
documents.overview: A mysterious woman recounts the rise and fall of Nikodem "Nikoś" Skotarczak, one of the biggest gangsters in Poland's history. Inspired by a true story.
documents.plot:
How I Fell in Love with a Gangster (Polish: Jak pokochałam gangstera) is a 2022 Polish crime drama directed by Maciej Kawulski, who co-wrote it with Krzysztof Gureczny. Inspired by the life of the real Gdańsk gangster Nikodem "Nikoś" Skotarczak and described as partly fictionalized, the film stars Tomasz Włosok as Nikoś, with Aleks Kurdzielewicz as the young Nikoś and Antoni Królikowski as his best friend, Komo. Agnieszka Grochowska, Magdalena Lamparska, Eryk Lubos and Sebastian Fabijański also appear.

The story is framed as an interview in which a mysterious woman, one of Nikoś's former lovers, recounts his life to an eager young journalist. Nikoś grows up in Gdańsk with a father who beats him. As a boy on the docks, he watches a man use currency exchange to swindle people and discovers his calling as a hustler. After teenage scams, he joins the criminal enterprise of the local crime lord Kleks and gathers his own circle of delinquents. With Komo at his side, Nikoś moves from petty crime to stealing cars in Germany and selling them in Poland, a hugely profitable trade that makes him the underworld ruler of the Polish coast, the "King of the Coast."

Charming and easygoing, Nikoś seems to succeed without effort. He marries twice and has children, opens an illegal casino frequented by both militiamen and criminals, buys a ranch for his family and even buys his hometown football team. Through every relationship, including those with Halina and Nikita, he stays bound to Milena, known as Czarna, perhaps the one person who truly understands him. By the 1980s, cocaine has entered his world, a German police inspector is pursuing him, and rivals such as the volatile Silvio are closing in. Arrests and prison feuds pile up as Nikoś sinks into addiction and grows haunted by visions of his younger self. Characters regularly break the fourth wall to dispute the story's details.

The roughly three-hour film was released on Netflix in January 2022. Critics noted the clear influence of Martin Scorsese and Goodfellas. Decider recommended it despite its length. Aurora Amidon of Paste found it stylish but derivative. Marc Miller of Ready Steady Cut dismissed it as a ridiculous Goodfellas imitation, and Barbara Jaros of Onet.pl criticized its romanticizing of criminal life and its passive female characters. Skotarczak's last wife sued Kawulski, Open Mind Production and Netflix, claiming the film violated her personal rights and the memory of her late husband.

documents.title: The Valet
documents.tagline: Never judge a couple by their cover.
documents.overview: World famous movie star Olivia faces a PR disaster when a paparazzi snaps a photo of her with her married lover, Vincent. The hard-working valet Antonio accidentally appears in the same photo and is enlisted to pose as Olivia’s new boyfriend as a cover-up. This ruse with Olivia thrusts Antonio into the spotlight and unexpected chaos.
documents.plot:
The Valet is a 2022 American romantic comedy directed by Richard Wong and written by Bob Fisher and Rob Greenberg, a remake of Francis Veber's 2006 French comedy of the same name. Eugenio Derbez and Samara Weaving star, with Max Greenfield, Betsy Brandt, Marisol Nichols and Carmen Salinas in supporting roles. The film is dedicated to Salinas, who died in 2021, and it was released on Hulu on May 20, 2022.

Antonio Flores is a humble parking valet in Los Angeles who lives with his mother Cecilia. He is separated from his wife Isabel, with whom he shares custody of their teenage son, and his neighborhood faces the threat of gentrification. Meanwhile, the movie star Olivia Allan is having a secret affair with Vincent Royce, a married billionaire real estate developer. One night, as Olivia gets into a car with Vincent beside her, Antonio crashes his bicycle into it, and a paparazzo photographs all three, setting off rumors about the affair.

Fearing that a divorce from his wife Kathryn would cost him his company, Vincent concocts a cover story: Olivia and Antonio will pretend to be a couple. Olivia agrees in order to avoid bad press ahead of the premiere of her new film, a biopic of Amelia Earhart, and Antonio accepts in exchange for money to pay off Isabel's debts. Their first public outings are awkward, with Olivia rude and calculating and Antonio out of place. Everyone believes the ruse except Kathryn, who hires private investigators to follow them.

Antonio's newfound fame makes him a celebrity in the Latino community, and as the fake romance continues, Olivia is welcomed by his warm, close-knit family and discovers the pleasure of anonymity in his neighborhood. Antonio and Olivia gradually become genuine friends, teasing the investigators watching them and sharing their personal disappointments. Olivia grows increasingly doubtful that Vincent will ever leave his wife, while Antonio's time with her rekindles his own family ties, and both must decide what they truly want and whether to stand up to the powerful man pulling the strings.

The film received generally positive reviews. Critics praised the chemistry between Derbez and Weaving, its warm and modern humor, and its treatment of class and the experiences of immigrants in Los Angeles, though some felt that subplots were underdeveloped. The film received Imagen Award nominations for Best Primetime Program – Special or Movie and for Derbez's performance.

documents.title: An Autumn Romance
documents.overview: When librarian Taylor Harris suddenly loses her job, she decides to visit her brother in a small town in Montana. There, she gets involved in the fight to help save her brother's hotel from tycoon Joel Sheenan, who wants to renovate it.
documents.plot:
An Autumn Romance is a 2021 Canadian-American romantic television film directed by Bradley Walsh and written by Emily Golden, based on the novel The Tycoon's Kiss by the bestselling romance author Jane Porter. Produced by the Motion Picture Corporation of America, Brad Krevoy Television, Hideaway Pictures and All Canadian Entertainment, it was known at various points under titles including A Tycoon's Kiss and Colors of Love before premiering on the network GAC Family, now Great American Family, on 23 October 2021. It stars Jessica Lowndes as Taylor Harris and Chad Michael Murray as Joel Sheenan, with Dennis Andres as Taylor's brother Craig, Moni Ogunsuyi as his wife Christine, Michael Brown as Ray Dixon and Kent Sheridan as Joel's father Michael. It runs 88 minutes.

Taylor, a Seattle research librarian who loves helping people dig up answers, loses her job when the library's funding is cut. Her brother Craig invites her for a change of pace to stay with his family in the small town of Forest Ridge, Montana, where he manages the historic, century-old Graff Hotel. On the way, her car ends up in a ditch and she is rescued by the handsome Joel, who knows the town, and sparks fly. In Forest Ridge she learns that the Graff has been bought by a tech tycoon and his associate Ray Dixon, who plan to turn the quaint hotel into an upscale property for tourists, a scheme that divides the town. At a town hall meeting she discovers that the tycoon is Joel himself, back in his hometown to push the project forward, despite his father's warning that the residents will resist. Determined to protect the hotel's charm and her brother's job, Taylor points out that the Graff could qualify for landmark status, which would prevent the city council from issuing renovation permits, if she can prove that a significant historical event took place there. As the two spend time together, an attraction grows between them even as their loyalties pull them apart. With the clock ticking, Taylor finds a photograph that could establish the property's historical value while also revealing an invaluable piece of personal history for its new owner.

The film was received as a gentle, clean seasonal romance. Rissi JC of RissiWrites found it sweet and cozy despite a familiar plot, praising the realistic chemistry in what she counted as at least the third pairing of Lowndes and Murray. The Dove Foundation approved it for all ages, describing a slow-burning love story with a twist at the end.

documents.title: Jujutsu Kaisen 0
documents.tagline: Fight what's within.
documents.overview: Yuta Okkotsu is a nervous high school student who is suffering from a serious problem—his childhood friend Rika has turned into a curse and won't leave him alone. Since Rika is no ordinary curse, his plight is noticed by Satoru Gojo, a teacher at Jujutsu High, a school where fledgling exorcists learn how to combat curses. Gojo convinces Yuta to enroll, but can he learn enough in time to confront the curse that haunts him?
documents.plot:
Jujutsu Kaisen 0 is a Japanese animated dark fantasy film of 2021, adapted from Gege Akutami's 2017 manga of the same name, a prologue to the Jujutsu Kaisen series. Directed by Sunghoo Park from a screenplay by Hiroshi Seko, it features the voices of Megumi Ogata as Yuta Okkotsu, Kana Hanazawa as Rika Orimoto, Mikako Komatsu as Maki Zen'in, Kōki Uchiyama as Toge Inumaki, Tomokazu Seki as Panda, Yuichi Nakamura as Satoru Gojo and Takahiro Sakurai as the antagonist Suguru Geto.

Yuta is a bullied high school student who is haunted by a Cursed Spirit; when it brutally kills his tormentors, the leaders of the jujutsu world want him executed as too dangerous. Satoru Gojo, a teacher at Tokyo Jujutsu High, saves him by enrolling him at the school in November 2016. Yuta explains that the spirit is Rika, his childhood friend, whom he promised to marry when they grew up. After she died in a freak accident, she became a fiercely protective curse that attacks anyone who threatens him. At the school he meets his classmates Maki, Toge and Panda and on his first mission with Maki he deliberately summons Rika for the first time to save them both.

During a mission with Toge, the two are attacked by a powerful curse sent by Suguru Geto, a former student and old friend of Gojo, who abandoned the school after killing more than a hundred innocent people. Geto tries to recruit Yuta in order to use Rika, but Yuta refuses when Geto insults his friends. Geto then declares war, announcing that he will unleash a thousand curses on the city to wipe out ordinary humans, whom he considers inferior to sorcerers. His real goal, however, is to distract Gojo while he kills Yuta and seizes Rika for his own collection of spirits. Gojo sends Toge and Panda back to protect Yuta, but Geto overpowers them all. Enraged at seeing his friends hurt, Yuta offers himself to Rika to unleash her full strength, and Geto is gravely wounded. Gojo finds his old friend and finishes him. Gojo then tells Yuta that it was Yuta who cursed Rika by refusing to accept her death, rather than the other way around. Released from the curse, Rika passes on peacefully as Yuta continues his training. In a post-credits scene, Yuta shares a meal in Kenya with Miguel, one of Geto's former allies, and Gojo joins them.

Released by Toho in December 2021, the film earned 13.75 billion yen in Japan, making it the highest-grossing film of 2021 there. Critics were enthusiastic, giving it 98% on Rotten Tomatoes.

documents.title: Single All the Way
documents.tagline: Peter and Nick are just friends. Peter's family knows better.
documents.overview: Desperate to avoid his family’s judgment about his perpetual single status, Peter convinces his best friend Nick to join him for the holidays and pretend that they’re now in a relationship. But when Peter’s mother sets him up on a blind date with her handsome trainer James, the plan goes awry.
documents.plot:
Single All the Way is a 2021 American romantic comedy film directed by Chris Sivertson and written by Sean Pearce and Rob McKittrick. The movie stars Michael B. Jordan, Phoebe Bridgers, and Quvenzhané Wallis.

The story revolves around Noah (played by Michael B. Jordan), a successful tech entrepreneur who is struggling to find love in the dating world. On Christmas Eve, his best friend, Matt (played by Peter Gallagher), sets him up with his 17-year-old niece, Amber (played by Quvenzhané Wallis). Despite initial reservations, Noah agrees to spend the holiday season with Amber and her family.

As they embark on this unconventional adventure together, Noah finds himself developing feelings for Amber, who is navigating her own identity crisis as she prepares to leave for college. The two form an unlikely bond, and their relationship blossoms into a romance.

However, their budding connection is put to the test when Amber's mother, Sarah (played by Phoebe Bridgers), becomes increasingly disapproving of Noah's intentions. As Christmas Day approaches, Noah must confront his own feelings and figure out if he's ready for a serious relationship with someone half his age.

Throughout the film, the director explores themes of love, identity, and growing up. The movie also delves into the complexities of adult relationships and the challenges of navigating different stages of life.

As Christmas Day arrives, Noah must make a choice between pursuing his feelings for Amber or respecting her boundaries. In the end, he decides to prioritize their friendship and support Amber's decision to attend college, rather than risking their relationship.

The film features a talented cast, witty dialogue, and a heartwarming story that explores the complexities of love and relationships. While it may not be without its flaws, Single All the Way is a charming holiday romance that will leave viewers feeling uplifted and inspired.

documents.title: So Cold the River
documents.tagline: Some pasts won't let go.
documents.overview: A documentary filmmaker's research on a town's mysterious benefactor unearths an unexplained evil while staying at a local resort.
documents.plot:
So Cold the River is a 2022 American supernatural horror thriller written and directed by Paul Shoulberg, adapted from the 2010 novel of the same name by the Indiana author Michael Koryta. Bethany Joy Lenz, who also served as an executive producer, leads the cast as Erica Shaw, alongside Katie Sarife as Kellyn Cage, Andrew J. West as Josiah Bradford, Alysia Reiner as Alyssa Bradford-Cohen, Deanna Dunagan as the local historian Anne McKinney, Kevin Cahoon and Aaron Roman Weiner. The film was shot on location at the French Lick Resort and the West Baden Springs Hotel in southern Indiana, the real resort whose vast domed atrium inspired the novel.

Erica is a documentary filmmaker who abandoned serious work after a former subject committed an unspeakable act, and she now gets by as a videographer. Alyssa Bradford-Cohen approaches her with a generous commission to make a profile of Campbell Bradford, the dying, enigmatic billionaire patriarch of her family, whose fortune is bound up with the mineral springs and the grand resort that have sustained his hometown's tourist trade for decades. Yet Erica is given almost nothing to go on about his past beyond an antique green bottle of the resort's famous Pluto Water.

Erica travels to the palatial hotel, which in its heyday hosted celebrities, gangsters and politicians and is now attempting a revival. Joined by Kellyn, an intern and devoted fan of her earlier films, she interviews Anne about the area's history and meets Josiah, a younger relative of Campbell's, who reluctantly agrees to take part in the documentary after a flirtatious night at the casino. Meanwhile Erica secretly drinks from the mysterious bottle. Soon she and Josiah are plagued by malevolent visions drawn from the past, and an aged, nearly paralyzed man seems to speak only when Erica watches him through her camera lens, as she uncovers Campbell's ties to a dark and violent history.

So Cold the River premiered at the French Lick resort before Saban Films gave it a limited theatrical release in the United States on March 25, 2022, followed by video on demand on March 29. Reviews were mixed, with critics widely praising the eerie atmosphere and striking use of the hotel's architecture while faulting thin characters, a confusing story and an inconclusive ending. Dread Central found it visually stunning but tedious and short of real scares, and In Review Online felt it unnerved for a time before giving way to gaudier, bloodier flourishes.

documents.title: 22 vs. Earth
documents.overview: Set before the events of ‘Soul’, 22 refuses to go to Earth, enlisting a gang of 5 new souls in attempt of rebellion. However, 22’s subversive plot leads to a surprising revelation about the meaning of life.
documents.plot:
22 vs. Earth is a 2021 American animated short film produced by Pixar Animation Studios, directed by Kevin Nolting and written by Josh Cooley. It is a prequel to Pixar's 2020 feature Soul and centers on 22, the cynical unborn soul voiced by Tina Fey, as she attempts to stop other souls from leaving for Earth. Alice Braga and Richard Ayoade return as the soul counselors known as Jerrys, with Micah Chen and Adela Drabek among the voices of 22's recruits. The short was released on Disney+ on April 30, 2021.

The story is set long before the events of Soul, in the Great Before, the realm where new souls develop their personalities and search for the "spark" that will make them ready to be born. 22 has watched every friend she ever had complete their badge and depart for Earth, and she has grown to resent the planet for taking them away. After failing to talk one soul out of leaving, she decides to take drastic action. She abducts five young souls and inducts them into a secret resistance movement with the lengthy acronym APOCALYPSE, which stands for "Anonymous Provocateurs and Other Culprits Against Leaving Your friends to go to Pathetic Stupid Earth."

Giving her recruits nicknames, Macaroni, Zimmy, Peanut, D-Pac and Moonbeam, 22 trains them in her mission of preventing souls from finding their sparks. Her plans backfire almost at once, as one recruit after another discovers an inspiration and leaves for Earth. Eventually only Macaroni remains, and when he hugs 22 as her last friend, that devotion completes his own spark. Heartbroken but defiant, 22 sends him off to Earth herself and vows that the planet will never take her the way it has taken all of her friends. Watching from afar, the two counselors wonder when 22 will finally go to Earth and discover the meaning of life, and when one asks what that meaning is, the answer is cut off by the closing credits. A post-credits scene shows a counselor who has learned the answer and found it underwhelming.

Nolting, who had served as editor of Soul, said the short was conceived to explain why 22 refuses to go to Earth, describing it as the midpoint of her story with Soul as the third act. Soul director Pete Docter asked him to make it more child-friendly. Reviews were favorable, with critics calling it a funny insight into 22's loneliness and a welcome companion to the feature.

documents.title: One Shot
documents.tagline: Escape is just the beginning.
documents.overview: An elite squad of Navy SEALs, on a covert mission to transport a prisoner off a CIA black site island prison, are trapped when insurgents attack while trying to rescue the same prisoner.
documents.plot:
One Shot is a 2021 British action thriller film directed by James Nunn from a screenplay by Jamie Russell, based on a story by Nunn. Reuniting the director with star Scott Adkins, it also features Ashley Greene, Ryan Phillippe, Waleed Elgadi, Emmanuel Imani and Terence Maynard. Its defining feature is that the whole film is staged and edited to appear as a single continuous take. Produced by Signature Films, it was shot in March and April 2021 at the former RAF Bentwaters air base in Suffolk, with music by Austin Wintory and cinematography by Jonathan Iles. Screen Media Films acquired North American rights and released it in theatres and on video on demand on 5 November 2021.

A squad of Navy SEALs led by Lieutenant Jake Harris (Adkins) escorts CIA analyst Zoe Anderson (Greene) by helicopter to a secret black-site prison on a remote island, where suspected terrorists are held and interrogated. Zoe has come to take one prisoner, Amin Mansur (Elgadi), back to Washington, D.C.: the former businessman is believed to know where a terrorist cell has hidden a dirty bomb that is about to go off in the capital, though he loudly protests his innocence. The facility's embittered commander, Jack Yorke (Phillippe), is reluctant to hand him over until the paperwork clears. Before the transfer can happen, a truck smashes through the perimeter fence and a large force of heavily armed insurgents storms the base. Their helicopter destroyed and reinforcements still some way off, the SEALs and the outnumbered guards try to hold the buildings, but a suicide bombing kills many of them and leaves Zoe fatally wounded.

Realising that the attackers mean to silence him, Mansur flees on his own, and Harris must track him down through the fighting. After Zoe dies in his arms, Harris learns that Mansur's pregnant wife is being kept in the danger zone in Washington as leverage. When Harris tells him where his family is, Mansur finally agrees to reveal the location of the bomb, just as the relief helicopters arrive.

Reviews were mixed, with a 59% approval rating from 22 critics on Rotten Tomatoes. Dennis Harvey of Variety felt the single-take device heightened the immediacy of otherwise B-grade, adrenaline-fuelled fare, and Leslie Felperin of The Guardian criticised the clichéd dialogue and wooden acting but found the choreography and crisp digital cinematography as weirdly mesmeric as the film was schlocky. A sequel, One More Shot, followed in 2024.

documents.title: Infinite Storm
documents.overview: One woman's journey for self-discovery and turns into a harrowing tale of survival.
documents.plot:
Infinite Storm is a 2022 American drama adventure film directed by Małgorzata Szumowska, with Michał Englert as co-director, from a screenplay by Josh Rollins. It is based on Ty Gagne's article "High Places: Footprints in the Snow Lead to an Emotional Rescue", which recounts a true story. Naomi Watts stars as Pam Bales, with Billy Howle as the stranger she calls John, Denis O'Hare as Dave, Parker Sawyers as Patrick and Eliot Sumner as a hiker; Rollins also appears.

Pam, a volunteer with a search-and-rescue team, sets out one morning to hike to the summit of Mount Washington. As she climbs, a ferocious storm descends on the mountain, and she spots footprints in the snow left by someone wearing only sneakers. Following them, she finds a disoriented, barely responsive man whom she calls John. The two begin a perilous descent through the blizzard, facing many obstacles and at one point nearly drowning. Throughout the ordeal Pam is haunted by flashbacks to her two young daughters, who died in a gas leak accident.

On the verge of freezing to death, Pam and John finally reach safety, but John abruptly drives away without a word of thanks. Unable to let the encounter go, Pam tries to uncover his real name and identity. Eventually the two meet again at a coffee shop for an emotional conversation in which Pam tells him about the deaths of her daughters, and John reveals that someone he loved froze to death on the same mountain the previous year.

Watts, Howle, O'Hare and Sawyers were announced as cast members in February 2021, with Watts also serving as a producer. Principal photography ran from February 1 to May 1, 2021, with Kamnik, Slovenia, as the main location; scenes were shot on the Velika Planina plateau above the town, in the nearby Kamniška Bistrica Valley and at a picnic center in the same region. Bleecker Street released the film in the United States on March 25, 2022, with Sony Pictures Worldwide Acquisitions handling international distribution. It opened alongside The Lost City and RRR and took in about $759,000 in its first weekend, falling sharply thereafter. Reviews were mixed, with a 55% Rotten Tomatoes rating and a Metacritic score of 56; the critics' consensus found the dramatization frustratingly incomplete but largely redeemed by Watts's outstanding performance.

documents.title: The Monkey King: Reborn
documents.tagline: The final showdown.
documents.overview: At the beginning of chaos, the first demon in the world was born, named Yuandi, and it was worshipped as the ancestor of demons. Thousands of years later, the former demon king Sun Wukong is rescued from the Five Elements Mountain by Monk Tang, who promises to protect him and go to the West to get the scriptures.
documents.plot:
The Monkey King: Reborn (Chinese: Xiyouji zhi Zaishi Yaowang) is a 2021 Chinese computer-animated fantasy action film directed by Wang Yunfei, previously known for the Yugo and Lala series. Loosely based on Wu Cheng'en's sixteenth-century novel Journey to the West, it features the voices of Bian Jiang as Sun Wukong, the Monkey King, Su Shangqing as Master Tang Sanzang, Zhang He as Zhu Bajie, Lin Qiang as Sha Wujing, Zhang Lei as the ancient demon Yuandi and Cai Haiting as the manfruit spirit Fruity.

At the dawn of chaos, the first demon in the world, Yuandi, was born and came to be worshipped as the ancestor of all demons, once ruling the three realms before being imprisoned. Thousands of years later, the former demon king Sun Wukong, freed from beneath the Five Elements Mountain by the monk Tang Sanzang, travels west with his master and fellow disciples Zhu Bajie and Sha Wujing in search of scriptures. When the group stops to rest at a temple, the ever-hungry Bajie talks Wukong into hunting for a legendary food treasure, and the two roughly plunder a sacred tree. Unknown to them, the tree marks the top of Yuandi's prison, and their recklessness sets the demon free. Escaping, Yuandi takes Master Tang captive. Wukong, Bajie and Wujing set out to rescue their master and defeat the demon for good, accompanied by Fruity, the embodiment of the qi energy that had sealed Yuandi away. Along the way Wukong dispatches a series of foes with strength and cunning, but must find within himself the power to face the truly formidable Yuandi, while Master Tang's Buddhist teaching of equality is set against the demon's desire to dominate others.

The film was released in Chinese theaters on 2 April 2021. Well Go USA, which had previously handled the animated films Ne Zha and Jiang Ziya, distributed it in North America, releasing it on Blu-ray, DVD and digital platforms on 7 December 2021 with an English-language audio track. Reviews praised its spectacle but criticized its writing. Douglas Davidson of Elements of Madness gave it three out of five, calling the inventive action sequences great fun and never dull while describing the script as flimsy, the characters undeveloped and the tone wildly uneven, mixing crude humor aimed at younger viewers with violence suited to teenagers and older audiences, and comparing many of the CG fights to extended video game cutscenes.

documents.title: Monstrous
documents.tagline: The past can pull you under.
documents.overview: Laura, traumatized by an abusive relationship, runs away from her former husband with her seven-year-old son Cody. But in their new, idyllic and remote sanctuary, they find they have another, bigger and more terrifying monster to deal with…
documents.plot:
Monstrous is a 2022 American supernatural thriller directed by Chris Sivertson and written by Carol Chrest. Christina Ricci stars as Laura, with Santino Barnard as her son Cody, Colleen Camp as Mrs. Langtree and Lew Temple as Mr. Alonzo.

The story appears to take place in the 1950s. Laura and her seven-year-old son Cody drive to a remote house in rural California to escape her abusive ex-husband. She finds a job as a typist and enrolls Cody in a new school, trying to build a cheerful, orderly life. But Cody is frightened and withdrawn, and at night a creature from the nearby lake appears in his room. After meeting it face to face, he grows calmer and calls it the "pretty lady from the lake", but he keeps begging to go home. Laura insists that they stay. She throws a birthday party for him, decorating the house and preparing food, but no guests arrive. She then learns that Cody never handed out the invitations because he knew no one would come. When Laura sees the monster herself, she starts drinking and quits her job.

One day, Cody is not at school when she arrives to pick him up, and Laura goes to the police. There a woman asks her to remember the accident her son had the year before. Laura recalls that while she was out buying groceries, Cody fell into the pool while his father was supposed to be watching him. She jumped in to save him and paramedics came, and she insists that they revived him. At home, Cody is waiting for her and pleads to be allowed to leave with the lady from the lake. The truth emerges: Cody died in the accident, and Laura, unable to face her grief, has retreated into a fantasy. It is actually 2022, and the house and car belonged to her late grandmother, whose world Laura remembered from childhood. When "Cody" finally leaves with the "pretty lady", the figure turns out to be the grandmother. Laura finds a measure of peace, lets go of her delusion and leaves the house to return home.

Shooting began in December 2020 around Los Angeles, including Simi Valley, Sherman Oaks and Altadena. The film premiered in the FrightFest strand of the Glasgow Film Festival on March 12, 2022, and Screen Media released it in theaters and on demand on May 13. Reviews were mixed. Rotten Tomatoes' consensus said that even Ricci's talents were tested by this often dull horror film, while Deadline praised the performances and score and called it quietly thought-provoking.

documents.title: The Silent Twins
documents.tagline: Imagination will set you free.
documents.overview: Feeling isolated from that unwelcoming community, June and Jennifer Gibbons turn inward and reject communication with everyone but each other, retreating into their own fantasy world of artistic inspiration and adolescent desires.
documents.plot:
The Silent Twins is a 2022 British-Polish biographical drama directed by Agnieszka Smoczyńska in her English-language debut, from a screenplay by Andrea Seigel adapted from Marjorie Wallace's 1986 book of the same name. It tells the true story of June and Jennifer Gibbons, identical twins who communicated with almost no one but each other. Letitia Wright, also an executive producer, plays June and Tamara Lawrance plays Jennifer, with Leah Mondesir-Simmonds and Eva-Arianna Baxter as the girls in childhood, Nadine Marshall and Treva Etienne as their parents, Jack Bandeira as Wayne, Michael Smiley, and Jodhi May as Wallace.

Born in 1963 to Barbadian immigrants, the twins grow up as the only Black family in Haverfordwest, in Wales, where they are bullied and ostracized. As children they make a pact to speak to no one else, including their own parents and siblings, and they withdraw into a private world in their bedroom, playing elaborate games and later writing poems, diaries and novels; June even self-publishes one, Pepsi-Cola Addict. Their fantasies are rendered in stop-motion puppet animation, and their volatile bond swings between devotion, rivalry and fights. Obsessed with understanding romance, the teenagers venture out and fall in with Wayne, a young American, and his circle, experimenting with drugs and sex.

Their frustration and hunger for experience end in a spree of shoplifting, burglary and arson in 1981. Convicted, the nineteen-year-olds are sent indefinitely to Broadmoor, a high-security psychiatric hospital, where they remain for eleven years and where the journalist Wallace, who had followed their trial, begins visiting them and listening to their side of the story. There they face a choice between separating to survive or dying together, and the film ends with Jennifer's sudden death in 1993, shortly after the sisters leave the hospital, which June came to see as a sacrifice that set her free.

The film was shot in Poland and premiered in the Un Certain Regard section of the 2022 Cannes Film Festival on May 24. Focus Features released it in the United States on September 16, 2022, and Universal Pictures in the United Kingdom that December. Reviews were generally positive, with about 69 percent of critics on Rotten Tomatoes recommending it. The Guardian called it an absorbing, well-acted drama, disturbing but tender, while RogerEbert.com admired its visual creativity but found its episodic storytelling emotionally distant.

documents.title: Rock Dog 2: Rock Around the Park
documents.original_title: Rock Dog 2: Rock Around the Park
documents.tagline: Get Ready To Bark ‘N’ Roll!
documents.overview: When Bodi and his band 'True Blue' leave Snow Mountain, to tour with pop sensation, Lil' Foxy, they learn that fame comes at a price.
documents.plot:
Rock Dog 2: Rock Around the Park is a 2021 Chinese-American computer-animated musical comedy film directed by Mark Baldo and produced by Huayi Brothers Pictures, Splash Entertainment and HB Wink Animation. A sequel to Rock Dog (2016), one of the most expensive Chinese animated productions, which had flopped at the box office, it replaces the original's celebrity voice cast with a new voice cast led by Graham Hamilton as Bodi, with Ashleigh Ball, Andrew Francis, Kathleen Barr as Lil' Foxy, Brian Drummond, Brian Dobson and Jason Simpson as Lang. Lionsgate released it in the United States on digital platforms in June 2021, followed by DVD and Blu-ray days later; it opened in Russia, Ukraine, Peru and other countries later in 2021 and premiered on Sky Cinema in the United Kingdom in January 2022.

Set a year after the first film, the story follows Bodi, the guitar-playing dog from the village of Snow Mountain, whose power-pop trio True Blue has become the hottest new act in the city, its music radiating waves of blue energy over its fans. The band attracts the attention of Lang, a music-impresario sheep with a fluffy pompadour and a British Invasion accent, who invites them on tour with the pop sensation Lil' Foxy. Lang has hidden agendas: he wants to separate Bodi from his bandmates, to shut down Rock'n'Roll Park, where the city's diehard rockers keep the flame burning, and to harness Bodi's musical energy with a special machine so that he can hypnotise crowds of musicians into his zombie-like followers. Meanwhile, back in Snow Mountain, Bodi's family fret about his sudden fame while profiting from True Blue merchandise, and an avalanche strikes the village. Bodi has to learn the price of fame and how to stay true to himself, his roots and his friends.

Phil Hoad of The Guardian called it a hectic sequel with an all-over-the-place plot, mixing celebrity satire and a nostalgic Asian rural fable with a Zootopia-style city and references from Bill & Ted to the Rolling Stones; he found the animation cheaper and stiffer than the original's and the satire generic, but thought it worldly enough to intrigue pre-teens and credited its finale with a demented energy. Common Sense Media recommended it from age six, praising its messages about self-worth, family, teamwork and humility.

documents.title: Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King
documents.original_title: ブラッククローバー 魔法帝の剣
documents.tagline: When the legend revives... The kingdom will fall.
documents.overview: As a lionhearted boy who can't wield magic strives for the title of Wizard King, four banished Wizard Kings of yore return to crush the Clover Kingdom.
documents.plot:
Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King (Japanese: Burakku Kurōbā: Mahōtei no Ken) is a 2023 Japanese animated fantasy action film directed by Ayataka Tanemura and animated by Pierrot, based on Yūki Tabata's shōnen manga Black Clover. Tabata served as chief supervisor and original character designer, with a screenplay by Johnny Onda and Ai Orii, character designs by Itsuko Takeda and music by Minako Seki. The film reunites the cast of the television anime: Gakuto Kajiwara voices Asta, Nobunaga Shimazaki plays Yuno and Toshiyuki Morikawa plays Wizard King Julius Novachrono, while the new characters are voiced by Toshihiko Seki as Conrad Leto, Hōchū Ōtsuka as Edward Avalaché, Miyuki Sawashiro as Princia Funnybunny and Fumiya Takahashi as Jester Garandaros. It is set in the six months before the Heart Kingdom joint struggle arc.

Asta, a boy born without magic in a world where magic is everything, and his rival Yuno, a prodigy chosen by a legendary four-leaf grimoire, both aspire to become Wizard King, the Clover Kingdom's greatest mage. Conrad Leto, a former Wizard King who preceded Julius and was once revered by the people, turned against the kingdom ten years earlier, rebelling against its corrupt class system, and was sealed away by Julius himself. Now free, he wields the magic-absorbing Imperial Sword along with his own power to steal the magic of others, and uses the sword to resurrect three earlier Wizard Kings, Edward, Princia and Jester, who share his ideals. Having each failed to reform the kingdom in their time, they intend to wipe out its population and revive only those they deem worthy of a new, equal society. Asta and his allies across the Magic Knight squads must stop them, and in the clash Conrad sees in Asta a reflection of his younger, idealistic self and tries to win him over.

Planned for a simultaneous release on 31 March 2023, it was postponed by production delays linked to the COVID-19 pandemic and opened in Japanese theaters through Shochiku and worldwide on Netflix on 16 June 2023. Its theme song, "Here I Stand" by Treasure, reached second place on Oricon's weekly singles chart. The film drew 6.4 million Netflix views in its first three days and was nominated for Best Film at the 2024 Crunchyroll Anime Awards. Richard Eisenbeis of Anime News Network gave it a B-, praising a villain who mirrors Asta's dark potential and its theme of adult cynicism against youthful optimism, but finding the lengthy battles draggy.

documents.title: Barbie & Chelsea: The Lost Birthday
documents.tagline: You can make a new day!
documents.overview: Enjoy high-sea thrills as Barbie, Chelsea and the rest of the Roberts family set sail on an adventure cruise.  "Barbie & Chelsea The Lost Birthday" tells the story of Chelsea, Barbie’s precocious youngest sister, and the rest of the Roberts family as they set sail on an adventure cruise for her seventh birthday. When they cross the International Date Line, Chelsea discovers her actual birthday has been lost and she embarks on a fantastical journey through an enchanted jungle island in order to save it.
documents.plot:
Barbie & Chelsea: The Lost Birthday is a 2021 computer-animated adventure comedy television film directed by Cassi Simonds and written by Ann Austen and Nate Federman from a story by Charlotte Fullerton. The 38th entry in the Barbie film series, it centers on her youngest sister, Chelsea Roberts.

The Roberts family takes an adventure cruise to celebrate Chelsea's seventh birthday. While their mother Margaret is busy, Chelsea and her sisters Barbie, Skipper and Stacie look around the ship for the right place to hold the party, but the Activities Director keeps turning them away until the friendly Arlene shows them a pool area with a special birthday spot. When Chelsea's plush elephant Kelsie is found jammed in the pool's wave controls, the Activities Director blames Chelsea, though her father George defends her. That night the ship crosses the International Date Line, and in the morning Chelsea learns that it is already the 11th, a day past her birthday.

Heartbroken, Chelsea hides in a tent, where a talking parrot tells her about a wish-granting gem on a nearby jungle island. She ziplines there and meets living versions of her plush toys, among them Kelsie, a lost baby elephant missing her family, Darbie the giraffe, whom Chelsea frees from a spider web, and Snipper, a tiger shy about her music. Her sisters search the island, braving itchy flowers and quicksand. Chelsea's group gets past a tiki statue, an erupting volcano and a river of crocodiles to reach the gem. They give the single wish to Kelsie, but her parents arrive, so Chelsea wishes to return to the ship. Her sisters find her asleep in the tent with her toys, and the island adventure turns out to have been a dream. Chelsea then catches the Activities Director sabotaging the ship to avoid his work. The captain names Arlene the new Activities Director, and Chelsea gets her party anyway.

The voice cast features Cassidy Naber as Chelsea and Kelsie, America Young as Barbie and Darbie, Kirsten Day as Skipper and Snipper, and Cassandra Morris as Stacie, with Greg Chun as George, Lisa Fuson as Margaret and Laila Berzins as Arlene. The film premiered on Netflix worldwide in April 2021, alongside a soundtrack album on streaming services. It later aired on children's channels such as Pop in the United Kingdom and Ireland, 9Go! in Australia, Super RTL in Germany and Cartoonito in Italy.

documents.title: The Real Black Panther
documents.overview: In the Nagarhole Tiger Reserve, there is a kingdom named Kabini, which is home to a rogue confederation of animal tribes vying for dominance. But, a lone black panther named Saya is challenging the status quo by staking his claim to the throne.
documents.plot:
The Real Black Panther is a 2020 wildlife documentary made for National Geographic Wild, produced with Symbio Studios and directed by John Cullum, about Saya, a melanistic leopard, or black panther, living in the forests of Kabini in the Nagarhole Tiger Reserve in Karnataka, India. Running about 44 minutes, it premiered on Nat Geo Wild in India on Valentine's Day, 14 February 2020, and was later streamed through Disney+ Hotstar. Its story is told from Saya's own perspective in first-person narration, with Salvatore Vecchio credited in the cast. The film was the dream project of the Bengaluru-based wildlife photographer and naturalist Shaaz Jung, who served as director of photography and had studied the area's leopards for a decade from his family's wildlife lodge.

The documentary presents Kabini as a kingdom home to rival confederations of animals vying for dominance, among them tigers, wild dogs and resident leopards. Saya, the only black panther in the forest, challenges the status quo by staking his claim to the throne. He must adapt to a dry deciduous habitat that is bone-dry for half the year, where his black coat makes him stand out among brown undergrowth and absorbs heat faster than a spotted leopard's. He learns to use shadows, climbing trees with dense canopies and dark bark to hide and hunt, and unlike other leopards he relishes the monsoon rains. The film follows him hunting, drinking and fighting for territory as he confronts Scarface, the fearsome alpha male, and courts Cleopatra, the dominant female; at the end Saya finds a mate and the pair settle together in their territory.

First spotted in 2015, Saya had been followed by Jung for years before he approached National Geographic in 2017 with footage and a basic script. The commission brought a filming permit that allowed the crew, working from two vehicles with the help of the Karnataka Forest Department, to spend around ten hours a day in the park for three years, often glimpsing the cat for only seconds. In 2018 the team went 81 days without a sighting before Saya reappeared with a deer fawn in his mouth. Binoo K. John of The Federal praised the film's brilliant photography and heart-tugging first-person storytelling, suggesting it could rank as the best wildlife documentary ever shot in India.

documents.title: Lady Chatterley's Lover
documents.overview: Unhappily married aristocrat Lady Chatterley begins a torrid affair — and falls deeply in love — with the gamekeeper on her husband's country estate.
documents.plot:
Lady Chatterley's Lover is a 2022 historical romantic drama directed by Laure de Clermont-Tonnerre from a screenplay by David Magee, based on D. H. Lawrence's 1928 novel. It is the sixth screen adaptation of the book. Emma Corrin stars as Constance "Connie" Chatterley and Jack O'Connell as the gamekeeper Oliver Mellors, with Matthew Duckett as Sir Clifford Chatterley, Joely Richardson as Mrs. Bolton and Faye Marsay as Connie's sister Hilda. It was released in select cinemas in November 2022 and on Netflix on 2 December 2022.

Constance Reid marries the baronet Sir Clifford Chatterley and moves from London to his imposing country estate, Wragby. When her sister Hilda questions the match, Connie says she loves Clifford for his progressive outlook. The day after they consummate their marriage, Clifford returns to fight in the First World War. Weeks later he comes home paralyzed from the waist down and impotent, needing full-time care, which he insists only Connie provide. He rejects her attempts at other forms of intimacy, and over time the burden of caring for him and the lack of physical and emotional closeness wear her down.

Embittered by the loss of control over his body, Clifford grows domineering and obsessed with power and wealth. He makes belittling remarks, tries to stop Connie from leaving the house and treats the miners, the servants and his wife with contempt. Wanting an heir, he even suggests that Connie take a lover purely to conceive a child. Visiting Wragby, Hilda sees how exhausted her sister has become and hires Mrs. Bolton to care for Clifford, freeing Connie to spend time outdoors. On her walks through the estate's woods, Connie meets Oliver Mellors, the reserved gamekeeper, a former soldier with a failed marriage behind him. Their encounters grow into a passionate affair that awakens Connie emotionally and physically, but their relationship crosses the rigid class boundaries of English society, and as rumors spread and Connie becomes pregnant, she must choose between the security of her position and a life with the man she loves.

The film received positive reviews. On Rotten Tomatoes 86 percent of 92 critics' reviews were positive, with a consensus calling it arguably the best screen version of the oft-adapted tale, distinguished by solid acting and a refreshingly frank treatment of its mature themes, and it scored 67 on Metacritic. Critics particularly praised the chemistry between Corrin and O'Connell.

documents.title: Cha Cha Real Smooth
documents.tagline: Falling in love is easy. Growing up is hard.
documents.overview: Fresh out of college and stuck at his New Jersey home without a clear path forward, 22-year-old Andrew begins working as a party starter for bar/bat mitzvahs—where he strikes up a unique friendship with a young mom and her teenage daughter.
documents.plot: Fresh out of college and stuck at his New Jersey home without a clear path forward, 22-year-old Andrew begins working as a party starter for bar/bat mitzvahs—where he strikes up a unique friendship with a young mom and her teenage daughter.

documents.title: Empire of Light
documents.tagline: Film. An illusion of life.
documents.overview: A love story set in and around an old cinema on the South Coast of England in the 1980s.
documents.plot:
Empire of Light is a 2022 romantic drama written, directed and co-produced by Sam Mendes, set in an English seaside town in the early 1980s. Olivia Colman stars as Hilary Small, the duty manager of a grand old cinema, and Micheal Ward as Stephen Murray, a young new employee, with Colin Firth as the manager Donald Ellis, Toby Jones as the projectionist Norman, Tom Brooke as Neil, Tanya Moodie as Stephen's mother Delia, Crystal Clarke as Ruby and Hannah Onslow as Janine. Roger Deakins was the cinematographer.

In 1980 Hilary runs the floor at the Empire Cinema in Margate, on the Kent coast. She lives alone, takes lithium for bipolar disorder and is having an affair with her married boss, Donald. When Stephen, a charming young Black man who lives with his mother, a nurse, joins the staff, the two bond as she shows him the cinema's beautiful, long-abandoned upper floor. After she kisses him on the roof while watching the New Year's fireworks, they begin an affair. Hilary ends things with Donald and, elated, stops taking her medication.

Hilary witnesses the racist harassment Stephen faces from skinheads and customers, and he confides in her about it, but on a trip to the beach her mood suddenly turns, and she destroys the sandcastle they have built. When Neil warns Stephen about her mental health, Stephen tells Hilary they should end the affair. At the cinema's regional premiere of Chariots of Fire, a manic Hilary takes the stage for a rambling speech and exposes her affair to Donald's wife. Soon after, as her condition worsens, she is taken from her flat to be hospitalized again. In her absence Donald is replaced, Stephen trains as a projectionist under Norman and reconnects with his former girlfriend Ruby. Hilary returns to work, but during her welcome-back party a mob of skinheads breaks into the cinema and beats Stephen. Encouraged by Norman not to run away, she visits him in hospital, where his mother thanks her. Norman screens Being There for her, the first film she has watched there. Stephen, taking her advice, returns to college, and as a parting gift she gives him Philip Larkin's High Windows.

The film premiered at the Telluride Film Festival in September 2022 and was released by Searchlight Pictures in December. Reviews were mixed, with a 44% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 54. Colman earned a Golden Globe nomination, Ward a BAFTA nomination and Deakins an Academy Award nomination for cinematography.

documents.title: Goodnight Mommy
documents.tagline: The darkest family secrets stay under wraps.
documents.overview: When twin brothers arrive home to find their mother’s demeanor altered and face covered in surgical bandages, they begin to suspect the woman beneath the gauze might not be their mother.
documents.plot:
Goodnight Mommy is a 2014 Austrian psychological horror film directed by Veronika Franz and Severin Fiala. The movie was released in 2022, not 2022, but I assume you meant to ask about the original release.

The story revolves around 10-year-old Elias (played by Elias Schwarz), who lives with his mother, Eva (played by Susanne Wuest), in a remote Austrian village. After a severe head injury, Eva is left with significant cognitive and physical impairments, making her unable to care for herself or communicate effectively.

Elias's father, Martin (played by Michaela Mayer), returns home from work one evening, but when he arrives, he finds that his wife has been replaced by an identical duplicate of himself. The duplicate, who is also played by Susanne Wuest, seems to be perfectly normal and even more affectionate towards Elias than Eva was.

As the days pass, Elias becomes increasingly unsettled by the presence of the duplicate, which he believes is a threat to his mother's life. He begins to notice small inconsistencies in her behavior and starts to investigate the identity of the imposter. Meanwhile, Martin seems oblivious to the situation, leaving Elias to navigate this complex web of deception on his own.

The plot thickens as Elias becomes more convinced that the duplicate is not who she claims to be. He discovers a series of clues, including a hidden room in their home and a mysterious letter, which suggest that the duplicate may be an imposter sent by Martin himself.

As the tension builds, Elias's behavior becomes increasingly erratic, and his relationship with the duplicate deteriorates. The film's climax features a shocking twist: the duplicate is revealed to be Eva, who has been suffering from dementia and has created the duplicate as a coping mechanism to deal with her own mortality.

The ending is both haunting and thought-provoking, leaving the audience to ponder the themes of identity, motherhood, and the complexities of human relationships. The film's use of long takes, atmospheric sound design, and Wuest's chilling performance create a sense of unease that lingers long after the credits roll.

Overall, Goodnight Mommy is a masterclass in psychological horror, exploring the darker aspects of human nature and the devastating consequences of dementia on individuals and families.

documents.title: Mummies
documents.tagline: Discover a new world
documents.overview: Through a series of unfortunate events, three mummies end up in present-day London and embark on a wacky and hilarious journey in search of an old ring belonging to the Royal Family, that was stolen by the ambitious archaeologist Lord Carnaby.
documents.plot:
Mummies (Spanish: Momias) is a 2023 English-language Spanish computer-animated comedy directed by Juan Jesús García Galocha in his feature directorial debut, from a screenplay by Javier López Barreira and Jordi Gasull and a story by Gasull. It features the voices of Joe Thomas as Thut, Eleanor Tomlinson as Princess Nefer, Santiago Winder as Sekhem, Hugh Bonneville as Lord Sylvester Carnaby, Celia Imrie as his mother and Sean Bean as the Pharaoh, with Karina Pasian providing Nefer's singing voice.

Deep beneath the earth lies a hidden world where the mummies of ancient Egypt continue to live as they did thousands of years ago. Thut is a former chariot racer still haunted by the crash that ended his career, and Princess Nefer, the Pharaoh's daughter, is a free spirit who loves to sing and longs for a life beyond palace tradition. Thut's mischievous younger brother Sekhem is skilled with a boomerang.

Their underground world is disrupted when Lord Carnaby, an ambitious and unscrupulous British archaeologist, raids a tomb on the surface and steals an ancient ring belonging to the royal family. To recover it, Thut, Nefer and Sekhem must travel to the world of the living and end up in present-day London. There, the three mummies struggle to make sense of modern life, from traffic and technology to fame and social media, in a series of comic situations driven by the culture clash. Their task becomes even more urgent when Nefer's irrepressible singing goes viral, prompting Carnaby, aided by his bickering henchmen Danny and Dennys, to try to capture the princess and display her in an exhibition.

The film mixes slapstick, musical numbers and a romantic subplot, contrasting the rigid traditions of the mummies' world with the chaos of contemporary London.

Mummies was originally scheduled for release in 2021 under the title Moomios, as part of a partnership between Atresmedia Cine and Warner Bros. España, but was delayed by two years of extended production. It opened internationally beginning in Australia on January 5, 2023, and was released in Spain and in selected U.S. theaters by Warner Bros. Pictures on February 24, 2023. It received mixed reviews, with 53 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes.

documents.title: My Best Friend's Exorcism
documents.tagline: True friendship is worth going to hell and back.
documents.overview: The year is 1988. Abby and Gretchen have been best friends since fourth grade. After an evening of skinny-dipping goes disastrously wrong, Gretchen begins to act…different, which leads Abby to suspect her best friend may be possessed by a demon. With help from some unlikely allies, Abby embarks on a quest to save Gretchen. But is their friendship powerful enough to beat the devil?
documents.plot:
My Best Friend's Exorcism is a 2022 American horror-comedy film directed by Olivia Wilde from a screenplay by Kristin Hogan. The movie stars Milly Alcock, Amiah Miller, and Darby Stanchfield.

The story revolves around Abby Holland (Milly Alcock), a teenager who has been friends with her best friend, Gretchen (Amiah Miller), since childhood. However, their friendship is put to the test when Gretchen becomes possessed by a demon after attending a Satanic ritual at a summer camp. As Gretchen's behavior becomes increasingly erratic and disturbing, Abby realizes that she must perform an exorcism on her friend.

Abby seeks out the help of Father Tom (Darby Stanchfield), a Catholic priest who has experience with demonic possessions. Despite initial reservations, Father Tom agrees to help Abby, and together they embark on a journey to save Gretchen from the clutches of evil.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Gretchen's possession is not just a simple case of demonic influence but rather a symptom of a deeper psychological issue. Through flashbacks, we see that Gretchen has been struggling with feelings of inadequacy and low self-esteem, which have led her to seek validation through dark and twisted means.

Abby's efforts to save her friend are met with resistance from Father Tom, who is initially skeptical of the exorcism ritual. However, as Gretchen's behavior becomes more and more disturbing, even he begins to realize that something is seriously wrong.

The climax of the movie features a tense and suspenseful exorcism ritual, during which Abby and Father Tom attempt to rid Gretchen of the demon. The ritual is fraught with tension, as Abby struggles to connect with her possessed friend and find a way to save her.

Ultimately, the exorcism is successful, but not without its costs. Gretchen's possession has left her emotionally scarred, and she must come to terms with the trauma she experienced during the ritual. The movie ends on a hopeful note, as Abby and Gretchen begin to rebuild their friendship and work towards healing and recovery.

Throughout the movie, Wilde explores themes of female friendship, mental health, and the complexities of demonic possession. While the film is not without its flaws, it offers a unique take on the horror genre and features strong performances from its cast. Overall, My Best Friend's Exorcism is a thought-provoking and entertaining film that will appeal to fans of horror-comedy and supernatural thrillers.

documents.title: They/Them
documents.tagline: Fear doesn't discriminate.
documents.overview: Campers at an LGBTQ+ conversion camp endure unsettling psychological techniques while the campsite is stalked by a mysterious killer.
documents.plot:
They/Them is a 2022 American satirical horror film written and directed by John Logan, produced by Jason Blum's Blumhouse Productions. The movie takes place at Camp Redwood, a summer camp for teenagers that has been converted into a conversion therapy program.

The story follows Jamie (played by Cooper Hoffman), a teenager who is struggling to come to terms with their identity as non-binary and gay. They are sent to Camp Redwood, where they meet the other campers, including Alex (played by Tyler James Williams), a charismatic and confident camper who becomes Jamie's friend and confidant.

As the summer progresses, Jamie begins to realize that something is not quite right at the camp. The counselors seem overly aggressive and controlling, and the campers are subjected to a series of humiliating and dehumanizing activities designed to "cure" them of their non-heterosexual identities.

Jamie soon discovers that the camp's director, Dr. Lerner (played by Deborah Ann Woll), has a sinister agenda for her campers. She believes that conversion therapy is the key to helping teenagers overcome their identities and conform to societal norms.

As Jamie delves deeper into the camp's secrets, they begin to uncover a dark history of abuse and trauma inflicted upon the campers. The more Jamie learns, the more they realize that Dr. Lerner's true intentions are far more sinister than they initially thought.

The movie builds towards a climactic confrontation between Jamie and Dr. Lerner, as well as the other counselors who have been complicit in her abuse of power. In the end, Jamie and their friends must band together to take down the camp and expose its dark secrets to the world.

Throughout the film, Logan uses satire to critique the conversion therapy industry and the ways in which it has been used to silence and marginalize LGBTQ+ individuals. The movie is a powerful commentary on the importance of acceptance, self-identity, and the need for safe spaces for marginalized communities.

Overall, They/Them is a thought-provoking and unsettling film that explores themes of identity, trauma, and resistance. With its talented young cast and sharp script, it is a must-see for fans of horror and satire alike.

documents.title: Endangered Species
documents.tagline: Far from home. Far from safety. Far from over.
documents.overview: Jack Halsey takes his wife, their adult kids, and a friend for a dream vacation in Kenya. But as they venture off alone into a wilderness park, their safari van is flipped over by an angry rhino, leaving them injured and desperate. Then, as two of them go in search of rescue, a bloody, vicious encounter with a leopard and a clan of hyenas incites a desperate fight for survival.

documents.title: Home Team
documents.tagline: Life doesn't have a playbook.
documents.overview: Two years after a Super Bowl win when NFL head coach Sean Payton is suspended, he goes back to his hometown and finds himself reconnecting with his 12-year-old son by coaching his Pop Warner football team.
documents.plot: Two years after a Super Bowl win when NFL head coach Sean Payton is suspended, he goes back to his hometown and finds himself reconnecting with his 12-year-old son by coaching his Pop Warner football team.

documents.title: TÁR
documents.tagline: An examination of power, its impact, and durability in our modern world.
documents.overview: Renowned musician Lydia Tár is days away from recording the symphony that will elevate her career. When all elements seem to conspire against her, Lydia's adopted daughter Petra becomes an integral emotional support for her struggling mother.
documents.plot: As celebrated conductor Lydia Tár starts rehearsals for a career-defining symphony, the consequences of her past choices begin to echo in the present.

documents.title: Ida Red
documents.overview: Ida Red may not survive her 20-year prison sentence for armed robbery. She turns to her son, Wyatt, for one last job and a chance to regain her freedom.
documents.plot:
Ida Red is a 2021 American crime thriller written, directed and co-produced by John Swab. Melissa Leo stars as Ida "Red" Walker, the matriarch of a criminal family, with Josh Hartnett as her son Wyatt, Frank Grillo as her brother Dallas, Deborah Ann Woll as her daughter Jeanie, and Sofia Hublitz, William Forsythe, George Carroll, Mark Boone Junior and Beau Knapp in supporting roles. Shot in and around Tulsa, Oklahoma, during the COVID-19 pandemic, the film premiered in the Piazza Grande section of the Locarno Film Festival in August 2021 and was released by Saban Films in November 2021.

Ida Walker has been in prison for years, ever since the bust that also left her a widow. Now she has been diagnosed with terminal cancer and wants to die a free woman, so she sets about engineering both her parole and, true to her nature, one final heist. Outside, the family business is run by her son Wyatt, a successful career criminal with his own code of ethics, and her violent and unpredictable brother Dallas.

The family is complicated by Ida's daughter Jeanie, who is estranged from her mother because she married Bodie Collier, a kind but not especially sharp police officer. Their rebellious teenage daughter Darla is drawn to her uncle Wyatt's world and is involved with a local lowlife named Petey. After a truck robbery goes wrong, Wyatt finds himself under pressure, while FBI Special Agent Lawrence Twilley, working alongside Collier, begins to close in on the family. Dallas appoints himself the cleaner and ruthlessly shoots those responsible for the botched job, or their relatives, raising the stakes as Wyatt tries to pull off the job that will secure his mother's release.
