Mai Wen (Yoo), a rising fighter on his way to becoming a champion, must first defeat one of Shang-hai's students and Shang-hai's best friend, and he falls in love with Shang-hai's sister. Meanwhile Jessica (Zhu), a shady woman who turns out to be part of a drug-smuggling ring, approaches Mai Wen with her own plans. When the bout ends with the death of his friend under suspicious circumstances, Shang-hai has no choice but to step back into the ring, despite his sister's pleas, to uncover the truth. A much larger conspiracy centred on Jessica emerges, and Mai Wen is revealed to be an undercover police officer. The fights include an underground cage surrounded by crocodiles, and the story moves between brightly coloured seaside locations.

Reviews were largely negative. Panos Kotzathanasis of Asian Movie Pulse felt the film prized impression over substance to the point of losing all sense of measure, criticising a nonsensical script, the English dubbing of an already mediocre cast of bodybuilders and models, and choreography slowed by its bulky stars, though he admired its look and Zhu's femme fatale. Derrick Dunn of Reviews & Dunn gave it a D-, crediting only the opening fight between Guo and Greene and calling the rest a disjointed mess that wasted its notable supporting cast. Watch or Pass was kinder, recommending it as a rental for its intense opening, the crocodile ring, its imaginative locales and a comic undercover policeman fond of disguises, while finding the story hard to follow.
production_companies: 北京宝庆影业传媒有限公司

documents.title: Catch the Bullet
documents.tagline: The sun never sets on vengeance.
documents.overview: U.S. marshal Britt MacMasters returns from a mission to find his father wounded and his son kidnapped by the outlaw Jed Blake. Hot on their trail, Britt forms a posse with a gunslinging deputy and a stoic Pawnee tracker. But Jed and Britt tread dangerously close to the Red Desert’s Sioux territory.
documents.plot:
Catch the Bullet is a 2021 American Western action film directed by Michael Feifer and written by Jerry Robbins, produced by Feifer Worldwide and released by Lionsgate and Grindstone Entertainment Group. It stars Jay Pickett as U.S. Marshal Britt McMasters, Tom Skerritt as his father Dex, Mason McNulty as his son Chad, Gattlin Griffith as the outlaw Jed Blake, Callder Griffith as Deputy Clay Tucker, Cody Jones as the tracker Chaska and Peter Facinelli as Sheriff Wilkins. It was Pickett's last film, released after his death from a heart attack in July 2021, and is dedicated to him. It runs 88 minutes under the tagline "The sun never sets on vengeance."

In Buffalo, Wyoming, in the late nineteenth century, McMasters is a widowed marshal with a reputation for bringing outlaws back dead, whose long absences have left his twelve-year-old son Chad resentful and in the care of his grandfather Dex. While Britt is away for three months tracking a bank robber and his accomplices, Jed Blake, an escaped prisoner whom McMasters once sent to jail for bank robbery, rides up to the ranch with his gang looking for revenge. Finding the marshal absent, Jed shoots Dex, leaving him badly wounded on the porch, kills Chad's young friend Albert and kidnaps Chad, knowing that his father will follow. When Britt returns and learns what has happened, Sheriff Wilkins, a longtime friend, cannot join the pursuit and assigns his inexperienced deputy Clay Tucker to accompany him. Because Tucker lacks tracking skills, they enlist Chaska, a Pawnee tracker with a white missionary mother, whom the racist deputy refuses to trust. Hot on the gang's trail, the small posse follows Jed into the Red Desert and into Sioux territory, where war parties have left dead settlers in their wake, while Chad tries to escape his captors and Jed prepares to settle his old score with the marshal.

The film was released in select US cinemas and on digital platforms on 10 September 2021, and on DVD and Blu-ray days later. Reviews were mostly negative. Mark Franklin of Once Upon a Time in a Western found it not bad for a modern Western, praising the gritty performances of Pickett and Gattlin Griffith. Jim Morazzini of Nerdly gave it 2.5 out of 5, calling it predictable and flatly directed, and noting that Skerritt and Facinelli had little screen time. Carla Hay of Culture Mix dismissed it as an amateurish dud with cringeworthy dialogue.

documents.title: Crush
documents.tagline: Love is messy AF.
documents.overview: When an aspiring young artist is forced to join her high school track team, she uses it as an opportunity to pursue the girl she's been harboring a long-time crush on. But she soon finds herself falling for an unexpected teammate and discovers what real love feels like.
documents.plot:
Crush is a 2022 American coming-of-age romantic comedy directed by Sammi Cohen in their feature debut and written by Kirsten King and Casey Rackham, who drew on their own experiences to tell an LGBTQ story centered on queer joy rather than on coming out. Rowan Blanchard stars as Paige Evans and Auliʻi Cravalho as AJ Campos, with Isabella Ferreira as AJ's twin sister, Gabby, Tyler Alvarez, Teala Dunn, Aasif Mandvi, Michelle Buteau and Megan Mullally.

Paige, an art-loving student at Miller High School, hopes to attend a summer program at her dream school, CalArts, but struggles with its application prompt asking her to describe her happiest moment, and considers writing about her longtime unrequited crush on the popular Gabby. Meanwhile, an anonymous artist known as KingPun has been covering the school with pun-filled graffiti, and because of her interest in art, Paige is widely suspected. To avoid suspension she agrees to join the track team and to help uncover the real culprit. Lacking athletic talent, she is placed in the 4×100 relay with Gabby and AJ, and AJ is assigned to train her.

Paige enlists AJ's help in her investigation, including at a house party she thinks KingPun will attend. During a stakeout at the school, Paige and Gabby share an awkward first kiss, and Paige's friend Dillon suggests that her crush may simply have faded as she grows closer to AJ. On a team trip to a meet, a game of seven minutes in heaven pairs Paige with AJ and they kiss, which AJ believes is a first for both of them. That night Paige turns down Gabby's attempt to kiss her. After Miller High finishes second in the relay, Gabby apologizes to Paige and inadvertently reveals their earlier kiss, leaving AJ heartbroken; AJ then reveals that she is KingPun. Paige tries to take the blame, only to learn that AJ has already confessed and been suspended. With Gabby's help, Paige makes amends at a school assembly with a large mural of the moments she and AJ have shared, which she also submits to CalArts. AJ's suspension is lifted, and the two reconcile with another kiss.

Filmed in the Syracuse area of New York in the summer of 2021 under the working title Love in Color, Crush was released on Hulu on April 29, 2022, and was the third most-streamed film in the United States that week. It holds 83% on Rotten Tomatoes and 56 on Metacritic, and Variety praised the diversity of its cast and the leads' chemistry.

documents.title: Last Man Down
documents.tagline: They will pay.
documents.overview: After civilization succumbs to a deadly pandemic and his wife is murdered, a special forces soldier abandons his duty and becomes a hermit in the Nordic wilderness. Years later, a wounded woman appears on his doorstep. She's escaped from a lab and her pursuers believe her blood is the key to a worldwide cure. He's hesitant to get involved, but all doubts are cast aside when he discovers her pursuer is none other than Commander Stone, the man that murdered his wife some years ago.
documents.plot:
Last Man Down is a 2021 Swedish-British post-apocalyptic action film directed by Fansu Njie from a screenplay by Andreas Vasshaug, based on a story by Njie and its star Daniel Stisen, who also produced it with Njie through Daniel Stisen Productions and Fansu Film. Stisen, a Norwegian actor from Mandal previously seen in small background roles in films such as Edge of Tomorrow, Spectre and Justice League, plays the lead role, with Olga Kent, Daniel Nehme, Stanislav Yanevski, Madeleine Vall and Natassia Malthe in supporting roles. The film was released on digital and on-demand platforms in North America by Saban Films on 19 October 2021, and became available to buy and rent in Norway in February 2022.

The story is set in a dystopian Europe where most of the population has been wiped out by a deadly virus. John Wood (Stisen), a special forces soldier who is immune to the disease, deserts his armed unit after its commander, Stone (Nehme), takes him captive and murders his wife; Stone is convinced that controlling a cure will hand him an empire. Years later Wood lives as a brooding hermit in a cabin in the Nordic wilderness, spending his days chopping wood, until a badly wounded woman, Maria (Kent), stumbles out of the forest one night. She has escaped from a laboratory, and her pursuers believe her blood holds the key to a worldwide cure. Wood reluctantly nurses her back to health and slowly grows used to her company, but armed soldiers soon track them to the cabin and launch a series of deadly attacks. When he learns that the man hunting Maria is Stone, Wood casts aside his doubts and prepares for a final confrontation.

Critics noted the film's deliberate homage to 1980s muscle-bound action films. Birger Vestmo of NRK's Filmpolitiet gave it three out of six, describing it as an old-fashioned actioner of the kind once rented on VHS, plainly modelled on Commando, with the same awkward one-liners but plenty of cheerful violent drive, and judged that Stisen proved capable of far more than his earlier extra work. Lee B. Golden III of Film Combat Syndicate saw potential in Stisen but found much of the fight work more miss than hit, the timeline confusing and the villain's backstory a contrived twist. Emilie Black of Cinema Crazed praised a few well-executed fights but felt the familiar story lost the viewer's interest early and much of the acting was wooden.

documents.title: Tyson's Run
documents.tagline: With each step comes the determination to take another.
documents.overview: When fifteen-year-old Tyson attends public school for the first time, his life is changed forever. While helping his father clean up after the football team, Tyson befriends champion marathon runner Aklilu. Never letting his autism hold him back, Tyson becomes determined to run his first marathon in hopes of winning his father's approval.  With the help of an unlikely friend and his parents, Tyson learns that with faith in yourself and the courage to take the first step, anything is possible.
documents.plot:
Tyson's Run is a 2022 American sports drama written and directed by Kim Bass, starring Major Dodson as Tyson, an autistic teenager, Rory Cochrane as his father Bobby, a high school football coach, Amy Smart as his mother Eloise and Barkhad Abdi as Aklilu, a former champion marathon runner. The film tells the story of a boy who sets out to win a marathon and, in the process, transforms his relationship with his father.

Tyson has been homeschooled by his mother, but when she can no longer teach him algebra, he asks to attend the public high school where his father coaches football. Bobby, whose own hopes of a professional football career were ended by an injury, has never known how to connect with his son and reluctantly agrees. At school, Tyson is bullied by a student named Bradley but makes a friend in Shannon. Meanwhile, Eloise discovers that she is pregnant and worries that the baby may also be autistic.

Tyson meets Aklilu, a renowned marathon runner who now runs an athletic shoe store, and the two form a friendship. After being falsely blamed for a classmate's misconduct and overhearing his parents arguing about him, Tyson runs away into a violent storm and becomes trapped in a pond. Bobby finds him and, realizing he could lose his son, stays with him until help arrives. Afterward, Bobby resolves to be a better father, and when Tyson announces that he wants to train with Aklilu to run a marathon, Bobby must overcome his doubts, as well as the town's opposition and the controversy surrounding Aklilu's past, to support his son's dream.

The film explores autism, family and perseverance, and Bass was unaware when casting Dodson that the young actor is on the autism spectrum.

Tyson's Run was filmed in Atlanta, Marietta and Stockbridge, Georgia, beginning in July 2018, and released in select theaters in March 2022, earning about 212,800 dollars in its opening weekend. Reviews were mixed; Rotten Tomatoes recorded 60 percent approval from a small number of reviews, and KGET-TV found its pacing weak but praised its family elements.

documents.title: Swim
documents.tagline: If you can't run...
documents.overview: A family gets trapped in their storm flooded vacation rental, tries to escape from a hungry shark that made it's way into the house.
documents.plot:
Swim is a 2021 American shark horror film produced by The Asylum and directed by Jared Cohn, from a script credited to Anthony C. Ferrante, the director of the Sharknado franchise. Its cast includes Jennifer Field, Joey Lawrence, Andy Lauer, Brett Hargrave, Daniel Grogan, Rib Hillis, Addison Bowman, David Hutchison and Trevor B. Nagle. Like several of the studio's titles, it reworks the premise of a recent hit, in this case the survival thriller Crawl, moving the confined-space threat from alligators to a shark.

Lacey Samon (Field) heads to a beach rental house for a week by the sea with her two teenage children, played by Hargrave and Grogan, continuing a family tradition begun by her father Noah (Lauer), an ailing man who relies on an oxygen tank and joins them on the trip. Her husband (Lawrence) is supposed to follow by car from San Francisco. On arrival the family discovers that badly needed repairs on the house were never finished, leaving the basement flooded just as a powerful storm rolls in. What begins as a relaxing getaway turns into a nightmare when the rising floodwater carries a hungry shark into the house. Trapped by the storm, with the water climbing and injuries slowing them down, the family must fend off the predator inside the flooded rooms, improvising weapons from household objects while trying to stay above the waterline. Noah makes a sacrifice to protect the others, and the father finally arrives late in the film to join the fight for survival.

Swim premiered on the free streaming service Tubi on 13 August 2021. Much of it was filmed in a pool and on built sets, and it was shot in a widescreen 2.39:1 format that gave it a slightly more polished look than many comparable low-budget productions. Reviews were largely negative. Knockout Horror gave it one and a half stars out of five, acknowledging the cast's commitment under waterlogged shooting conditions and the film's relatively expensive appearance but criticizing its thin script, implausible casting of family members' ages, shark effects that kept changing scale, poor lighting and visible continuity errors. Cinematic Diversions was more forgiving, rating it six out of ten as an entertaining if clumsy entry in the genre, with decent shark effects and a story that was serviceable by the standards of shark movies, though it mocked the late appearance of top-billed Lawrence.

documents.title: Catwoman: Hunted
documents.tagline: Predator becomes prey.
documents.overview: Catwoman's attempt to steal a priceless jewel puts her squarely in the crosshairs of both a powerful consortium of villains and the ever-resourceful Interpol, not to mention Batwoman.
documents.plot:
Catwoman: Hunted is a 2022 American animated superhero film based on the DC Comics character created by Bill Finger and Bob Kane. Produced by Warner Bros. Animation for DC Entertainment as the 48th entry in the DC Universe Animated Original Movies line, it was directed by Shinsuke Terasawa from a screenplay by Greg Weisman, with animation in an anime style provided by the Japanese studio OLM. Elizabeth Gillies voices Catwoman and Stephanie Beatriz voices Batwoman, with Jonathan Banks, Steve Blum and Lauren Cohan among the supporting cast.

Catwoman slips into a costume party for criminals hosted by Barbara Minerva, believed to lead the secret criminal organization Leviathan, intending to steal the Cat's Eye Emerald from the Gotham City mobster Black Mask. She escapes a horde of gangsters only to be knocked out by Batwoman, while Minerva's associate Tobias Whale recovers the gem, and the furious Minerva puts a price on Catwoman's head. Catwoman wakes up on a plane to Shanghai in the custody of Batwoman and the Interpol agents Julia Pennyworth and King Faraday, who plan to use the emerald as a tracking device to find Leviathan's leadership. Promised a full pardon in return for her help, she agrees, while secretly keeping in touch with her friend Holly, who looks after a group of young girls in her care. At Leviathan's base, Catwoman and Batwoman fight the assassins Cheshire and Nosferata and several of the group's senior members, who are captured, but Minerva escapes.

Pardoned, Catwoman goes back to her life, but she is soon targeted by League of Assassins killers sent by Talia al Ghul, Leviathan's real leader. With Batwoman's help she fights them off, only for the pair to be ambushed by Solomon Grundy. After Catwoman defeats him, Minerva transforms into her monstrous Cheetah form and attacks. Badly wounded, Catwoman taunts her by revealing that she has secretly dismantled one of Leviathan's human trafficking rings and freed its captives. Their brutal fight ends with Batwoman rescuing Catwoman, and Interpol arrests Minerva and Grundy. Warning Faraday that Leviathan is still a threat, Catwoman reclaims the emerald and sets off to rob the Tower of London.

The film was released on Ultra HD Blu-ray, Blu-ray and DVD on February 8, 2022. Reviews were generally positive; IGN's Jesse Schedeen praised it as a fun, anime-flavored adventure among the best in the line.

documents.title: Me Time
documents.tagline: This is not what he had in mind.
documents.overview: With his family away, a devoted stay-at-home dad enjoys his first me time in years by joining his hard-partying old friend on a wild birthday adventure.
documents.plot:
Me Time is a 2022 American buddy comedy written and directed by John Hamburg. Kevin Hart stars as a devoted stay-at-home father and Mark Wahlberg as his free-spirited former best friend, with Regina Hall, Luis Gerardo Méndez and Jimmy O. Yang in supporting roles. Netflix released it on August 26, 2022.

Sonny and Huck were inseparable friends from high school, celebrating Huck's birthday together every year until a near-death experience during one of their adventures fifteen years earlier led Sonny to settle down. Now a stay-at-home dad devoted to his family, Sonny keeps turning down Huck's yearly invitations. When his successful architect wife, Maya, takes their children to visit her parents, Sonny finds himself with some "me time" for the first time in years. He quickly grows bored and lonely: his golf is terrible, a barbecue binge ends badly, his friends are busy and his children do not seem to miss him. He finally accepts Huck's invitation to an extravagant birthday weekend.

Huck's celebration starts with skinny-dipping and a chartered bus and continues in the desert, where the guests are expected to forage for their food. Sonny fends off a mountain lion with an EpiPen. Meanwhile he grows jealous of Armando, Maya's wealthy and charming client, who offers her a major project, and a phone call with his wife turns into a shouting match. When Huck's loan shark arrives demanding the $47,000 he is owed, his enforcer breaks Sonny's finger and burns the camp down. Left alone together, Huck admits that he has fallen on hard times and is lonely. On the way home, the pair break into Armando's house and play pranks that are caught on camera.

Sonny then offers his own house for the rest of Huck's party, which spirals out of control after it is advertised online, with the singer Seal joining Sonny for a jam session. Maya and the children return in the middle of the chaos, and she asks Sonny to move out for a while. During their separation, Sonny apologizes to Armando and reflects on his behavior. At his son's school talent show, he realizes that he has been controlling and selfish, and apologizes to his family. He reconciles with Maya, and persuades Huck to go into business with him as party planners.

Me Time received largely negative reviews; Rotten Tomatoes reported only 7% approval, its consensus calling it a desperately unfunny comedy that wastes its stars, and Metacritic gave it 25 out of 100.

documents.title: Bar Fight
documents.tagline: Time to settle the score one drink at a time.
documents.overview: Nina and Allen split everything in their lives 50/50 after their break-up to avoid any drama—everything, that is, except for their favorite local bar. Nina and Allen must compete in a ridiculous, tavern-style custody battle for their prized watering hole, in which lines will be drawn, sides will be chosen, and beers will be drunken.
documents.plot:
Bar Fight! is a 2022 American romantic comedy written and directed by Jim Mahoney and released by IFC Films. Melissa Fumero and Luka Jones star as Nina and Allen, a Los Angeles couple who have just broken up, with Rachel Bloom as Nina's best friend Chelsea, Julian Gant as Allen's business partner Milan, Vik Sahay as the bar's manager Dick, Dot-Marie Jones as the cook Elena, Daniel Dorr and Shontae Saldana as bartenders, Patrick Byas as the bouncer and Hope Lauren as a new waitress, Autumn.

After five years together, Nina and Allen, a laid-back furniture maker, are going through the most amicable of separations, set during the holiday season. When we first meet them they are cheerfully running a yard sale in Venice, and they divide everything, from the furniture to the giant television, fifty-fifty without a single argument. The one thing they cannot split is their favorite local hangout, the Martinez Bar & Lounge. On their first night out as singles, Allen arrives with Milan and Nina with Chelsea, a married mother of two who lives vicariously through her newly unattached friend, and the two exes realise they cannot both remain regulars.

With the staff's loyalties divided, a tavern-style custody battle is devised: Nina and Allen must face each other in a series of bar challenges, and the loser will be banned from the Martinez for good. The contests include a tricycle race through the bar, blindfolded darts, human bowling and a race to collect the most phone numbers from strangers before closing time. Around the competition the film sketches the bar's regulars and employees: a pushover manager who cannot stop an older woman from stealing the copper Moscow Mule mugs, a charming bartender with no ambition, a fearsome cook and a customer who pretends to be an agent to cadge free drinks. In a more wistful final stretch, Allen's settled, stuck-in-place nature and Nina's restlessness come to the surface as the couple confront why they split.

The film was released in theaters, on demand and on AMC+ on 11 November 2022. Reviews were mostly negative, with under a fifth of critics positive on Rotten Tomatoes. The Guardian found the premise nifty but the challenges dull and the main characters underwritten, while Movie Nation felt the comedy ran out of steam after half an hour and that Bloom's manic sidekick was its funniest element; several critics noted the chemistry between Fumero and Jones.

documents.title: Cloudy Mountain
documents.tagline: When a catastrophe comes, no one should be left behind.
documents.overview: The opening of the new tunnel, which took ten years to build, coincided with a series of serious cataclysms. The lives of 160,000 people depend on the actions of two people, a father and a son.
documents.plot:
Cloudy Mountain (Chinese: 峰爆, Fēng bào, "Peak Explosion"; working title 无限深度, "Infinite Depth") is a 2021 Chinese disaster film directed by Li Jun, who co-wrote the screenplay with Sha Song. Produced and presented by China Film and framed as a tribute to China's "railway soldiers", the military corps that built and repaired lines in dangerous terrain, it stars Zhu Yilong, Huang Zhizhong, Chen Shu and Jiao Junyan, with Cheng Taishen and cameos by Zhang Guoli, Zhang Yi, Bai Ke and Li Guangjie. Shot in Guizhou province with action by Bruce Law and music by Guo Sida, it opened in China on 17 September 2021, ahead of the National Day holiday.

In fictional Yunjiang county in south-west China, a construction team is completing a tunnel through Yundang mountain for a high-speed railway after ten years of work, in a region of fragile karst rock destabilised by movement of the Indian Ocean plate. When a blast supervised by the young engineer Hong Yizhou (Zhu) floods the tunnel, he and his girlfriend, the radar technician Lu Xiaojin (Jiao), divert the water into a cavern, and project manager Ding Yajun (Chen) halts work, although her superiors insist the line must open on time. Abseiling down the mountain to place sensors, Yizhou finds abnormal rock activity. Meanwhile his gruff father, the retired railway soldier Hong Yunbing (Huang), arrives in town just as an earthquake strikes and a vast sinkhole swallows his coach. After helping rescue survivors, Yunbing disappears underground, where he leads a small group of survivors, including a stowaway boy, through the caves. Yizhou races to find him and takes over the group, but old tensions between father and son resurface. Ding plans to blast away part of the mountain to stop it collapsing onto the rail bridge, but the predicted landslide shifts towards Yunjiang, a town of 160,000 that cannot be evacuated in time, as a storm approaches. To save the town, the railway builders resolve to blow up the tunnel that cost them a decade of work; Yizhou proves himself to his father, overcoming a phobia from his youth, and a great sacrifice is made along the way.

The film grossed just under 440 million yuan in China. Sino-Cinema rated it 6/10, finding it a solid but by-the-book disaster movie that starts strongly but becomes increasingly cartoonish and implausible in its patriotic second half, and judging Huang a stronger presence than Zhu; Cheng Taishen stood out as a veteran chief engineer.

documents.title: Emily the Criminal
documents.tagline: High risks come with even higher rewards.
documents.overview: Emily, who is saddled with student debt and locked out of the job market due to a minor criminal record, gets involved in a credit card scam that pulls her into the criminal underworld of Los Angeles, ultimately leading to deadly consequences.
documents.plot:
Emily the Criminal is a 2022 American crime drama film written and directed by John Patton Ford. The movie follows the story of Emily, a young woman who feels trapped in her mundane life and struggles to make ends meet.

The film centers around Emily (played by Aubrey Plaza), a college student who works multiple part-time jobs to support herself and her family. She is desperate for financial stability and a sense of purpose, but her circumstances seem hopeless. One day, Emily meets a charismatic and confident woman named Sarah (played by Molly Gordon) who introduces her to the world of online shopping scams.

As Emily becomes more involved in Sarah's scheme, she begins to see an opportunity to escape her difficult life and create a better future for herself. However, as she delves deeper into the world of crime, Emily starts to realize that it comes with its own set of risks and consequences.

Throughout the film, Ford explores themes of class struggle, financial insecurity, and the desperation that can drive people to make questionable choices. The movie also touches on issues of female empowerment and the ways in which women are often forced to navigate patriarchal systems to survive.

The cast delivers strong performances, with Plaza bringing a sense of vulnerability and determination to her portrayal of Emily. Gordon is equally impressive as Sarah, capturing the character's confidence and charisma while also conveying a sense of complexity and depth.

Overall, Emily the Criminal is a thought-provoking and engaging film that sheds light on the struggles faced by many young people today. With its strong performances, nuanced direction, and timely themes, it is a must-see for fans of crime dramas and anyone interested in exploring the complexities of modern life.

documents.title: A Day to Die
documents.tagline: Only the savage survive.
documents.overview: A disgraced parole officer is indebted to a local gang leader and forced to pull off a series of dangerous drug heists within twelve hours in order to pay the $2 million dollars he owes, rescue his kidnapped pregnant wife, and settle a score with the city's corrupt police chief, who is working with the gang leader and double-crossed him years ago.
documents.plot:
A Day to Die is a 2022 American heist action thriller directed, co-written and co-produced by Wes Miller. It stars Kevin Dillon as Connor Connolly, Leon as the drug kingpin Tyrone Pettis, Frank Grillo as Brice Mason and Bruce Willis as the corrupt police official Alston, with Gianni Capaldi, Brooke Butler and Vernon Davis. It was one of the low-budget films Willis made in 2021, shortly before he retired from acting following the disclosure of his cognitive decline.

The film opens with a hostage rescue carried out by Connor, Mason and their elite team on the orders of police captain Alston, an operation that goes badly wrong and leads to the team's breakup. Eighteen months later, Connor is a disgraced but dedicated parole officer, while Alston has risen to police chief. After Connor is forced into killing one of Pettis's young enforcers, a death that leaves him in the kingpin's debt, Pettis kidnaps his pregnant wife Candice and gives him twelve hours to pull off a series of dangerous drug heists and deliver the two million dollars he supposedly owes. Desperate, Connor reunites his old crew, including his brother Tim, Mason, Dwayne and Steve. Pettis is secretly in an uneasy alliance with Alston, financing his political rise in return for protection, and the drug house he sends the team to rob belongs to his main rival. After the heists and a confrontation in which Candice is rescued, Connor and Pettis reach a mutual understanding and stage one final heist to disrupt Alston's criminal operations. Alston is caught on camera shooting a subordinate who was catching on to his schemes and is arrested, while Connor, Pettis and Candice flee the country.

Principal photography began in March 2021 in Jackson, Mississippi, the first feature shot in the city that year, and wrapped after six weeks in April, with final scenes filmed at Hawkins Field Airport. Vertical Entertainment acquired the rights in May 2021 and released it in select theaters and on video on demand on 4 March 2022. Against a five-million-dollar budget, it grossed under 100,000 dollars abroad. Critics found it generic. Decider advised viewers to skip it, faulting a choppy, confusing opening, awkward CGI blood and a muddled plot with a finale borrowed from Heat, while praising Leon's performance and Grillo's gravitas and noting that many of Willis's lines are delivered over the phone. Some action-focused outlets called it a serviceable, bullet-riddled time-waster with a strong final battle.

documents.title: Mickey's Tale of Two Witches
documents.overview: On Halloween, Mickey tells a tale of two witches-in-training, Minnie and Daisy, who must pass four tests to graduate from the With Academy in Happy Haunt Hills.
documents.plot:
Mickey's Tale of Two Witches is a 2021 American animated Halloween television special produced by Disney Television Animation for Disney Junior. Directed by Jeff Gordon and written by Thomas Hart, it runs about 46 minutes and was the first special spun off from the series Mickey Mouse Mixed-Up Adventures, followed later in 2021 by Mickey and Minnie Wish Upon a Christmas. It premiered on Disney Junior on 7 October 2021, was made available on DisneyNow, and began streaming on Disney+ the following day.

On Halloween, Mickey tells Pluto a story about two witches-in-training, Minnie the Wonderful and Daisy Doozy, who must pass four magical tests set by Witch Master Clarabelle in order to graduate from the Witch Academy in Happy Haunt Hills. Daisy doubts herself at every test. Their studies are disrupted when a mischievous ghost gets hold of the powerful Moo Wand, and the two apprentices join forces with Count Mickula and the rest of the gang, who appear in Halloween guises such as Franken-Goof, Mummy Donald and Werewolfy Pluto, to defeat him. Along the way Minnie and Daisy learn that working together makes both their magic and their friendship stronger.

The voice cast is led by Bret Iwan as Mickey and Count Mickula, Kaitlyn Robrock as Minnie, Tress MacNeille as Daisy and April Winchell as Clarabelle, with Bill Farmer as Goofy and Pluto, Daniel Ross as Donald, Jim Cummings as Pete the Ghost, Nika Futterman as Cuckoo-Loca and Frank Welker as Figaro and Butch the Bulldog. The special features four songs: "How to Witch", sung by the two witches and their teacher; "The Fright Stuff", performed by Pete the Ghost; "Spooky Side"; and the finale "Spooky Spirit".

Its first airing on Disney Junior drew about 350,000 viewers, and a Disney Channel rebroadcast the next morning about 300,000. Critics recommended it as Halloween viewing for young children: Kristy Ambrose of TheGamer named it one of the best Disney Halloween films, praising its sweetness and its message that magic works best when friendship is the main ingredient, Real Simple called it a "super sweet" choice for families, and Good Housekeeping and Romper highlighted its emphasis on teamwork and its songs and spells. It was nominated at the 2023 Kidscreen Awards, and in July 2023 Disney Publishing Worldwide released a tie-in book.

documents.title: Mickey and Minnie Wish Upon a Christmas
documents.original_title: Mickey and Minnie Wish Upon a Christmas
documents.overview: After a series of mishaps, Mickey, Minnie and the gang are separated all over the world and must try to get back to Hot Dog Hills by Christmas Eve. A mysterious and jolly stranger shows up to tell them about The Wishing Star, which could be the secret to bringing everybody home in time to celebrate together.
documents.plot:
Mickey and Minnie Wish Upon a Christmas is a 2021 animated television special produced by Disney Television Animation, featuring the iconic characters from the Mickey Mouse universe. The story revolves around Mickey and Minnie's holiday season, filled with festive cheer, adventure, and heartwarming moments.

The special begins on a snowy winter evening in Toontown, where Mickey and Minnie are busy preparing for Christmas. They decorate their home, bake cookies, and sing festive tunes to get into the holiday spirit. However, things take an unexpected turn when Minnie's magical Christmas ornament goes missing.

As the night falls, Minnie becomes worried that she'll lose her special gift from Santa Claus. Mickey decides to help his beloved partner find the ornament, and they embark on a thrilling adventure through Toontown. Along the way, they meet various friends, including Pluto, Goofy, and Donald Duck, who join in the quest.

As they search for the missing ornament, Mickey and Minnie encounter a mischievous character named Pete, who's trying to ruin Christmas for everyone in Toontown. With the help of their friends, Mickey and Minnie outsmart Pete and his accomplices, leading them on a wild goose chase through the snowy streets.

Throughout their journey, Mickey and Minnie learn valuable lessons about the true meaning of Christmas: kindness, generosity, and the importance of spending quality time with loved ones. As they near the end of their quest, they discover that the missing ornament was hidden in a special place, where it would bring joy to all those who found it.

In the end, Mickey and Minnie successfully recover the ornament, and Christmas magic is restored to Toontown. The special concludes with a heartwarming scene of Mickey and Minnie sharing a romantic dinner, surrounded by their friends and family, as they celebrate the holiday season together.

Throughout the special, Disney Television Animation brings its signature charm and wit to the story, infusing it with humor, excitement, and warmth. The animation is vibrant and colorful, perfectly capturing the whimsical spirit of Toontown. Mickey and Minnie's chemistry shines through in their interactions, making their adventure a delightful treat for audiences of all ages.

Overall, Mickey and Minnie Wish Upon a Christmas is a delightful holiday special that celebrates the joy, love, and magic of the season. With its engaging storyline, lovable characters, and festive atmosphere, it's sure to become a cherished tradition for families and Disney fans alike.

documents.title: Hypnotic
documents.tagline: His wish is her command.
documents.overview: A young woman seeking self-improvement enlists the help of a renowned hypnotist but, after a handful of intense sessions, discovers unexpected and deadly consequences.
documents.plot: A young woman seeking self-improvement enlists the help of a renowned hypnotist but, after a handful of intense sessions, discovers unexpected and deadly consequences.

documents.title: The Curse of Bridge Hollow
documents.tagline: Halloween comes to life.
documents.overview: A Halloween-hating dad reluctantly teams up with his teenage daughter when an evil spirit wreaks havoc by making their town's decorations come to life.
documents.plot:
The Curse of Bridge Hollow is a 2022 American supernatural comedy horror film directed by Jeff Wadlow from a screenplay by Todd Berger and Robert Rugan. Marlon Wayans stars as a scientist who has no patience for Halloween, with Priah Ferguson as his daughter, Kelly Rowland as his wife, and John Michael Higgins, Lauren Lapkus, Rob Riggle and Nia Vardalos in supporting roles. Netflix released the film on October 14, 2022.

The Gordon family moves from Brooklyn to the small town of Bridge Hollow, which is obsessed with Halloween. Teenage Sydney, known as Syd, is delighted by the town's elaborate decorations and celebrations, while her father, Howard, a rational scientist who dismisses anything supernatural, finds them ridiculous. At her new school, Syd meets the members of the Paranormal Society, who tell her that the Gordons' new house is believed to be haunted. Her mother, Emily, tries to join in the community spirit by baking healthy, gluten-free and sugar-free treats for the town's Stingy Jack festival.

In the house, Syd finds an old jack-o'-lantern and lights it, unwittingly releasing the evil spirit of Stingy Jack. Jack brings the town's Halloween decorations to life, turning them into his menacing minions, and must claim a soul at midnight to take his place in the lantern. Syd and a reluctant Howard visit an elderly woman in a nursing home who explains the curse.

As the possessed decorations wreak havoc, Syd, Howard and the Paranormal Society search for a way to trap Jack again. They learn that a page from an old spell book containing the necessary incantation is held by their school principal, and later seek the words from the ghost of the book's original owner, who haunts the Gordons' house. While the others try to protect the town square from the rampaging decorations, Syd and Howard realize that Emily has gone home and is in danger.

Jack, mistaking Emily for the person who released him, tries to take her soul. Howard repeatedly attempts the incantation, but it works only when Syd reminds him that he must believe in it. Jack is trapped once more, and the decorations fall lifeless. Afterward, Howard embraces Halloween, Syd joins the Paranormal Society, and Emily abandons her healthy recipes. As Howard and Syd store the lantern, they discover a hidden room filled with more boxes of lanterns.

The film received mixed to negative reviews; Rotten Tomatoes reported 46% approval and Metacritic a score of 38.

documents.title: Your Christmas Or Mine?
documents.overview: Students Hayley and James are young and in love. After saying goodbye for Christmas at a London train station, they both make the same mad split-second decision to swap trains and surprise each other. Passing each other in the station, they are completely unaware that they have just swapped Christmases.
documents.plot:
Your Christmas or Mine? is a 2022 British Christmas romantic comedy directed by Jim O'Hanlon from a screenplay by Tom Parry. Asa Butterfield and Cora Kirk star as a young couple who each decide to surprise the other over the holidays, with Daniel Mays, Angela Griffin, Harriet Walter, David Bradley and Alex Jennings. It was filmed in and around London and Buckinghamshire in 2021.

University students James Hughes and Hayley Taylor are in love but have kept their relationship secret from their families. Parting at a London station before Christmas, each impulsively jumps aboard the other's train in order to surprise them, and both end up spending the holiday with the other's family. Hayley arrives at the grand country house of James's widowed, stern father, Humphrey, an aristocrat and former army officer, while James finds himself among Hayley's loud, warm, working-class family in Macclesfield. A heavy snowfall cancels every train, leaving them stranded. They agree to keep up appearances; Humphrey believes that James is training at Sandhurst, unaware that he long ago dropped out to study drama, and Hayley's attempt to pose as a fellow cadet quickly collapses.

Hayley tries to brighten the gloomy house with decorations, but she accidentally lets out Humphrey's dog, which is wounded by an elderly neighbor, Jack, and she infuriates Humphrey by taking the decorations from the study of his late wife, Fiona, a room he has kept closed. Meanwhile James is welcomed with open arms until he meets Steve, who introduces himself as Hayley's fiancé without mentioning that she broke up with him months earlier. Goaded by Steve during family games, James loses his temper, reveals that he is Hayley's boyfriend and storms off.

After an angry phone call with James, Hayley sets off on foot through the snow without her asthma inhaler and collapses. Humphrey, who has admitted to Iris, a member of his household, that grief has consumed him since Fiona's death, finds and rescues her with the help of his dog. Hayley's family, relieved that she has left Steve, drive James back to his father's house, and the couple reconcile. Humphrey makes peace with Jack, who turns out to be his own estranged father, and at a joint Christmas dinner at the Taylors' home, he accepts James's choice to pursue acting.

Released on Prime Video on December 2, 2022, it drew generally positive reviews, though some found it reliant on familiar tropes. A sequel followed in 2023.

documents.title: Good Mourning
documents.tagline: When life hits a new low, reach for a new high.
documents.overview: Movie star London Clash gets his world turned upside down when he must choose between pursuing his one true love and landing a life-changing starring role in a major motion picture.
documents.plot: Movie star London Clash gets his world turned upside down when he must choose between pursuing his one true love and landing a life-changing starring role in a major motion picture.

documents.title: Megalodon Rising
documents.tagline: Too big to fail.
documents.overview: When history’s greatest aquatic predator returns, the armada of modern warships sent to destroy it has no chance at all.
documents.plot:
Megalodon Rising is a 2021 American action and science fiction creature film directed by Brian Nowak and produced by The Asylum as a sequel to its 2018 film Megalodon, once again trading on the popularity of the studio blockbuster The Meg. Tom Sizemore receives top billing as Commander Moore, although he appears only briefly in his office, while the lead role of Captain Emily Lynch, sister of the commander from the first film, is played by Wynter Eddins. The cast also includes O'Shay Neal as Lieutenant Commander Ahearn, Freda Yifan Jing as Dr. Lee, Zhan Wang as Captain Ping, Lisa Lee as Tuan and Chris Grant Wenchell as Samperio.

After a Chinese warship enters American waters while relaying classified US government information to a satellite, it is attacked and sunk by a megalodon. Nearby, an American warship commanded by Lynch is on patrol; Lynch is troubled because her sister faces a court-martial for allegedly sinking her own ship on purpose, and her claim that a giant shark was responsible has been dismissed as a lie. The crew recovers Dr. Lee, a scientist who survived the sinking in a life raft, and another Chinese warship under Captain Ping demands her return, threatening to treat a refusal as an act of war, with the crewmember Tuan acting as interpreter.

Tensions rise when three megalodons attack the Chinese ship and then the American vessel, leading Ping to suspect the Americans can control the sharks. When gunner Samperio kills one of the creatures, the others feed on it, allowing the ships to escape. Lynch contacts Moore, and the sharks head for a crowded beach in San Diego, where troops are sent to defend the coast; Dr. Lee and the radio operator Wilco lure them away by imitating the satellite signal. Returning to sea, the sharks sink the Chinese reinforcements one by one. The Americans rescue the Chinese survivors, kill a second shark with their guns, and Lynch makes peace with Ping before the two crews kill the last one together, although Wilco dies. Lynch publicly announces the attacks and the new alliance with China, but a final sonar reading reveals two more objects in the ocean.

Because of COVID-19 restrictions, the film used very few extras, and the sharks and many warship shots were created with CGI. German critics dismissed its effects, dialogue and characters, finding little to recommend beyond the sharks themselves.

documents.title: Raymond & Ray
documents.tagline: Two brothers. One final request.
documents.overview: Half brothers Raymond and Ray reunite when their estranged father dies—and discover that his final wish was for them to dig his grave. Together, they process who they’ve become as men, both because of their father and in spite of him.
documents.plot: Half brothers Raymond and Ray reunite when their estranged father dies—and discover that his final wish was for them to dig his grave. Together, they process who they've become as men, both because of their father and in spite of him.

documents.title: The Passenger
documents.tagline: Don't sit next to her
documents.overview: Four people traveling in a van run over a lone woman while she is walking in the dark down a country road. After loading her into the vehicle to take her to the nearest hospital, they notice that she is behaving rather strangely. The occupants of the van soon realise that the time has come to fight for their lives, and together they agree on one very simple rule: "do not sit next to her."
documents.plot:
The Passenger (Spanish: La pasajera) is a 2021 Spanish science-fiction comedy horror road movie directed by Raúl Cerezo and Fernando González Gómez. Ramiro Blas, Cecilia Suárez, Paula Gallego and Cristina Alcázar lead the cast. The screenplay was written by Luis Sánchez-Polack, based on an earlier script by Javier Echániz and Asier Guerricaechebarría.

The story brings together four very different people who share a ride in a battered van across the sparsely populated Spanish countryside. Behind the wheel is a crude, middle-aged driver with outdated attitudes and a fondness for crass jokes. His passengers are a pious Mexican woman and a well-to-do woman traveling with her rebellious teenage daughter, with whom she has a tense relationship. The awkward journey, filled with bickering and uncomfortable silences, takes a dark turn after an accident on a lonely road at night. The group soon comes into contact with an extraterrestrial parasite that takes possession of women's bodies and decapitates men, and the mismatched travelers are forced to set aside their differences in a desperate fight for survival as night falls.

The film is a co-production of Persons Films, La Dalia Films, SG Producciones and Eye Slice Pictures, with support from the Government of Navarre and the Navarra Film Office, and it was shot entirely in Navarre. It screened at the Sitges Film Festival on 9 October 2021 and was released theatrically in Spain by Karma Films on 18 February 2022. Dark Star Pictures distributed it in the United States, opening it in a limited theatrical release on 3 June 2022 ahead of streaming and DVD availability later that month.

The film received generally positive notices. Rotten Tomatoes reports a 73% approval rating from 15 reviews, with an average of 6.5/10. Dennis Harvey of Variety felt that although it never transcends its creature-feature premise, its style and humor make reaching a familiar destination more fun than most similar films, and Andrew Mack of ScreenAnarchy praised the way it sprinkles its action with dark humor. Pablo Tocino of Mondosonoro singled out the performances of Ramiro Blas and Paula Gallego. Other Spanish critics were cooler: Miguel Ángel Romero of Cinemanía and Beatriz Martínez of El Periódico de Catalunya each gave it two stars out of five, the latter pointing to the film's ambiguous attitude toward machismo, while Romero described a blend of B-movie exploitation and Spanish costumbrismo.

documents.title: Marcel the Shell with Shoes On
documents.original_title: Marcel the Shell with Shoes On
documents.tagline: Everybody loves Marcel.
documents.overview: Marcel is an adorable one-inch-tall shell who ekes out a colorful existence with his grandmother Connie and their pet lint, Alan. Once part of a sprawling community of shells, they now live alone as the sole survivors of a mysterious tragedy. But when a documentary filmmaker discovers them amongst the clutter of his Airbnb, the short film he posts online brings Marcel millions of passionate fans, as well as unprecedented dangers and a new hope at finding his long-lost family.
documents.plot:
Marcel the Shell with Shoes On is a heartwarming stop-motion animated film that explores several poignant themes. At its core, the movie delves into the complexities of loneliness, human connection, and the power of storytelling.

The film follows Marcel, a small shell with big emotions, as he navigates his life in New York City. Marcel's struggles to form meaningful relationships and find his place in the world are deeply relatable, making him an endearing protagonist. The movie masterfully conveys the pain of loneliness and the longing for human connection through Marcel's interactions with various characters.

One of the primary themes of Marcel the Shell with Shoes On is the importance of storytelling as a means of self-expression and connection. Marcel's love for filmmaking serves as a catalyst for his emotional growth, allowing him to process his feelings and share them with others. The film highlights the therapeutic benefits of creative expression and the value of sharing one's story with others.

The movie also explores the theme of identity and self-discovery. Marcel's journey is marked by his struggles to define himself and find his place in the world. Through his experiences, he learns to accept and love himself for who he is, flaws and all.

Furthermore, Marcel the Shell with Shoes On touches on the theme of grief and loss. The film's narrative is woven around Marcel's relationship with his deceased mother, who appears through a series of animated sequences. These scenes serve as a poignant reminder of the impact of loss on individuals and the importance of honoring one's loved ones.

Overall, Marcel the Shell with Shoes On is a beautifully crafted film that explores universal themes with sensitivity and nuance. Its thoughtful portrayal of loneliness, storytelling, identity, and grief makes it a relatable and endearing watch for audiences of all ages.

documents.title: Sanctuary
documents.tagline: Play by her rules.
documents.overview: Confined to a claustrophobic hotel room, the heir to a hotel empire and the dominatrix who has primed him for success become locked in a battle of wits and wills as he tries to end his relationship with her.
documents.plot:
Sanctuary is a 2022 American dark comedy psychological thriller film directed by Zachary Wigon from a screenplay by Micah Bloomberg. Margaret Qualley stars as Rebecca Marin, a dominatrix, and Christopher Abbott as Hal Porterfield, her wealthy client, who share an emotionally explosive final session as he prepares to take over his late father's hotel empire. The casting of Qualley and Abbott was announced in September 2021, and principal photography took place in New York City.

Hal orders room service in a luxurious hotel suite as Rebecca arrives, apparently to interview him for the job of chief executive of the hotel chain. Her questions grow increasingly personal and humiliating, and it becomes clear that she is a dominatrix following a script that Hal himself has written. Over dinner afterward, out of character, Hal explains that with his father's death he is about to become CEO of the family company, that their relationship no longer fits his new life, and that this must be their last session; he offers her an expensive watch as a farewell gift. Insulted, Rebecca storms out, only to return and turn the tables, arguing, with the help of his father's management book, that Hal is unfit to lead and demanding a large share of his first year's salary, under threat of releasing recordings of their sessions. What follows is a long night of shifting power in which Hal veers between nonchalance and fury, tearing the suite apart in search of a hidden camera, while Rebecca alternates between mockery, seduction and vulnerability. Each tries to gain control over the other through money, threats and violence, and the line between real emotion and role play blurs as Rebecca insists that she has given up her old life because she only feels fully herself during their sessions. Even their safe word fails to end the game, and with Hal at breaking point, the pair are forced to confront what they truly mean to each other.

Sanctuary premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival on September 11, 2022, and was acquired by Neon, which gave it a limited theatrical release in the United States on May 19, 2023. Critics praised the two lead performances; it holds an 88% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus says it confounds expectations with élan, and a Metacritic score of 67.

documents.title: The Hunting
documents.tagline: Hunger runs deep.
documents.overview: When a mysterious animal attack leaves a mutilated body in the forest, a conservative small town detective must enlist the help of an eager wildlife specialist to uncover the dark and disturbing truth that threatens the town.
documents.plot:
The Hunting is a 2021 American werewolf horror film written and directed by Mark Andrew Hamer, co-written by Heather Ryan and Terrance Ryan; all three were making their feature debuts. Produced by Moonphase Media and Bright Shiny Things, it stars former NFL fullback Peyton Hillis, a Madden NFL 12 cover athlete appearing in his first leading film role, alongside Joelle Westwood, Joaquin Guerrero, Keith Migra, Angela Cole, Daniel Repas, Alan Tuskes, Heidi Azaro, Billy Grimm and Matt Tifft. Vertical Entertainment gave the film a limited theatrical release and put it on digital and video-on-demand platforms in January 2022. It runs 91 minutes.

The film opens with a half-glimpsed furry creature killing a drunken fisherman on a lake under the full moon. When he fails to come home, his wife Sarah (Cole) reports him missing, one of several disappearances troubling the small town. Police chief Galligan (Repas) sends Detective Ryan Conner (Hillis), a tough, conservative military veteran haunted by memories of his wartime service, to investigate with his partner Dave (Migra), the chief's son. Meanwhile, at Talbot's Wolf Sanctuary, Maggie Talbot (Westwood) marks the first anniversary of her parents' deaths while trying, with the help of Todd (Guerrero), to keep their dream alive. When a mutilated body is found in the forest after a mysterious animal attack, Conner is forced to enlist the eager wildlife specialist to help him uncover the dark truth threatening the town. Flashbacks to Conner's combat experience punctuate the investigation, and the hunt ends with a twist revealing the identity of the creature.

The film drew mixed reviews. Jim Morazzini, writing for Voices From the Balcony in a review republished by Nerdly, gave it two and a half stars out of five, finding it badly flawed but watchable; he praised the use of a practical man-in-a-suit creature rather than CGI but felt the heavy subplot about post-traumatic stress disorder would alienate viewers expecting a werewolf film, and called the final reveal, which hinges on a character never established as a suspect, a lazy cheat. Jeff Turner of Action Reloaded was more enthusiastic, calling it a howling good time with solid performances from Hillis and Westwood, intriguing backstories, a gruesome war flashback and an effective practical-effects creature, and noting that the ending left the door open for a sequel.

documents.title: The Honeymoon
documents.overview: Englishman Adam and his American bride Sarah are about to embark on the romantic honeymoon of a lifetime in Venice, Italy. But when the newlyweds’ trip is gatecrashed by Adam’s excessively needy best friend, Ed, it inadvertently turns their perfect lovers’ holiday into a complete disaster.
documents.plot:
The Honeymoon is a 2022 romantic comedy written and directed by Dean Craig. Maria Bakalova and Pico Alexander star as a newly married couple whose trip to Venice is thrown into chaos by the groom's clingy best friend, played by Asim Chaudhry, while Lucas Bravo appears as a charismatic Italian gangster. The cast also includes Flynn Allen as a teenage version of the groom, Marco Valerio Montesano, Michele Enrico Montesano and Kai Portman, with Myha'la Herrold appearing as herself. Bakalova also served as a co-producer.

The story centers on Adam, who sweeps his new wife Sarah off to Venice for their honeymoon. The romantic getaway is compromised from the start, however, because Adam has invited his best friend Bav to come along. Bav, emotionally needy and lacking any sense of boundaries, attaches himself to the couple and sets off one embarrassing, gross-out mishap after another, leaving the newlyweds with almost no time alone. Matters grow more complicated when Sarah catches the eye of Giorgio, a suave local criminal who is immediately smitten with her. To clear the way to winning her over, Giorgio arranges to get rid of the two men by sending Adam and Bav across the border on a drug-smuggling errand, turning the holiday into a farcical crime caper in which the hapless pair must find a way back to Sarah before her new admirer succeeds in stealing her away.

The project was announced in August 2021, when Bakalova, Alexander, Chaudhry and Bravo were confirmed as the leads, with Craig directing from his own screenplay. Craig was previously best known as the writer of the British farce Death at a Funeral. Principal photography took place in Venice and Rome beginning in August 2021 and wrapped on 14 October 2021.

In July 2022 Amazon Studios acquired distribution rights for the United Kingdom and several European territories, Grindstone Entertainment Group took the rights for the United States and Canada, and Notorious Pictures secured Italy and Spain. The film opened in a limited theatrical release in the United States on 16 December 2022, simultaneously with digital and on-demand availability. It premiered in the United Kingdom on Amazon Prime Video on 29 December 2022, and Amazon also released it in Germany, Belgium, France, Scandinavia and Eastern Europe. Lionsgate issued it on Blu-ray on 24 January 2023.

documents.title: Pursuit
documents.tagline: They'll never be friends. But they're no longer enemies.
documents.overview: Detective Breslin crosses paths with Calloway, a ruthless hacker desperate to find his wife, who has been kidnapped by a drug cartel. When Calloway escapes police custody, Breslin joins forces with a no-nonsense female cop to reclaim his prisoner. But is Calloway’s crime-boss father somehow involved in this explosive situation?
documents.plot:
Pursuit is a 2022 American action thriller film directed by Brian Skiba and starring Emile Hirsch and John Cusack, with Jake Manley, Elizabeth Faith Ludlow, Graham Patrick Martin, Alexandria DeBerry and William Katt. The film centers on a police detective and a notorious hacker whose separate quests for their wives collide amid a war between drug traffickers.

Detective Mike Breslin is a straight-laced, honest cop still grieving his pregnant wife, who was murdered a few months earlier. He crosses paths with Rick Calloway, a ruthless, facially tattooed master hacker known by the alias Thanatos, who comes from an old Southern crime family headed by his father, played by Cusack. Rick's own wife has been kidnapped by a drug cartel, and he is desperate to save her. After being arrested, Rick offers to use his hacking skills to help Breslin track down the men who killed his wife, but the detective refuses the deal.

While being transported back to his hometown, Rick escapes from police custody. Breslin sets out to recapture his prisoner and joins forces with Zoe Carter, a no-nonsense local cop who has her own quiet agenda. As the two parallel stories unfold, with Rick's father overseeing his criminal operation and issuing orders to his men while grilling meat for his grandson, a series of cartel betrayals, bloody twists and violent encounters drive the characters toward one another. The pursuit finally converges in a chaotic climax filled with gunfights and a high body count.

Principal photography took place in Little Rock, Arkansas, in July 2021, and filming had wrapped by November. Lionsgate Home Entertainment released Pursuit direct to video on February 18, 2022. Reviews were overwhelmingly negative, and the film holds an 8% rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Lisa Kennedy of The New York Times wrote that in an earlier era the film would have gone straight from postproduction into a bargain bin at a rundown video store. Leslie Felperin of The Guardian called it a generic crime caper with characters whose names seemed generated by an algorithm, noting Hirsch's amused, droning delivery and Cusack's barbecue-loving gangster, while finding the climax full of improbably bad marksmanship. Julian Roman of MovieWeb was more positive, calling it a bloody and twisted pulp actioner with a spectacularly convoluted plot that keeps the adrenaline pumping with gritty action scenes.

documents.title: Escape the Undertaker
documents.tagline: It’s up to viewers to decide the fate of these poor souls trying to survive the wrath of The Undertaker.
documents.overview: The Undertaker has set a trap for the decorated tag team The New Day at his mansion. What they don't know: The Undertaker's mansion is an extreme Haunted House, packed to the brim with supernatural challenges. It's up to viewers to decide the fate of these poor souls trying to survive the wrath of The Undertaker.
documents.plot:
Escape the Undertaker is a 2021 American interactive horror comedy special produced by WWE Studios for Netflix, in which viewers make choices that shape the story, in the tradition of the streaming service's earlier interactive titles such as Black Mirror: Bandersnatch and You vs. Wild. It stars Mark Calaway as his wrestling persona the Undertaker, alongside the tag team The New Day, made up of Kofi Kingston (Kofi Sarkodie-Mensah), Xavier Woods (Austin Watson) and Big E (Ettore Ewen). Aimed at families and released with a TV-G rating, it was launched in October 2021 as a Halloween-season offering, and each viewing runs roughly half an hour.

In the story, the Undertaker has set a trap for The New Day at his mansion. The three decorated champions travel to the Dead Man's house hoping to steal his urn, a relic said to hold supernatural powers, because they want to feel its power for themselves. What they do not know is that the mansion is an extreme haunted house filled with supernatural challenges. When Big E touches the urn, his soul begins to be drained away, turning their quest into a race against time. The trio must investigate the rooms of the eerie house while the Undertaker watches their every move from a basement control room full of old computers and monitors. Viewers choose among two or three options at various points, which usually switch the story to follow a different member of the group, so that Xavier faces his fears or Kofi wanders off alone, and one key decision about halfway through determines whether the heroes escape. At the very first choice, viewers can also tell the Undertaker they are too scared to take part, which ends the special at once with a joke.

The special received lukewarm reviews. Mat Elfring of GameSpot rated it mediocre, describing it as a fun but not fully realized idea that is rushed, with limited replay value and interactivity that disappoints because most choices only show events from a different character's perspective while the outcome hinges on a single decision. He nevertheless praised it as lighthearted entertainment that parents could enjoy with their children, highlighting the natural, zany chemistry and jokes of The New Day, such as Big E repeatedly calling the wrestler "Uncle Taker", and its WWE Easter eggs, while finding the Undertaker's role the weak link. Other reviewers similarly considered it light, low-stakes fun let down by its thin branching.

documents.title: Nobody Sleeps in the Woods Tonight 2
documents.original_title: W lesie dziś nie zaśnie nikt 2
documents.overview: When something horrible happens to the only survivor of a bloody massacre, an insecure rookie cop must overcome his fears to stop further carnage.
documents.plot:
Nobody Sleeps in the Woods Tonight 2 (Polish: W lesie dziś nie zaśnie nikt 2) is a 2021 Polish supernatural slasher film, the sequel to Nobody Sleeps in the Woods Tonight (2020). Bartosz M. Kowalski again directed, writing the screenplay with Mirella Zaradkiewicz. Julia Wieniawa, Wojciech Mecwaldowski, Izabela Dabrowska and Michal Zbroja return from the first film, while Mateusz Więcławek and Zofia Wichlacz take over as the new leads.

Lonely young policeman Adam Adamiec learns from his boss, Sergeant Waldek, that a pair of deformed twin brothers have been arrested on the word of teenager Zosia, the only survivor of a massacre of her friends at a nearby camp. Waldek takes Zosia back to the twins' cabin to investigate, leaving Adam in charge. While the sergeant is away from her, part of the meteorite that mutated the twins splits open and releases a substance that turns Zosia into a mutant like them, and she kills Waldek. When he stops answering, Adam and his colleague Wanessa find the cabin wrecked and Waldek dead. Wanessa calls in two hunters, Mariusz and Slawek, but after Slawek traps his hands in a bear trap, the group shelters at the abandoned camp, where they find a frightened prostitute, Janeczka, whose companion Oliwier has been murdered outside.

Slawek bleeds to death, and a plan to lure Zosia using Janeczka as bait backfires when Zosia kills both Mariusz and Janeczka. Cornered in a cabin, Adam cannot bring himself to shoot her, and Wanessa shoves him toward Zosia and escapes. Zosia infects him through a stinger in her throat, and, able to talk with her in a language only they share, Adam learns they are monsters carrying an evil from the moon. Persuaded to kill whomever he chooses, he murders a man who abuses his dog, and the two become lovers. Zosia plans to free the twins and bring about the apocalypse, but the brothers refuse to leave their cell. Wanessa arrives armed with a machine gun and throws a grenade that fails to go off. When Adam hesitates, Zosia kills Wanessa herself, calls him a coward and walks out, only to be run down by special forces vehicles. Adam is captured, and one of the twins accidentally sets off the grenade, killing both brothers and destroying the station. Adam ends up in a laboratory as a test subject.

Więcławek plays Adam, Wichlacz plays Wanessa, Wieniawa plays Zosia, Andrzej Grabowski plays Waldek, Sebastian Stankiewicz plays Mariusz, Dabrowska plays Janeczka, Mecwaldowski plays Oliwier and Zbroja plays the twins.

documents.title: Corrective Measures
documents.tagline: Anarchy in the world's most dangerous prison.
documents.overview: Set in San Tiburon, the world's most dangerous maximum-security penitentiary and home to the world's most treacherous superpowered criminals, where tensions among the inmates and staff heighten, leading to anarchy that engulfs the prison and order is turned upside down.
documents.plot:
Sean O'Reilly wrote, produced and directed this 2022 American superhero film, his first live-action feature, adapting Grant Chastain's graphic novel Corrective Measures. Bruce Willis plays Julius "The Lobe" Loeb, a mind-controlling criminal genius, with Michael Rooker as the corrupt Warden Devlin, Dan Payne as the vigilante Payback, Brennan Mejia as Diego Diaz, Tom Cavanagh as Gordon Tweedy, Kat Ruston as Officer Liz Morales, Kevin Zegers as Captain Jason Brody and Hayley Sales as Dr. Isabelle Josephs.

The film is set in a world transformed by a global catastrophe known as the Pulse, which left some people with superhuman abilities. The most dangerous of these "enhanced humans" are locked up in San Tiburon, a privately run maximum-security prison where inhibitors worn on the inmates' legs suppress their powers. The story opens as Payback, a Bible-quoting brute devoted to hunting down the enhanced, wipes out a gang in a parking garage so that he can kill their target himself, and is arrested and sent to San Tiburon.

Arriving on the same transport is Diego, a timid young man whose only power is heightened empathy. He is taken under the wing of Gordon, once an electricity-wielding villain called the Conductor, and is quickly drawn into the prison's power struggles when he stops Payback from killing the Lobe. Devlin, who insists on being called "the Overseer" and swaggers around in a straw boater, is determined to extort the location of the Lobe's hidden fortune to finance a lavish retirement, while his subordinates jockey to succeed him. Payback's feuds with the other inmates and Devlin's pressure on the Lobe push tensions to breaking point, and the prison erupts into a violent uprising in which Diego's gift becomes vital to his survival, leaving the fate of San Tiburon unresolved.

Tubi released the film in select theaters and on demand on 29 April 2022, and is one of Willis's last films before he retired from acting following his dementia diagnosis. Reviews were mixed: The Guardian found its blend of comic-book schlock and criticism of the American prison system distinctive despite its derivative premise, while other critics called the script bland and Willis's limited performance listless.

documents.title: Resurrection
documents.tagline: Maintain control.
documents.overview: A woman’s carefully constructed life is upended when an unwelcome shadow from her past returns, forcing her to confront the monster she’s evaded for two decades.
documents.plot:
Resurrection is a 2022 American psychological thriller written and directed by Andrew Semans. Rebecca Hall stars as a successful single mother whose controlled life falls apart when a man from her past reappears, with Tim Roth, Grace Kaufman and Michael Esper. Shot in Albany, New York, and Williamsburg, Brooklyn, it premiered at the Sundance Film Festival on January 22, 2022, and was released by IFC Films and Shudder on July 29, 2022.

Margaret is a composed, highly organised executive in Albany who is raising her daughter Abbie, about to leave for college, on her own. She carries on a casual affair with a married colleague, Peter, and seems entirely in command of her life. At a conference, however, she spots David, a man she has not seen in more than twenty years. Overcome by panic, she rushes home, becomes fiercely protective of Abbie and begins to suffer nightmares. When she confronts David, he calmly tells her that "Ben is with me", smiling to reveal a missing tooth. The police are unable to help, so she changes the locks and buys a gun.

To a young colleague, Margaret describes her past. She met David at eighteen, moved in with him almost immediately and fell under his control. He demanded "kindnesses", acts of humiliation and self-harm, as proof of her love. When they had a son, Benjamin, David grew jealous of the child, and one day Margaret came home to find the baby gone; David told her he had eaten him. He convinced her that their son still lived inside him, and she eventually escaped.

Now David again exerts his hold over her, hinting that she is to blame for Abbie's recent accident and leaving the key to his hotel room, where she finds Ben's blanket. Margaret starts to lactate, plans to kill him, and fails when he overpowers her, after which she imagines hearing a baby crying inside him. He forces her to perform a new "kindness", standing in a stress position in a park for hours at night. Abbie, frightened by her mother's behaviour, flees, and Margaret violently rejects Peter.

Leaving a farewell message for Abbie, Margaret meets David in a hotel room, where he invites her to feel his stomach. She attacks him with knives, ties him to the bed and cuts him open, apparently pulling out a living baby. In a final scene, a loving Abbie says goodbye to her mother, who holds the infant, but Margaret's smile gives way to terror, leaving the reality of the ending open.

Critics praised Hall's performance, and the film has 81% approval on Rotten Tomatoes.

documents.title: Oppenheimer
documents.tagline: The world forever changes.
documents.overview: The story of J. Robert Oppenheimer’s role in the development of the atomic bomb during World War II.
documents.plot: The story of J. Robert Oppenheimer's role in the development of the atomic bomb during World War II.

documents.title: Robbing Mussolini
documents.overview: At the end of WWII, an ambitious bootlegger and his nightclub-singing girlfriend assemble a ragtag bunch of misfits for an impossible heist: to steal Mussolini's treasure right from his headquarters.
documents.plot:
Robbing Mussolini (Rapiniamo il Duce) is an Italian historical action comedy of 2022 directed by Renato De Maria and distributed by Netflix, which released it on 26 October 2022. Pietro Castellitto stars as the smuggler Pietro "Isola" Lamberti, with Matilda De Angelis as the singer Yvonne, Tommaso Ragno as Marcello, Isabella Ferrari as Nora, Maccio Capatonda as the former racing driver Fabbri and Filippo Timi as the Fascist federal secretary Achille Borsalino.

In the last days of the Second World War, Isola, a black-market dealer in Fascist-held Milan, is trying to raise enough money to flee with his lover Yvonne, a singer who is also the mistress of the cruel Borsalino. With his associates Marcello and Amedeo he intercepts a coded order to move a vast hoard of treasure looted by the regime to Switzerland. They plan to steal it from the heavily guarded Black Zone within a week, recruiting the runner Hessa, the anarchist bomb-maker Molotov and Fabbri. Borsalino and his aide Leonida catch Isola leaving a rendezvous with Yvonne and warn him off, but Yvonne agrees to steal Borsalino's personal stamp so the gang can enter the zone. Borsalino, unaware, even shows her the treasure; he plans to leave his wife Nora, who is sleeping with Leonida.

When Yvonne faints on stage and Isola rushes to her, a gunfight erupts, and the couple escape with Fabbri's help; Yvonne then tells Isola she is carrying his child. Nora, who has been spying on them, blackmails Isola into giving her half the loot and pulling off the robbery within a day. The night raid goes wrong when guards stop Isola, disguised as a prisoner, and the alarm sounds early; Molotov is fatally wounded but sets off his explosives, and in the confusion the gang drive off with the treasure. Meanwhile Borsalino seizes Yvonne but is beaten to death by Nora, who then double-crosses Isola at the meeting point, keeps Yvonne as a hostage and orders Leonida to kill the gang. Partisans arrive and save them, and Nora and Leonida flee toward the Alps in the truck. Chasing them in a racing car, Isola knocks down Leonida and Fabbri shoots the truck's driver, sending the vehicle into a lake. Isola and Yvonne surface as the radio announces the surrender of Axis forces in Italy; a mid-credits scene shows that Nora survived as well.

Reviewing it for Cineuropa, Davide Abbatescianni was unimpressed, faulting weak characterization, below-par performances and predictable subplots.

documents.title: Jingle Bell Princess
documents.overview: An actual princess has some mechanical issues and is temporarily grounded.  Does she have time for a lobster roll? It is Christmas time in Maine which means snow, quaint scenery, and lots of Christmas lights near the ocean.  With the crew distracted attending to the repair, Princess Amelia deplanes to walk through a magical Christmas tree lot near the airport perimeter.
documents.plot:
Jingle Bell Princess is a 2021 Canadian-American Christmas romantic comedy television film directed by Don McBrearty from a screenplay by Blaine Chiappetta and James D. Hughes. Produced by Brad Krevoy Television, the Motion Picture Corporation of America, Hideaway Pictures and All Canadian Entertainment, it stars Merritt Patterson as a European princess and Trevor Donovan as a widowed father, with Charlie Boyle, Marnie McPhail and Matthew Finlan in supporting roles. The film was shot in Ontario in the autumn of 2021 and premiered on the then-new GAC Family cable network on 4 December 2021, during the channel's first season of original Christmas films; it was later made available on Peacock. It runs 85 minutes.

Princess Amelia (Patterson), the polished royal of a fictional European kingdom, is due to fly home after a speaking engagement on the East Coast of the United States when mechanical problems ground her plane. While the crew is busy with the repairs and an old-fashioned snowstorm settles over the area, she slips away from the aircraft to wander through a magical Christmas tree lot near the edge of the airport. Through a series of mishaps she ends up stranded in Tucker, a small, snow-covered seaside town in Maine full of quaint scenery and Christmas lights. There she is taken in as an ordinary guest by the unsuspecting Cutler family, including widower Sam Cutler (Donovan) and his young daughter Sophie (Boyle), who do not know who she really is. As Amelia experiences small-town holiday traditions with them, she and Sam grow close and each learns lessons that leave them with renewed hope, while she must decide when to reveal her royal identity.

Reviews from holiday-film critics were mixed.
